screen.immortal_cultivation_mod.life.act: Regular activities cost one action. Seclusion costs two and is available once per year. Three actions reset each year.
screen.immortal_cultivation_mod.life.cho: Choose one legacy. Open the spell or item list to choose what you bring back.
screen.immortal_cultivation_mod.life.rew: This life's legacy has been claimed.

life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.birth: You were born into a new and uncertain life.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.quiet_: The year passed quietly, leaving only small changes behind.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.relati: Someone close to you reached the end of their lifespan.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.breakt: Your Qi surged through the barrier and your realm advanced.
The breakthrough failed and backlash tore through your meridians.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.relati: You spent time tending an important relationship.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.death: Your simulated life came to its end.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.manual: You ended the simulation early and settled the experiences and achievements gained so far.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.fate_s: A thread of preserved fate turned certain death into a grievous injury.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.log.child_: A child was born into your household, carrying traces of both parents.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.s: You devoted the year to study and sharpened your comprehension.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.e: You tempered your body and practiced practical combat.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.f: You stayed near your family and strengthened old bonds.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.e: You ventured beyond familiar roads in search of opportunity.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.w: You worked diligently and improved your livelihood.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.s: You met people, exchanged stories, and widened your circle.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.r: You set aside ambition for a time and recovered body and mind.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.c: You circulated Qi through repeated cycles of cultivation.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.p: You practiced combat arts until each movement became clearer.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.activity.s: You completed a sect mission and returned with merit.
You closed your doors to the world and cultivated in solitude.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.root: You hold your hand against the testing stone while the steward reads it. From the edge of the square your family asks, “Can they enter the sect?”
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.joi: You accept the assessment and follow the directions onto the sect's mountain path.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.sta: You decline the invitation and return home to your familiar life.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.see: You leave home to seek a teacher willing to take you as a student elsewhere.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.brea: Qi repeatedly reaches the barrier and recoils as pressure comes and goes in your dantian. Before attempting the next realm you must assess your foundation, body and composure.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.bre: You gather your available Qi and begin pressing against the realm barrier.
You postpone the attempt and keep working on the unstable parts of your foundation.
You pay for medicine and guidance to improve the preparation you can actually make.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: The steward lays out four slips. “Village patrol, escort, a hunt and old records. Read the work before accepting; the reward won't tell you everything.”
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: You collect the patrol token and set off downhill before dawn.
The caravan manager meets you outside the gate to examine both routes ahead.
You accept the charcoal map marking the beast's freshest tracks.
Three days sorting records earn merit and a little understanding from the surviving texts.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: The bloody tracks are fresh but villagers ask you to stay. “What if they return tonight?” Pursuit may find the pack while guarding protects those sheltering here.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: You catch the pack in a narrow gully and leave with injuries and a few stones from its den.
The pack tests the firelight twice and retreats before the villagers thank you at dawn.
Your detailed map lets the elder deal with the threat without further loss of life.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: Raiders watch the mountain road while the river rises. Their envoy demands a sealed box and the manager asks, “Would one box really make them leave the rest?”
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: You defeat the ambush and deliver every medicine chest for the hazardous-route payment and two mid-grade stones.
The caravan arrives safely after a draining night beside the cold river.
Recognizing the envoy's bluff you negotiate passage through treatment of the wounded and both parties remember the arrangement.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: The beast sleeps among bones beneath the broken bridge with a sect arrow lodged in its wound. You can strike, prepare a trap or risk waiting for support.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.mis: A close fight nearly breaks your ribs before you prevail and gain cultivation from the core and experience.
After studying the terrain all night you trigger the prepared formation at sunrise and finish the hunt without a direct struggle.
Your fellow disciples complete the hunt without a death and one becomes a lasting companion.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.expl: The familiar road ends at a stone marker between medicinal scent, a cold sealed residence and caravan bells in the mist. You must choose where to go first.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.exp: You identify several herbs and trade the surplus for travel money and fasting pills.
A lingering technique breaks through your protection while the cave yields stones and dispersed Qi.
Conversation around the caravan fire leads to a useful trade and a new friendship.
You return in time before the night's thunder brings down the mountain paths you had considered.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.chil: Playing beside the stream, you accidentally eat a faintly spiritual herb and feel warmth followed by discomfort. A herbalist identifies the remaining leaves, asks how much you ate and has you rest. The discomfort passes, leaving somewhat improved vitality, without granting a root or cultivation method.

A neighboring child knocks early, eager to search the riverbank for a light seen falling there last night. An elder at home also needs your help, and an unfinished book lies open on the table. Your neighbor waits at the door and promises you will be back before dark.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.chi: You agree to finish the work at home together and play by the river that afternoon. The time gives you plenty to talk about. On later visits, he no longer has to explain whom he has come to see.
You return muddy and clutching an unfamiliar wild herb after the excitement of exploring the hills together.
You stay with the old books after the others leave and lose track of time until the road outside is quiet.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.fort: A blind fortune-teller at the market's edge calls you by name. Coins tremble on the cloth before him, beside a drawing of two diverging paths. “What I see is one way things could go,” he says, offering a seat. “Whether you hear it is up to you.”
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.for: He describes the broad outline of your hidden fate and leaves details for you to consider afterward.
The paid reading offers closer warnings about danger and opportunity without choosing the path for you.
You leave the stall unwilling to hand your decisions to a stranger's account of your future.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.seve: Days of fever leave you struggling to rise and ordinary remedies no longer help. A physician sends treatment proposals, but you must first consider their cost. With the prescriptions beside your bed, you weigh hired care, your existing medical knowledge or enduring it before the illness worsens.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.ill: The expensive medicine steadies your breathing and your strength gradually returns afterward.
Your existing medical skill gets you through the most dangerous night and leaves time to recover from the remaining weakness.
You survive without proper treatment but retain a lingering illness after the fever passes.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.woun: Traveling after the rain, you find an unfamiliar elderly cultivator wounded beside the road. He grips a bloodied manual and wears a broken sect token. At your approach he tries to rise, just as pursuers begin shouting farther down the path.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.hea: You help the elder into shelter off the road and avoid the pursuers before treating him. Once stable, he offers some cultivation guidance and remembers your name. His injuries still need recovery.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.ste: You take the manual and leave before the pursuers see you, leaving the elder behind without his consent to the theft.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.rep: You call to nearby patrolling disciples, who hold off the pursuers and collect the elder. After establishing the facts, their sect rewards you. The bloodied manual remains with him rather than entering your belongings.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.lea: You continue along the road without approaching or treating the elder as pursuit continues behind you.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.care: Now an adult, you look for steady work. A caravan needs another hand, a pharmacy will take an apprentice and a smith offers to teach you from the beginning. All three want an answer. You must decide where to start.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.bec: You begin by identifying and sorting herbs and gradually earn a steady living from the trade.
You begin managing cargo and accounts for the caravan, saving wages before buying your own first stock. Prices rise and fall; the trade has to be learned through actual transactions.
Repeated work at the forge toughens your hands and teaches the patience needed to shape metal properly.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.band: Fallen logs block the narrow road. As you stop, more than ten bandits emerge on either side. Archers wait on the slope and several earlier travelers are held nearby. Their leader approaches with his hand out for a toll.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.ban: You break the ambush and the travelers escape with you. Identifiable belongings return to their owners; your gain comes from the remaining spoils and their collected thanks. The fight's resource costs and injuries remain.
You escape the pursuing bandits with injuries and discover that your purse is much lighter too.
The bandits open a path after taking the money and watch you leave without a fight.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.anci: A collapsed wall beside the mountain path reveals a residence hidden by vines. You stop to inspect its dustless entrance and still-glowing formation lines. Metal scrapes somewhere inside, as though something is being dragged aside.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.rui: The entrance mechanism pulls a chain, revealing the source of the earlier scraping as a trap. You emerge injured with spirit stones and incomplete teachings from the chamber, and wounds still to treat.
Studying the lines from outside reveals part of their workings without requiring you to enter farther.
You note the location and leave without pursuing the uncertain treasure or the scraping sound behind it.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.sect: The sect tournament opens as you and the other disciples reach the platforms. Elders and guests take their seats while a steward checks registrations and places the lots in the box. Registration remains open. You can enter or stay beside the ring to observe.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.tou: Several rounds earn recognition in the sect from people who now know your name and techniques.
Watching the matches shows why parts of your own technique lag and gives you something specific to work on.
Withdrawing preserves your condition while drawing a few mocking remarks from the sidelines.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.dao_: During a rest, the cultivator who has traveled with you for years brings out an old keepsake you share. The conversation turns to your time together. At last they ask whether you would become cultivation partners and plan the years ahead together.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.result.com: You discuss the future and pledge to cultivate together, beginning to include each other in your plans.
You choose friendship and your companion puts away the keepsake without dismissing the years you traveled together.
You part without forcing the remaining words and continue separately with regret still unspoken.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.event.rare: During your usual practice on a summit, the rhythm of the dawn clouds helps resolve a long-standing difficulty. You steady your breathing and work slowly through the circulation you already know, incorporating the insight into your existing method. Daylight is full when you finish.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.huti_qi.q: 10 Qi to activate or recast; 1 Qi/second upkeep

Gather spiritual qi within your palm and shape it into a blazing fireball, hurling it forth to burn foes and scorch all in its path.
Circulate spiritual power to enter the Lingbeng state. Activating it again prolongs its effects and expands the explosive flames. This technique may be stacked up to ten layers.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.regenerat: Guide spiritual qi to nourish the body. For three breaths, vitality continuously flows through the flesh, steadily healing wounds.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.beam.desc: Condense spiritual power into a unique streak of light visible only to the caster. The phenomenon lingers for ten breaths before fading.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.earth_esc: Sink into the earth and travel through soil and stone while greatly increasing movement speed. Consumes 8 qi each second underground and ends upon returning to the surface.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.cleanse.d: Recite a cleansing incantation to wash over the body, removing all lingering curses, afflictions, and negative effects.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.qi_gather: Focus solely on absorbing the qi of heaven and earth. While active, you possess no offensive or defensive abilities, and all damage received is tripled.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.lingzhi_b: Condense a thread of spiritual power at your fingertip and release it with a light flick. The qi cost is minimal, yet it can wound enemies and shatter up to three blocks of stone.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_blad: Gather fierce winds into a razor-sharp blade. Whether slashing, cutting, or piercing, its edge can grievously wound an enemy.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_step: A movement technique that may be toggled at will. Winds gather beneath your feet, greatly increasing speed and granting an additional midair jump. Consumes 5 qi per second.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yufeng_ju: Ride the winds and drift through the air at low altitude. Consumes 30 qi per second. If no solid ground exists within twenty meters below, the power of flight is lost.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.smoke_art: Condense mist into a projectile and launch it forward. Those caught within the spreading smoke are blinded and unable to see for ten breaths.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.huti_qi.d: Toggle automatic shielding. Cast to form a 20-point physical shield for 10 Qi, with 1 Qi per second upkeep. When broken, it automatically recasts for another 10 Qi; damage beyond the old shield still gets through. If Qi is insufficient, protection pauses and reforms when 10 Qi is available. Cast again to turn it off for free. Cultivator spells bypass this shield.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.michen_zh: Stir dust to obscure vision, disrupt enemy ranged targeting, provides no damage reduction.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sliding_w: Launch a condensed water orb that forms a shallow pool upon impact. Those who step into it find their movements distorted and their controls reversed.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.ignite_fl: Channel true fire into a blazing streak that races forward. Grass, wood, stone, and all it touches are set aflame.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.spirit_si: A spiritual eye technique that may be freely toggled. When active, night appears as bright as day. Consumes 5 qi per second.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.light_bea: Expend 90 qi to summon six hexagonal spirit orbs behind you, stacking up to three layers. A punch fires a single orb, while a concealed strike releases them all at once. Each orb possesses immense destructive power, capable of devastating powerful foes and shattering large areas of terrain.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.dielang_s: Condense layers of water-aspected spiritual power into protective shields. One layer costs 50 qi and blocks 12 damage; two layers cost 100 qi and block 36 damage; three layers cost 150 qi and withstand 108 damage.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zhenshan_: Gather the power of earth and stone into a colossal palm strike. The palm persists for three breaths, crushing all rock and soil in its path.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.weiya.des: Release oppressive cultivation pressure for 2% of maximum Qi per second. Range grows from 12 to 64 blocks with cultivation stage. Weaker creatures tremble or kneel, dust and stones rise, and rain stops beneath the pressure dome.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zibao.des: Fatal: consumes all remaining lifespan. Select this spell, then press and release the cast key (default R) three times within 5 seconds. The first two presses only warn you; the third detonates. Opening a menu or switching spells cancels confirmation. Radius: Golden Core 50, Nascent Soul 80, Spirit Transformation 100, Void Refining 200, Body Integration 300, Mahayana 400, Tribulation 500 blocks.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.absorb_cu: Launch a Yin-aspected spirit projectile. If it strikes someone with lower cultivation, one-tenth of their cultivation progress is extracted and added to your own.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.tuntian.d: Devour all earth and stone within a five-meter radius, leaving nothing behind. Each block consumed advances your cultivation. The technique also devastates nearby living beings, and slain foes have their essence absorbed to greatly increase your cultivation.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.fengya.de: A toggleable secret technique. After channeling power, every punch—whether through the air, against stone, or at an enemy—unleashes a spiraling cone of compressed wind. Upon reaching the Golden Core Realm, concealed punches can summon a far larger wind cone.
Silently recite an arcane incantation and launch a metal-aspected spirit projectile. Targets with lower cultivation become rigid and unable to move for a short time.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yinlei_ju: Commune with the spiritual energies of heaven and earth, launch a lightning talisman, and call down heavenly lightning to strike the target.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wulei_zhe: An orthodox Daoist lightning art. Palm lightning and heavenly thunder descend together as five mighty lightning pillars, specializing in the destruction of evil spirits and demonic beings.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.liuguang_: 50 sword-light balls, 50 damage each; charged casts spawn up to 80

Release fifty sword-light balls in every direction, or up to eighty when fully charged. Each changes direction after striking blocks, striking enemies, flying ten blocks, or reaching a ten-block radius from the caster; radius redirects pick another non-outward direction rather than always returning straight to the caster. A projectile disappears after its twentieth direction change.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sifang_ji: Mini protective barrier shelters 3-5 cultivators, blocks poison and low-grade illusions.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.gushi_shi: Earth true essence forms sturdy stone shield, withstands slashes and blunt strikes, blocks common elemental spells.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.kongshi_s: Bind a zombie or corpse as your servant. Targets below your cultivation, or no more than one major realm above you, can be controlled.
Cultivating this method refines your own blood essence into Blood Qi. Thereafter, techniques and cultivation arts consume Blood Qi instead of Spiritual Qi.
Upon mastery, you naturally acquire the Absorb technique. Striking those of lower cultivation allows you to seize their cultivation and strengthen your own Dao foundation.
This method grants the divine power of Devouring Heaven, allowing the user to consume earth, stone, and living beings, transforming their essence into cultivation progress.
Mastering this method grants the Wind Pressure technique. Every punch tears through the air with destructive wind cones capable of injuring enemies and shattering stone.

Life Cycle: gather 0–100 Life Force from living terrain, creatures, healing allies, and high ambient Qi. At 60+ Life Force, Flourishing improves natural healing, Qi recovery, and Wood-technique efficiency; at 80+, Evergreen Breath periodically restores missing health. Below 40% HP, Withering automatically burns Life Force to resist death. A lethal hit can trigger Withered Wood Returns to Spring for 35 Life Force, but it then has a 3-minute cooldown. Fire and barren terrain sharply reduce generation.

When a cultivator falls for the first time, death does not come immediately. The soul persists as a spirit form for the duration of an incense stick, leaving a trail of flames before reforming the body with a final spark of life. Once the body has fully recovered, this life-saving ability may be used again.
All spiritual qi becomes extreme cold yin qi. It freezes water vapor, seals meridians, and grants the personal spells Cold Crystal Lock Claw, Frost Heaven Cry, and Frost-Shattering Skyglide.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.hanjing_s: Gather ice qi into the fingers, dash forward, and seize the target with frozen claws. Lower-level targets receive Frozen Qi, stopping automatic qi regeneration.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shuangtia: Release a mournful cry of extreme cold. The projectile blooms into a freezing field on impact. Lower-level targets become Frozen and Dazed, preventing spell casting.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.suishuang: Condense frost clouds beneath the feet and skim through the air at high speed. It only works at low altitude and drains qi quickly.
tooltip.immortal_cultivation_mod.sword_r: Golden Core+: %s toggles sword flight. Creative-flight controls; selected speed x1.5, above the realm cap.
message.immortal_cultivation_mod.sword_r: No controlled flying sword within 8 blocks and in sight. Release a sword and control it with Yuqi Shu first.
Not enough room to board. Move away from walls and low ceilings.
Sword flight: double-tap Jump to take off/land; Jump rises, %2$s descends. %1$s returns to ordinary flight. Speed x1.5.

Blue spiritual fire appeared in a ruined workshop north of here.
Cloud-pattern silver has become costly since the trade road closed.
A master refiner is seeking Star Dust Stone and paying without negotiation.
Speak softly. The dead nearby are resting, not deaf.
Do not fear the talismans. Fear what requires them.
The bell at my waist is a tool, not decoration.
Keep away from the coffin unless invited closer.
Living guests are rarer than silent ones in my work.
You still breathe evenly. Good. We may speak.
Grudge grows slowly, but neglect can turn a servant into a calamity.
A corpse remembers strength in its bones even after memory leaves the mind.
Yin qi must refine the body without consuming the controlling seal.
The best corpse control is precise enough that the dead never resist.
Blood crystals hasten grudge, but haste produces unstable servants.
A burial mound east of here has begun exhaling yin qi at noon.
Someone has been removing suppression talismans from old graves.
The nearby compass shows a moving patch of dense yin qi.
Black Stiffs have been seen where only ordinary corpses were buried.
At midnight the abandoned temple bell rings, though its bell was stolen years ago.
You look sturdy enough. Have you trained your foundation or only your appearance?
Sit. My breathing exercise is nearly finished.
A firm handshake reveals weaknesses that words conceal.
Do not mistake these bracers for armor. They are part of the training.
Pain is information. Injury is a warning. Learn the difference.
Eat well before training. Empty pride does not rebuild muscle.
Qi must enter flesh, sinew, and bone instead of merely circling the dantian.
External force reveals weak places that meditation cannot find.
I strengthen the body one honest injury at a time.
A powerful fist begins at the feet and passes through the whole body.
Defense without mobility is only a sturdier way to be struck.
A waterfall nearby is strong enough to temper the back and shoulders.
The apothecary has run out of body-tempering pills again.
A stone-skinned beast has been breaking traps near the mountain road.
Someone shattered the training posts outside town with bare fists.
The mineral spring north of here closes wounds unusually quickly.
Your name is unfamiliar, but manners can make a proper introduction.
My family taught me never to dismiss an unexpected guest.
Please sit. Clan business has left me eager for ordinary conversation.
Reputation opens doors, but conduct decides whether they remain open.
I represent more than myself, even during a casual meeting.
A family token proves origin, not character.
Our ancestral method is stable because generations corrected its flaws.
Inherited resources create opportunity, not guaranteed attainment.
Every breakthrough reflects on the family name carried with it.
Clan instructors value foundations more than dazzling early progress.
A secret art becomes worthless if its heir lacks the patience to master it.
Two families are negotiating over a spirit mine near the border.
The upcoming clan gathering will draw merchants from several provinces.
Someone has been forging family tokens to enter private auctions.
An elder vanished while inspecting the ancestral burial grounds.
A marriage alliance has made the local sects suddenly very polite.
You may dispense with ceremony. We are not at court.
State your name. I prefer to know whom I am addressing.
Few speak honestly to royalty. I hope you will be unusual.
The token is genuine. Reaching for it would still be unwise.
Travel beyond the palace is less comfortable and far more informative.
Sit. Rank should not waste time that conversation could use.
The royal archives preserve methods that vanished from ordinary sects.
Resources ease cultivation, but they cannot command enlightenment.
My foundation is a personal duty and a matter of state.
Protective treasures are useful, but relying on them invites a second death.
Power must be controlled twice: once in the meridians and once in the court.
The capital has restricted spirit-stone exports without explaining why.
A royal convoy disappeared on a road guarded by three cultivators.
Several officials have begun collecting ancient jade pendants in secret.
The border garrison reports spiritual beasts moving in organized groups.
Court astrologers disagree about an omen above the eastern mountains.
Keep your voice down and your questions useful.
You did not recognize me. Let us keep it that way.
Stand where I can see the road behind you.
Names are expensive. Call me whatever causes the least trouble.
I am not hiding from justice. I am avoiding someone else's version of it.
If guards arrive, we have never met.
Cultivation on the run teaches speed, concealment, and very short meditations.
A disguise hides a face, not the rhythm of familiar qi.
I keep enough qi for one escape even while sleeping.
Forbidden techniques are often just techniques owned by the wrong people.
A breakthrough leaves traces. Mine must happen far from witnesses.
New wanted orders appeared in three towns before sunrise.
The western checkpoint now inspects storage pouches as well as faces.
Someone is paying copper for information and spirit stones for silence.
A bounty hunter nearby wears sect robes over imperial armor.
There is a safe path through the marsh, but it will not remain safe for long.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinhuo_xi: Summon a particle fireball that homes in on the last living entity to hurt you. If no valid attacker exists, it remains motionless until a new entity attacks you, then begins pursuing that attacker. On impact, it ignites the target with water-resistant heart-fire and applies Heart Immolation for 30 seconds, draining 100 qi and 10 + the caster's Thought Damage in thoughts each second.
message.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinhuo_: No living attacker remains for the heart-fire to pursue.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.suigui_xi: Five falling stars, ten when fully charged; 30-block damage radius, small terrain craters

Compress the star paths engraved around your body into five falling meteors, or ten at full charge. Each impact damages enemies within 30 blocks, carves a small crater roughly 8 blocks in radius, and leaves a permanent carpet-like star mark that damages and weakens undead within 5 blocks.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.dongtian_: Borrow Qi from the Inner Heaven
Restores 1% max qi per generated inner-world chunk

Briefly open the grotto-heaven within your Golden Core and draw out its stored spiritual power. Restore 1% of maximum qi for every chunk generated in your personal Golden Core world. Chunk generation costs depend on core quality: Cracked 5000, Low 4000, Middle 3000, High 2000, Supreme 1000, Perfect 900, Nine-Revolution 800 qi.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shixu_chi: 30-block temporal domain; enemies move at one-twentieth speed

Establish a pale-gold, 30-block temporal domain around yourself. Broken clock rings catch and release in uneven steps beneath a translucent forcefield-like boundary. Enemies within the domain move and attack at one-twentieth their normal speed and experience visibly held, choppy moments, while your movement and attack speed are tripled. Hostile projectiles stop with stretched temporal afterimages and resume their original flight when released. The elementless domain consumes 500 qi each second.

Every wandering soul is cultivation waiting to be claimed.
Do not fear the banner. Fear what answers from inside it.
Righteous paths waste power by burying their dead.
A soul bottle is quiet only when it is empty.
Keep your distance if you value the shape of your spirit.
At my realm, the banner can hold only so many resentful souls.

method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.bas:
Draw a gentle breath through every meridian.
Let its slow current wash away impurity.
Keep the spirit still and balance blood and Qi.
Nourish your foundation through day and night.
Every path to the Dao begins with breathing.
A steady breath carries cultivation forward.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.cle:
Set aside distractions and quiet the restless mind.
Clear the spirit of worldly desires.
As turbid Qi fades, wisdom rises within.
Remain unshaken by illusion and temptation.
A heart like a mirror sees truth and falsehood.
Guard its clarity and avoid the crooked path.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.blo:
Draw in blood Qi and turn it into boundless might.
Waves of blood shake the surrounding void.
Feed the art with blood to unleash savage force.
A crimson wind drives ordinary foes away.
Let the blood surge, even at the cost of your essence.
One strike can split the earth and break a mountain.

Feed the art with blood to unleash savage force.
A crimson wind drives ordinary foes away.
Let the blood surge, even at the cost of your essence.
One strike can split the earth and break a mountain.

Draw in blood Qi and turn it into boundless might.
Waves of blood shake the surrounding void.
Feed the art with blood to unleash savage force.
A crimson wind drives ordinary foes away.
Let the blood surge, even at the cost of your essence.
One strike can split the earth and break a mountain.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.rei:
Contemplate the changing forms of reincarnation.
Learn the hidden cycle of life and death.
A turning thought reverses fortune and decline.
The endless cycle renews itself again.
Become one with the rise and fall of all things.
Break free of the chains of time.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.tun:
Swallow the free essence of heaven and earth.
Gather the arts of every direction within yourself.
Refine the essence of all things in the dantian.
Let your towering presence shake every living soul.
Absorb all Qi, whether righteous or demonic.
Build a power that reaches across the universe.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.pok:
Tear through the spatial wall before you.
Pass beyond the barriers of distance.
Let surging force scatter the clouds of the void.
Cross the world in an instant, without a weary journey.
A sharpened fingertip can cut a rift in space.
Come and go unseen among mountains and seas.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.jiu:
Draw cold death Qi from the Nine Nether depths.
Temper bare bones and remake the corpse.
Let Yin mist veil the sun and moon.
Command the dead to rise and obey.
Cold reaches the soul and slows every step.
The baleful Yin endures without fading.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.han:
A chilling cry stirs the icy wind.
Condense the cold into frost blades and talons.
Seize your foe and bind their meridians.
Let frost spread and still their blood and Qi.
Ice seals all things and holds the body fast.
Its piercing chill leaves little hope of escape.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.fen:
Burn your own vitality to gain strength.
Let flames rise across the distant world.
A thread of life borrows fire to delay its end.
Heavenly flames sweep away every obstacle.
Face encircling foes beneath a blazing sky.
Spend your life for one decisive moment.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.cui:
Let vigorous Qi scour flesh, sinew, bone, and skin.
Temper the mortal body through countless trials.
Hold true to yourself despite the pain.
An iron body can withstand a cutting blade.
Patient practice reshapes mortal flesh.
A mighty physique stands against hostile spells.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.cha:
Draw the vitality of living plants into your body.
Learn from ancient trees that flourish year after year.
Let flowing life heal every wound.
Withered wood blooms again in spring.
A gentle breath endures without exhaustion.
Remain with the world, unafraid of passing years.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_blad:
Gather the high wind into an edge of cold Qi.
Send it through the air to cut brush and stone.
Light and silent, it begins the art of Qi control.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.qi_gather:
Breathe in the pure essence of clouds and heaven.
Wash the meridians and nourish the source of life.
Build the foundation for a cultivator's path.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.cleanse.d:
Pure Qi brushes away dust and impurity.
A soft glow surrounds and cleanses the body.
A humble art accompanies the wandering cultivator.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.beam.desc:
Take a thread of dawn and form a straight spiritual ray.
Its clear light pierces darkness and obstruction.
A gentle beginning to the mastery of light.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.lingzhi_b:
Gather a spark of Qi at your fingertip.
A flick sends it swiftly toward a distant target.
A nimble little art for testing an opponent.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.spirit_si:
Open your eyes to spiritual light beyond mist and illusion.
See hidden forms and read the surrounding Qi.
A subtle vision far beyond ordinary sight.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.smoke_art:
Spread drifting smoke across the nearby air.
Cloud the sight and unsettle the enemy's senses.
A small escape art kept by many cultivators.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wind_step:
A gentle wind lifts the body and quickens the step.
Pure Qi curls beneath your feet as you dodge.
An early wind art for short, agile movements.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sliding_w:
Draw water Qi beneath your feet and tread upon the waves.
Cross the surface freely, without its resistance.
A secret art for short journeys over rivers.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.huti_qi.d:
A thin mantle of Qi surrounds the body.
Soft force disperses the weight of hostile blows.
A basic guard carried by Qi Refining cultivators.
Gather spiritual fire into a crimson sphere in your palm.
Cast it forth to burst and burn the path ahead.
A first fire art with plain and potent force.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.michen_zh:
Stir the dust of every direction into the wind.
Layer upon layer of haze hides sight and sound.
Cloud an enemy's senses and gain room to maneuver.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.regenerat:
Let living Qi flow through the wounded flesh.
Slowly smooth its scars and soothe its pain.
A gentle healing art for ordinary wounds.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.dielang_s:
Layer spiritual Qi into a shield like flowing water.
Wave after wave receives and dissolves each blow.
A supple guard against unending attacks.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yinlei_ju:
Reach toward the sky and summon threads of thunder.
Swift lightning strikes ghosts and baleful spirits.
The first mysteries of thunder carry fearsome power.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.kongshi_s:
Mark a lifeless body with your spiritual will.
Make the corpse your servant and command its steps.
A secret sidelong art scorned by righteous cultivators.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yufeng_ju:
Ride a long wind and tread the clouds.
Cross mountains and fields in a fleeting moment.
A supreme Qi Refining movement art for the wandering soul.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.earth_esc:
Merge with the earth and hide among its veins.
Slip beneath the ground, beyond the gaze of stronger foes.
A secret path of stealth and escape.
Drive your inner Qi outward in a sudden shock.
A surging wave pushes nearby enemies away.
This burst of bodily Qi cannot be used endlessly.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.gushi_shi:
Draw the dense essence of the earth into a giant stone shield.
Stand firm as rock against the fiercest blows.
The earth's defensive art offers steadfast protection.
Place Qi within a weapon and guide it through the air.
Strike near or far without grasping its hilt.
A foundation of weapon control for established cultivators.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.xuying_ta:
Step into the air and leave elusive shadows behind.
Shift between true and false forms to confuse your foe.
A secret footwork art for roaming melee combat.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wulei_zhe:
Summon five interwoven bolts of mighty thunder.
Heaven's pure Yang power sweeps away demons and evil.
A noble lightning art passed down by the Daoist tradition.
Condense your will into an unseen piercing needle.
Slip silently into the enemy's spiritual sea.
A soul attack wounds without a visible blade.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.light_bea:
Gather countless strands of light into a brilliant sphere.
Its radiant heat bursts with power beyond a simple beam.
An advanced Yang art for both offense and defense.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.sifang_ji:
Raise walls of Qi on four sides and form a little world.
Seal the space against passage from within or without.
An enclosure for trapping foes or securing escape.
Bind blood and Qi with spiritual inscriptions.
Lock the enemy's energy and hold the body still.
A decisive control art in a cultivator's duel.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.duanliu_k:
Cut the course of incoming Qi with a barrier in the void.
Turn aside both physical blows and hostile spells.
A subtle spatial defense that ordinary arts cannot break.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zhenshan_:
A palm descends with the weight of a mountain.
Its vast force shakes rock and sweeps the field.
A mighty bodily art that splits the hills in one strike.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.liuguang_:
Shape Qi into a thousand swords that fly like meteors.
Their shadows weave a rain of blades around your foe.
A Golden Core sword art with scarcely a gap to escape.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.dongtian_:
Draw Qi from a hidden world beyond this space.
Borrow its pure essence for a brief rise in power.
A costly secret art to use with care.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.suigui_xi:
Draw fragments from the stars and turn them into falling stones.
They crash through the sky and split the earth below.
A celestial assault with irresistible weight.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinhuo_xi:
A formless ember burns the soul and its thoughts.
It leaves the flesh untouched and scorches the Dao heart.
A cruel and elusive supreme fire art.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shixu_chi:
Turn the streams of time and slow the world around you.
All things falter while you move freely.
A supreme Golden Core art touching space and time.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.weiya.des:
Spread spiritual will into a boundless pressure.
Let surging Qi deny the enemy their own cultivation.
Feed the burst of power with your inner essence.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.zibao.des:
Ignite every reserve within your body in a single instant.
Golden Core or above; this art consumes your remaining life.
Select it and press the cast key three times within five seconds to confirm.
message.immortal_cultivation_mod.mysteri: [System] The ring is cold and dark. A faint spiritual consciousness seems to sleep within it.
[System] A pull comes from the ring as it slowly draws in your Qi.
[System] Faint ancient patterns emerge across the ring.
[System] A weak, heartbeat-like pulse comes from within the ring.
[System] An aged consciousness briefly stirs, but it still cannot speak.
[System] Insufficient Qi. The ring falls dormant again.
[System] The ring begins absorbing your Qi again.
[System] The seal within the ring shatters, awakening a consciousness that has slept for ages.
[System] The elder within the ring has awakened. Current Ring Power: %s / %s.
dialogue.immortal_cultivation_mod.myster: Ring Elder: Cough... at last, this old man can breathe again.
Ring Elder: Boy, I merely borrowed a thousand Qi. There is no need to look so pained.
Ring Elder: That Qi only broke the seal. My soul is still no more than a fading wisp.
Ring Elder: I will reside in this ring for now. Wear it, and I can sense the outside world.
Ring Elder: If you are willing to listen, I may offer a few pointers along the way.
Ring Elder: But understand this: not even an immortal can save one determined to die.
Ring Elder: Hm... I can finally see you. Average talent, but a remarkably stubborn life.
Ring Elder: Keep the ring secure. We are not master and disciple, but our fates are tied for now.
Ring Elder: Take me outside. I would see how many years have passed in this world.
Ring Elder: What trouble are you planning to find this time?
Ring Elder: So you finally remembered I was still in here.
Ring Elder: Your aura is steadier than before. Your cultivation was not entirely wasted.
Ring Elder: Wear it securely. Do not fling me away halfway through a fight.
Ring Elder: Judging by your expression, today will not be peaceful.
Ring Elder: Very well. What do you want this old man to examine now?
Ring Elder: You finally remembered me? I thought you meant to bury me at the bottom of a chest.
Ring Elder: Your cultivation barely grew, yet you gathered an impressive heap of clutter.
Ring Elder: You placed me among that scrap metal without the slightest shame.
Ring Elder: On and off already? With such an unsettled heart, how will you cultivate?
Ring Elder: Done with me already? How practical of you.
Ring Elder: Do not stuff me in with that pile of junk.
Ring Elder: Call when there is trouble. Better yet, avoid the trouble.
Ring Elder: Only one thread of my true spirit remains. Do not expect me to stop a death calamity soon.
Ring Elder: My consciousness has barely stabilized. At least I will not fall asleep halfway through a sentence.
Ring Elder: My soul is somewhat steadier. It seems this ring can still nourish the spirit by itself.
Ring Elder: Half my Ring Power has returned. In a true death calamity, I may be able to pull you free.
Ring Elder: A little more recovery, and I can perform a true spatial transference.
Ring Elder: Ring Power is full. Remember, this is not permission to throw your life away.
Ring Elder: Ring Power is nearly exhausted. Do not force yourself into another desperate situation.
Ring Elder: My soul has not recovered. If this happens again, I can only watch you face it alone.
Ring Elder: That cost me dearly. Behave yourself for a while.
Ring Elder: Only the final wisp of my true spirit remains. Another death calamity is beyond me.
Ring Elder: Enough Ring Power has returned for one transference. I hope you will not need it.
Ring Elder: Slow your breathing. Guide Qi into your meridians; do not drag it by force.
Ring Elder: Calm the mind before calming the Qi. Sitting longer will not help while you remain this restless.
Ring Elder: Once Qi enters the body, let your meridians adjust before circulating it.
Ring Elder: Breathing cultivation values a long, steady flow, not how much you seize at once.
Ring Elder: Your Qi sea is nearly full. Complete one circulation, then finish.
Ring Elder: You have enough Qi. Forcing in more will only damage your meridians.
Ring Elder: Cultivation is not stuffing your Qi sea. Mastering intake and release is the true skill.
Ring Elder: Your aura has reached the threshold. Steady your mind before breaking through.
Ring Elder: Your Qi is favorable today, but your foundation will decide whether you advance.
Ring Elder: Meridians, Qi sea, and mind: neglect any one and you will fail. Check them first.
Ring Elder: Your foundation is shallow and unstable. Breaking through now is asking for pain.
Ring Elder: Your vitality has not recovered. Forcing a breakthrough will leave hidden injuries.
Ring Elder: Your mind is in disorder. Today is not the day to break through.
Ring Elder: You lack Qi. Do you intend to blow the realm barrier open with one breath?
Ring Elder: One failure means little. Losing your composure would be the true defeat.
Ring Elder: Gather the scattered Qi again. No one walks the cultivation path without stumbling.
Ring Elder: You rushed. A breakthrough is not a door you can batter down with brute force.
Ring Elder: Stabilize your meridians before considering another attempt.
Ring Elder: Stop. Keep forcing it and your meridians will break before the realm barrier does.
Ring Elder: Your aura is somewhat denser. It is only a minor advance, so do not grow conceited.
Ring Elder: Your meridians have widened. Consolidate this stage instead of rushing onward.
Ring Elder: Acceptable. At least this advance left no obvious hidden damage.
Ring Elder: Your cultivation has improved. Take these materials and stabilize your realm.
Ring Elder: At last, Qi has entered your body. Only now have you truly touched the threshold of cultivation.
Ring Elder: Your Dao foundation is established. You have finally taken your first firm step upon the Great Dao.
Ring Elder: Your Golden Core is formed, gathering all Qi into one nucleus. Seek stability, not merely size.
Ring Elder: Your Nascent Soul has taken form and your spirit has an anchor. Now you may hear a few old stories.
Ring Elder: Another gate of the Great Dao has opened. The higher you climb, the deeper a single misstep becomes.
Ring Elder: You broke through behind my back? Not disgraceful, at least. I will not withhold your reward.
Ring Elder: Observe how the Qi circulates before memorizing the incantation.
Ring Elder: A spell is not a set of gestures. Miss the Qi path by an inch and the result strays a thousand miles.
Ring Elder: Clear away stray thoughts. You must remember the Qi pattern, not the words.
Ring Elder: Watch closely. I will demonstrate only once.
Ring Elder: You remembered the motion but not the Qi. Again.
Ring Elder: Your Qi went astray. Had this been real, you would have injured yourself.
Ring Elder: Your heart rushed, your hands rushed, and your mind failed to follow.
Ring Elder: You memorized the incantation nicely, yet understood none of it.
Ring Elder: Barely an introduction. Temper it through real combat now.
Ring Elder: You remember the Qi path, but mastery remains far away.
Ring Elder: Acceptable. At least you did not blow yourself up.
Ring Elder: The spell is learned. How much power it reveals is now your concern.
Ring Elder: That technique flowed more smoothly than before.
Ring Elder: You wasted less Qi. You are finally beginning to understand the technique.
Ring Elder: Good. It is beginning to show genuine refinement.
Ring Elder: The form is familiar now. Next, learn when it should be used.
Ring Elder: Come. Let me see whether that thousand Qi was worth spending on you.
Ring Elder: Keep your heart steady and watch the opponent's movements.
Ring Elder: Do not rush. Probe first, then find an opening.
Ring Elder: Guard your vitals and mind your path of retreat.
Ring Elder: This battle may be easy, but the careless usually die first.
Ring Elder: That aura stands a full realm above yours. Leave if you can; this is no time for pride.
Ring Elder: You cannot defeat this foe yet. Every moment you remain closes another path to survival.
Ring Elder: Forget overcoming strength with courage. This gap is beyond bravery.
Ring Elder: Remember this aura. Retreat today, and return to settle the debt later.
Ring Elder: The foe is somewhat stronger, but not unbeatable. Do not surrender the tempo.
Ring Elder: This battle is dangerous. Reserve enough Qi to escape.
Ring Elder: You gain nothing head-on. Force the opponent to reveal an opening.
Ring Elder: If you need advice against this, return to breathing exercises.
Ring Elder: Do not waste Qi. End it in one move.
Ring Elder: Bullying the weak proves nothing. Finish quickly.
Ring Elder: Careful. That aura is wrong. Do not meet its first strike directly.
Ring Elder: Its full power has yet to emerge. Observe first.
Ring Elder: This is no common enemy. Prepare every means of preserving your life.
Ring Elder: Its baleful aura is immense. Many lives must have ended beneath its hands.
Ring Elder: Your blood and Qi are in chaos. Create distance now!
Ring Elder: Those wounds are serious. Stop trading blows!
Ring Elder: Guard your heart meridian. A few more hits and you will not stand!
Ring Elder: Heal first! Victory is worth less than your life!
Ring Elder: One more heavy wound and I will drag you away by force.
Ring Elder: The Ring Power is ready. If death closes in, do not resist the transference.
Ring Elder: If you refuse to retreat, I will make the choice for you.
Ring Elder: The Ring Power is insufficient! I cannot take you away this time!
Ring Elder: I have not recovered. From here onward, you are on your own!
Ring Elder: There is no second escape. Use everything you have if you wish to live!
Ring Elder: Your Qi is nearly gone. Save enough to live and stop casting recklessly.
Ring Elder: Your Qi sea is empty. Not one wisp can be wasted now.
Ring Elder: Cast one more great spell and you will have nothing left for escape.
Ring Elder: The enemy's aura is scattering. Do not allow a breath of recovery.
Ring Elder: Now. End this battle.
Ring Elder: The foe is barely standing. Do not hesitate on the final strike.
Ring Elder: Why take that head-on? How many lives do you think you have?
Ring Elder: Dodge when you can. Must you test every blow with your bones?
Ring Elder: Do that again and I will wait until you finish flying before I speak.
Ring Elder: Your hands stayed steady and your Qi remained ordered. Acceptable.
Ring Elder: It was no easy victory, but at least you made no grave mistake.
Ring Elder: Remember that opening. Next time need not be so miserable.
Ring Elder: The weaker defeated the stronger. Good. Remember exactly why you won.
Ring Elder: This battle is worth remembering, but do not mistake fortune for strength.
Ring Elder: Acceptable. It seems I did not choose the wrong person.
Ring Elder: Today you surpassed the foe by half a step. One day, surpass them by a full realm.
Ring Elder: Retreat is no disgrace. Charging into certain death is true stupidity.
Ring Elder: Keep your life, and there can be another battle.
Ring Elder: Remember that aura. Return for the reckoning when you are stronger.
Ring Elder: The same technique struck you three times. Are you fighting or helping the foe practice?
Ring Elder: This technique wounds your foundation. Be certain you understand the price.
Ring Elder: Forbidden arts are not named so merely to sound impressive.
Ring Elder: Once begun, do not regret it. No one else can bear the backlash for you.
Ring Elder: Do not move! Guard your heart meridian. I am taking you away!
Ring Elder: Your life matters more than your pride. Go!
Ring Elder: Close your eyes! I will tear open a path through this calamity!
Ring Elder: Preserve your life, and there will still be a tomorrow!
Ring Elder: Do not resist the transference. Withdraw your Qi at once!
Ring Elder: You owe me for this one!
Ring Elder: If you can breathe, heal yourself now. This place is only temporarily safe.
Ring Elder: That escape cost dearly. Do not rush out to die again.
Ring Elder: Your life is saved. Now consider exactly what you did wrong.
Ring Elder: Remember who dragged you back from death's gate today.
Ring Elder: Check your surroundings. I can promise open ground, not perfect safety.
Ring Elder: Do not hurry back. Turning around now merely lets the enemy kill you twice.
Ring Elder: One life. Owe it to me for now; I will collect someday.
Ring Elder: This is the %sth time I have saved you. Bring your brain when you leave next time.
Ring Elder: At least I did not send you into lava. Consider yourself fortunate.
Ring Elder: The ground is reasonably level. Your fortune is not entirely exhausted.
Ring Elder: A random transference across five thousand blocks, yet you landed safely. Thank the heavens.
Ring Elder: You just recovered your life and already returned? Do you truly fear nothing?
Ring Elder: I sent you away, not around the corner so you could charge back in.
Ring Elder: At least heal your wounds before going back.
Ring Elder: Space is sealed here. The transference cannot activate!
Ring Elder: Someone has fixed the surrounding laws in place. Break the seal if you want to live!
Ring Elder: Space will not tear open. You must face this calamity directly!
Ring Elder: Qi is denser here than outside. Cultivation will proceed much faster.
Ring Elder: Slow down and sense carefully. The Qi flow here is unusual.
Ring Elder: This place suits cultivation, but dense Qi tends to attract other cultivators.
Ring Elder: There is a spirit vein below. Remember this place and say nothing for now.
Ring Elder: This Qi did not gather without cause. A spirit vein likely lies beneath us.
Ring Elder: Good fortune. Use this place well, but do not drain it dry.
Ring Elder: The baleful Yin is heavy. Guard your mind, and do not turn around no matter what you hear.
Ring Elder: Grudge Qi has gathered here for ages. Many must have died in this place.
Ring Elder: Conceal your aura. The things here may hunt without eyes.
Ring Elder: Thunder intent is flourishing. If you cultivate lightning arts, now is the time to comprehend it.
Ring Elder: Heavenly lightning is pure Yang and terribly fierce. Stay low unless you wish to test it yourself.
Ring Elder: To hear thunder is not to hear sound, but to grasp its instant of destruction.
Ring Elder: Dawn's violet Qi is rising. Cultivate now, or wait until tomorrow.
Ring Elder: At the day's beginning, the Qi of heaven and earth is at its clearest.
Ring Elder: Dawn sunlight is weak but pure, ideal for nourishing meridians.
Ring Elder: The deep night is still, perfect for reviewing today's cultivation.
Ring Elder: Moonlight is Yin. Related methods may achieve twice the result now.
Ring Elder: Darkness is not frightening. Not knowing what hides within it is.
Ring Elder: This world's laws differ from outside. Your spells may not retain their usual power.
Ring Elder: Space is turbulent here. Do not rely entirely on transference arts.
Ring Elder: The Qi of this world is unfamiliar. Adapt before you act.
Ring Elder: Your storage is nearly full again. You are a cultivator, not a scavenger.
Ring Elder: Are you saving that useless clutter as an inheritance?
Ring Elder: If you cannot organize a storage pouch, how will you manage a cave dwelling?
Ring Elder: Is standing idle cultivation now? The roadside stones should have ascended long ago.
Ring Elder: If you have nothing to do, circulate one complete cycle.
Ring Elder: I slept for years and still wasted less time than you.
Ring Elder: What has captured your thoughts so completely? Have you finally begun reflecting?
Ring Elder: Taking an innocent life without cause will only cloud your Dao heart.
Ring Elder: Killing is easy. Bearing the karma is not.
Ring Elder: If that person did not deserve death, today's blow has planted disaster for you.
Ring Elder: The greatest cultivation mistake is seeing only realm and ignoring foundation.
Ring Elder: Learning countless spells is useless if you cannot choose among them.
Ring Elder: Against a true expert, find your retreat before reaching for your killing move.
Ring Elder: Qi can recover. You have only one life.
Ring Elder: Those who live longest are rarely the strongest, but usually the ones who err least.
Ring Elder: Stop staring at the ring. There is no cultivation manual written on my face.
Ring Elder: Why do you insist on walking against every wall?
Ring Elder: In my day... never mind. At your realm, knowing too much would do no good.
Ring Elder: No power is without a price. When someone claims otherwise, the price simply has not appeared yet.
Ring Elder: Cultivation decides how far you can walk. Character decides where you finally arrive.
Ring Elder: Ignore me if you wish, but do not complain when the beating begins.
Ring Elder: Take the spell %s and these %s. Neither your techniques nor your foundation may fall behind.
Ring Elder: Your realm is established, so as promised I will teach you %s.
Ring Elder: This technique suits your current realm. How much you learn depends on your comprehension.
Ring Elder: The spell %s suits your present realm. Take it and comprehend it carefully.
Ring Elder: I will demonstrate only once. If you miss it, ponder it yourself.
Ring Elder: Used well, this is a killing move. Used poorly, it becomes your death warrant.
Ring Elder: Do not hoard techniques. Take these %s and strengthen your foundation first.
Ring Elder: These suit your current realm. Use them sparingly.
Ring Elder: Take them. Stop rummaging everywhere for scraps of low-grade material.
Ring Elder: Advancing too quickly is not always good. Use these materials to nourish your meridians.
Ring Elder: You already know that spell. I will replace it with materials better suited to you.
Ring Elder: You have learned every spell I can teach at this realm. Take additional cultivation resources instead.
Ring Elder: Clear your storage first. A proper cultivator should not pack like a wandering peddler.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.mist: Mist-Locked Qingxi Village: Qinghe leads you into a village trapped in one repeating day. The fox demon Feiyue and formation master He Xuan each claim the other created the dream array.
Expose He Xuan and shatter the array

The shattered core lets the villagers wake to a new day and Feiyue learn the truth about her cub. Qinghe's spirit fades into the fresh daylight. Before leaving she looks back at the village road, no longer bound to keep that same morning.
Aid Feiyue's revenge
Feiyue's fire consumes the dream and village together. She remembers your help while orthodox cultivators record your involvement in the destruction.
Trade the village for the Hundred-Thought Pearl
He Xuan hands you the emotion-filled pearl at the village's expense. Its whispers bring insight while contaminating your heart with others' suffering.
Reverse the dream-mist array
He Xuan enters his own loop while Qinghe becomes the land spirit guarding Qingxi. This morning is no longer repeated.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.star: Starfall Sinkhole: a lightless star opens a vast pit filled with inverted gravity, altered miners, and an unfinished host for powers from beyond this world.
Destroy the wreckage and seal the pit
Destroying the wreck lets the survivors return home while others resent the loss of an opportunity they believe cannot return.
Fuse with the unbound sequence core
The core accepts you and marks your soul with unfamiliar authority, bringing insight alongside an ongoing danger.
Let the cultivators research it together

The factions stabilize the collapsing rim and remove the injured before setting up a supervised research camp outside the danger area. The wreck remains under shared guard instead of prompting further bloodshed.
Reject every offered authority
Refusing every offered authority exposes parts of the archive that none of its willing hosts had been shown.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.bloo: Blood Moon Inn: every guest writes a name in the ledger, midnight repeats, and innkeeper Hongling needs one more soul to complete an old sacrifice.
Destroy the blood ledger
The ledger and contracts burn as daylight enters. The trapped guests leave without naming another sacrifice.
Pay with part of your lifespan
Your future years release the trapped souls and mother and daughter leave before sunrise. The years paid are genuinely lost.
Help Hongling complete the rite
The inn honors you after the ritual and the other guests' names disappear from its ledger forever.
Make every guest share the price

You restore Hongling's hidden eighth place to the account so the parties share the cost instead of surrendering another whole soul. When she finally stands among them as a debtor, the repeated night begins to break apart.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.name: Nameless Sword Tomb: countless ownerless blades surround a sword heart that tests whether inheritance, friendship, or one's own Dao matters most.
Accept the complete sword inheritance
You leave as the Nameless Sword Master with the full sword heart and every surviving will carried inside it.
Take only the sword intent
You refuse the sword heart's bond and leave with a single pure strand of intent while the tomb stays behind.
Share the sword heart with Su Zhao
You and Su Zhao share the inheritance and retain your separate paths afterward.
Challenge the nameless sword spirit
You defeat the spirit under your own name and form sword intent belonging to your own experience.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.drag: Dragonbone Wasteland: bone herders, a dragon-slaying guild, and the remnant dragon Ao Cang contest the marrow within an ancient skeleton.
Return the marrow and restore Ao Cang
The restored veins pulse and Ao Cang's soul briefly takes a visible shape to renew the land. When that manifestation ends the veins remain beneath the earth with the memory of your help.
Sell the marrow to the guild
You grow wealthy as the merchants dismantle the remains. Once the last shipment leaves the wasteland's spiritual vitality is exhausted.
Lead the bone herders to a new home
The Boneherd people abandon the contested remains and add your name to their migration songs, preserving their community rather than their old home.
Release the dragon from life and death
Ao Cang's will joins the awakened veins freely instead of remaining trapped as a soul waiting for resurrection.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reve: Reverse-Flow River: a faceless ferryman demands a cherished memory as fare while time-spirit fish carry lost years against the current.
Release the time-spirit fish
Releasing the fish lets the river run forward and returns the stolen memories as dreams to those waiting on the banks.
Exchange lifespan for the lost child
The woman recovers her child at the cost of several years from your future lifespan.
Steal memories from the river to cultivate
Other lives bring strength and understanding into your mind along with grief you cannot separate from the useful memories.
Return each memory to its true regret
Repairing the river does not erase loss but lets the boatman remember his own face at last.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.hund: Plague in Hundred-Herb Valley: a spreading illness, scarce medicine, and a merchant's concealed experiments force the valley toward judgment.
Treat the sick without distinction

The remedy is distributed according to need rather than status or payment, and the healers begin treating everyone. You submit the available trial records for examination. Both recovery and accountability still require work.
Reserve the cure for those who can pay
Those who can pay survive and you grow wealthy while the abandoned dead remain a stain on the remedy's use.
Burn the infected valley
The fire halts the plague at the cost of lives, fields and irreplaceable herbs without consoling everyone who survives outside.
Create a cure that renews the valley
The new medicine helps patients and clears poison from the soil. The valley begins restoring its fields and raising seedlings. Stripped herbs still have to grow back through new cultivation.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Black Mountain Ghost Market: every bargain is paid with blood, lifespan, secrets, or a true name, and some contracts outlive their makers.
Redeem a stolen true name
The lawful redemption restores the forgotten souls' names and identities and the market must recognize it.
Sell your name for ghost-market wealth
You leave wealthy and nameless while familiar faces struggle to remember you as more than a stranger.
Break the market's soul contracts
The contracts release the souls across Black Mountain while the market's enforcers turn their pursuit towards you.
Bind both owners of the same true name
The market finally recognizes the reconciled lives under one name despite previously declaring their coexistence impossible.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.heav: Heavenly Secret Illusion City: the city offers the perfect life you never lived, while its tower stores countless unrealized destinies.
Wake and leave the perfect life
You return to your imperfect life remembering the temptation with a steadier heart that no longer needs the dream to live for you.
Remain as lord of the illusion city
The city fulfills your wishes and closes behind you as its new master.
Release every unrealized life
The released lives enter reality as dreams and inspiration alongside dangerous shifts of fate affecting people beyond the city.
Bring one illusion-born resident home
The person born in illusion crosses the gate into a future no longer dependent on somebody else's imagining.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.nort: Northern Snow Pass: the wall is failing, civilians crowd frozen streets, and the snow-beast king offers peace for the heart beneath the city.
Hold the pass for three days
The defenders survive three bloody nights and hold the repaired walls, calling your name as the cost is counted.
Escort the civilians south
The city falls but its evacuated people survive the snow and begin rebuilding beyond the northern mountains.
Negotiate a pact with the snow-beast king
A difficult treaty establishes boundaries and addresses the core and broken agreement before another massacre can begin.
Let soldiers and civilians decide together
The people share the cost and authority rather than letting one hero claim their collective survival.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.esco: Escort Elder Danxia: the elder carries a coveted pill formula while a poisoned village and pursuing enemies threaten the ordered route.
Obey the order and keep moving
You deliver Danxia and the formula on time and receive completion credit without resolving what you saw along the road.
Stop to treat the poisoned village

Stopping to help makes the escort late for its agreed delivery, but the villagers receive treatment in time to pass the worst danger. When you leave, they see you off and ask for news of follow-up medicine.
Expose the secret hidden in the pill chests
Exposing the experiments unsettles the sect and explains the attacks previously dismissed as cargo raids.
Publish the formula for common healers
The new method reaches mortal healers beyond sect walls and changes medicine without requiring victims in the chests.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Blackstone Mine Disappearances: miners vanish below, production collapses, and something beneath the ore remembers an older claim to the mountain.
Slay the mine spirit and restore production
The mine reopens after the battle while the mountain's spiritual vitality gradually weakens despite renewed output.
Negotiate a ten-year mining pact

The sect returns the stolen heart crystal. The spirit releases the miners still alive in its chambers, then agrees to ten years of limited extraction. Output falls, but it no longer depends on disappearances.
Reveal the sect's concealed mining crime
The accounts bring down elders and secure years of overdue compensation for surviving miners.
Help the miners form their own sect
The miners establish a small earth-path sect to guard the vein rather than continue being consumed by it.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reco: Recover the Defecting Disciple: Gu Changfeng fled with the Scarlet Yang Manual, but the sect's account of murder and theft contains dangerous gaps.
Execute the defector and recover the manual
You carry out the execution and return with the bloodied slip while the sect records recovery of the manual.
Help Gu Changfeng disappear

You do not surrender Gu. You help the siblings evade pursuit and place his sister with a healer willing to keep their whereabouts private. Gu takes another name; her damaged meridians still need continuing care.
Expose the purge behind the order
The purge evidence splits the sect and reopens several condemned disciples' cases. It does not yet establish everyone's innocence.
Bring the true witness before the sect
The sister's testimony forces a public hearing instead of secret execution and brings responsibility into view.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.sect: Undercurrents at the Sect Tournament: a favored disciple's meridians are destroyed before the matches, and the culprit hides behind the sect's honor.
Reveal the sabotage and demand fair matches
The tournament restarts under supervision and real ability can finally decide the result.
Protect the sect's reputation
The scandal is suppressed and the tournament continues with its public dignity intact while witnesses remember what was hidden.
Choose a champion from the shadows
Your candidate wins while informed disciples remember how the result was manufactured and who arranged it.
Suspend the title and reform the tournament
The finalists withdraw together and the sect accepts reform instead of forcing a champion out of the corrupted tournament.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.lin_: Suppress the Lin Clan Rebellion: the sect demands overdue tribute, while evidence suggests the alleged rebellion conceals a larger enemy.
The city submits after heavy casualties and the sect praises your ruthlessness while residents bury their dead.
The new agreement replaces impossible demands with affordable duties and restores peace under reviewable terms.
The Lin clan gains independence and remembers your risk in supporting its freedom.
Unite both sides against their common enemy
The evidence exposes the demonic instigator and former enemies form a fragile alliance to pursue the same culprit.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.guar: Guard the Herb Garden for Seven Days: a Nine-Revolution Spirit Ginseng nears maturity while thieves, beasts, and a desperate fox mother gather nearby.
Guard the ginseng without compromise
The intact mature ginseng is delivered and the sect records the successful seven-day watch.
Use part of the medicine to save the fox cub
The shared medicinal power saves the cub and its mother leaves a blessing along the garden paths.
Steal the mature spirit ginseng
You flee with the priceless ginseng and the sect begins its lasting pursuit.
Refine the ginseng's offered side roots into three shared pills

With the ginseng's and sect's agreement, its three side roots become three pills: one for the cub, one for the sect and one for you. The main root remains to grow for another year, preserving the time promised to it.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.seal: Seal the Ancient Demon Cave: whispers beneath the forbidden ground reveal that the imprisoned demon may be a severed part of the sect founder.
Repair the seal exactly as ordered
The cave falls silent under the restored seal and the sect praises obedience while its oldest lie stays buried.
Destroy the imprisoned evil thought
Destroying the corrupted remnant releases memories that leave lasting wounds in your mind.
Release the demon from the cave
The broken seal releases a powerful enemy and grants you a share of forbidden knowledge with the consequences of freeing it.
Reunite the founder with the severed remnant

The halves reunite as a complete manifestation within the array, recounting the sect's origin and the founder's crimes. The account begins an inquiry and reform. What returns is the whole memory, not a resurrected physical body.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.miss: Find the Missing Mountain Patrol: seven disciples are trapped in a repeating forest formation, but evidence suggests an eighth traveler entered with them.
Lead all seven disciples out together
Outside the forest you count all seven again and find nobody left behind in the dusk.
Save the nearest survivor before the array shifts
You bring one disciple out before the route closes while the fate of the remaining six stays unknown.
Cut through the looping formation by force
Force tears open the way and ends the loop while injuring several disciples during the escape.
Find the identity of the eighth body

You identify the eighth body as the builder's infiltrator. The formation overlaid a visitor's clothing and handwriting to make it resemble that visitor's future self. Removing the disguise exposes calibration marks linking the infiltrator to the builder.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.oute: Outer Disciples' Lost Souls: seventeen disciples lie unconscious while a concealed formation burns their dreams as fuel for the sect.
Return all seventeen souls
All seventeen wake and the hidden draining system is dismantled so sleep no longer costs another memory.
Preserve one willing dream as the new guardian

One informed volunteer among the seventeen remains asleep to guard the dream while the other sixteen awaken. The new array no longer drains others' souls, but the volunteer's care becomes a continuing sect duty.
Replace the disciples with another source
The disciples wake while new victims fuel the restored array and the cruel mechanism continues under another name.
Reveal the formation to every disciple
The informed sect voluntarily shares tiny contributions of awareness and replaces the secret sacrifice system.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.thre: Three-Sect Covenant: assassination, a political marriage, and forged spell traces threaten to turn alliance talks into open war.
The evidence exposes the common enemy and the three sects remember your role in securing their alliance.
The sects sign under force and secretly wait for the threat to weaken before reconsidering the pact.
Secure control of the alliance for your sect
Your sect secures the alliance's power and resources while the other two begin organizing resistance in secret.
A joint council replaces marriage guarantees and private deals with shared voting across the three sects.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.stor: You follow the chosen lead while leaving the other questions open for later investigation.
The discovery gives you something concrete to compare with your earlier conclusions.
You reach the final stage following your decision, with the outcome still dependent on what you actually preserved.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.mist: On the road past Qingxi you twice return to the same stone in the fog. A girl calling herself Qinghe waits at the village entrance. She says the village wakes to the same morning every day. “I've tried taking people out, but they always come back.” She looks towards the hidden rooftops. “Will you help me find what's keeping us here?”
Follow Qinghe
Inspect Array
Test Qinghe
Even the spilled washbasin repeats on schedule and living names fill old gravestones. As sleepers head for the ruined shrine Qinghe says, “This happens every night.”
Question Villagers
Follow Midnight
The pale pearl sustains the dream fog but the channels reveal someone steering the fox's grief and collecting the village's emotions.
Trace Caster
Secure the array's center and trace its core
Qinghe's spirit describes her death eighteen years ago. “I know I'm dead but they're still in there. I can't let myself fall asleep with them.”
Trust Qinghe
Bind Qinghe

At Fox Hill you identify the caster He Xuan, who killed the fox Feiyue's cub and blamed the villagers to use her grief in refining the Hundred-Thought Pearl. After hearing the evidence, Feiyue faces him. “How long did you mean to let me hate them?”
Expose Hexuan
Bargain Hexuan
Dream streets overlap the waking village. He Xuan wants the pearl and Feiyue wants revenge while Qinghe begs you not to sacrifice the villagers with him.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.star: A black star has fallen into a mining district and opened a deep sinkhole. You arrive at a sect cordon where miners search for missing coworkers and black-robed strangers watch the descent. A boy catches your sleeve. Something below keeps calling to him, he says, even when he covers his ears.
Enter Openly
Sneak Inside
Follow Mad Youth

Gravity fluctuates in the first workings. Several injured miners hang upside down near the ceiling, held by ropes their companions are gripping. Limbs and shadows are changing. The miners ask you to get them to safety before descending farther.
Rescue Miners
Study Mutation
Seamless metal holds five lights governing killing, wealth, fortune, time and tasks. Approaching contenders leave little time to study it alone.
Hide Fragments
Warn Factions
Another voice interrupts the boy. “It says it's almost inside.” You can sever the connection or accept a lesser mark to investigate how hosts are chosen.
Free Host
Accept Mark

An earlier failed host, distinct from the boy you met, guards the core and copies techniques you reveal in an attempt to overwrite your soul. A damaged contract nearby states that consenting hosts receive only a description of powers; those refusing may examine the full risk archive.
Stabilize Core
Claim Core
The sinkhole collapses as the factions demand the core. Survivors, evidence and marks retained on your route determine which options remain possible.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.bloo: A mountain storm sends you looking for shelter at an inn lit by red lanterns. The keeper Hongling offers the guest book with her hand covering its final page. “Use the front for now. Leave the rest until daylight.” The room is full, but none of the guests looks up when you enter.
Sign True Name
Use False Name
Inspect Inn
