There are seven registered guests at the banquet, including you. Told one soul must remain before the others may leave, they begin accusing each other. You notice an additional place setting nobody is using.
Defend Guest
Offer Criminal
Repeated names on the last page show sacrifices never ended the blood night. One entry appears written by a future you.
Read Last Page
Steal Ledger

In the kitchen you find a servant unable to speak. Her memory fragments match the old records: she is the remnant of Hongling's daughter. Hongling arrives asking whether you can restore her, while the remnant refuses to approach the ritual array.
Restore Daughter
Bind Daughter

The ledger opens to an old page and the wall's concealment fades, revealing a burial pit. Hongling still demands a whole soul, but the page identifies the eighth place as her own. She has been hiding her debt among the guests' accounts.
Break Sacrifice Rule
Prepare the ledger's final sacrifice
The inn splits across its repeated nights as the guests search for exits. You must decide who pays and whether the cycle can actually end.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.name: Sword calls lead you into a valley of weathered tablets recording earlier cultivators' failures. Most names have been worn away. Su Zhao, another visitor seeking an inheritance, asks whether you want to enter together. “If there's anything inside, we can discuss shares when we find it.” He looks again at names absent from the sect histories.
Try to answer the swords' call
Read Sword Marks
Follow Su Zhao
Three gates test hunger for victory, fear of striking and certainty of invincibility. Su Zhao lowers her blade. “Perhaps we don't have to cut every door open.”
Cut Three Gates
Yield To Intent
The names survive on broken tablets after orthodox histories erased their failed owners. Su Zhao slows her reading and stops urging you onward.
Restore Epitaph
Take Sword Formula
Su Zhao admits her family's order to claim the inheritance alone. “I should have told you. Do we continue together or settle who goes first?”
Trust Suzhao
Duel Suzhao

The nameless spirit opens the tomb's register and offers to add your name with command of its swords. Asked about the bound sword intent, it points to the inscriptions holding it. Erasing those marks would let it disperse. Su Zhao is waiting too, and your earlier agreements still matter to the inheritance.
Accept Sword Name
Identify the inscriptions binding the sword intent
As the swords rise Su Zhao waits beside you. Inheritance, sharing, refusal and challenge depend on what your route has made possible.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.drag: Dragon bones exposed by a sandstorm block the trade road, and tremors threaten the nearby oasis. When you arrive, several travelers have collapsed beside the trail while bone merchants bargain over the remains. Residents beg them to stop dismantling the skeleton. Each removed piece brings a stronger tremor underfoot.
Save Caravan
Follow Merchants
Trace Dragon Cry
The homes stand over the dragon's final heart vein. A resident refuses to pack. “We've lived here for generations. Tell us where we'd go.”
Defend Oasis
Evacuate Oasis
Each bone for sale retains a memory while buyers ask only the price. You can profit from the trade or expose what is being sold.
Sell Dragonbone
Expose Merchants

The fragmented soul names itself Ao Cang and recognizes its lost memories in the bones the merchants took. The veins beneath the wasteland once belonged to its body; their last intact stretch now sustains the oasis. It asks you to recover what was taken and hear its history before deciding whether to remove that final vein.
Recover and return the memories in the stolen bones
Bind Dragon Soul
The remains breathe sand and merchants urge faster extraction while residents watch the stirring earth for your decision on restoring or stripping the dragon.
Prepare a way to restore the dragon vein
Mark the remains for extraction
The wasteland rises with the dragon's breath. Residents, traders and the soul wait for an answer about the future of the same land.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reve: At the crossing you find boats drifting uphill with the water. The boatman says memories and years reverse here too. A woman on the bank watches the river and begs him to look once more for the child she lost to it years ago. He does not answer her, turning instead to ask where you mean to go.
Board Boat
Follow Woman
Study Water

The boatman accepts memories as fare. “The water strips names from the living; the boat protects you. If you won't pay, you can follow the bank to the source.” Asked his name, he cannot remember it. He has taken so many memories that he has forgotten his own face.
Pay With Memory
Refuse Fare

The river shows the woman's lost child growing younger with the current. The boatman keeps her on shore: this is a past the river might alter, and the child has not returned. She recognizes a patch on the clothing and begs you to keep looking, even if only to learn what changing the drowning would cost.
Seek Child
Ask her to accept the child's death
The whirlpools hold discarded regrets. Returning the memories could repair old lives; keeping them offers insight accompanied by somebody else's suffering.
Return Memories
Keep Memories
At the source a spirit fish swims through possible histories. Releasing it restores time's course while taking it offers a way to alter a regret.
Clear a route for the spirit fish's release
Secure the fish and study how it changes the past
The water runs both ways as the banks fade. The people you protected and truths you established are what can anchor the final history.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.hund: Patients near Hundred-Herb Valley stop you to ask about medicine. The plants inside flourish, they say, while more people outside fall ill each day. Traders insist their stock is sound. A healer asks you to examine the patients and the discolored soil before deciding whom to believe.
Treat Sick
Search Herbs
Inspect Soil

The accompanying healer gives you medicine that can relieve symptoms. Patients begin describing the unpaid trials. Free distribution lets more people speak; charging high prices could fund research, but would exclude those without money.
Free Medicine
Sell Medicine
The useful herb grows on infected blood. Careful harvesting preserves the valley while stripping it would secure enough for the immediate treatment.
Harvest Sparingly
Strip Valley

In the underground medicine store you find a secret agreement covering manufactured illness, inflated prices and forbidden trials. Respected healers signed it too. Publishing it would implicate more than traders.
Expose Source
Hide Source

The earlier medicine only eased symptoms. The new antidote has not completed testing in a living body. You can volunteer for that risk or burn the infected plots within the quarantine area to slow the spread and gain time for patients outside.
Test On Self
Burn the infected plots within the quarantine area
The merchants block the valley as the sickest patients run out of time. Your medicines, evidence and treatment preparations determine what remains possible.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Paper offerings along the night road lead you into Black Mountain's market, where names, memories and years are for sale. You mean only to browse until you find your own name on a price tag. The stallholder says someone consigned it. He will have to consult his ledger to tell you who.
Follow Paper Money
Trace Stolen Name
Enter Future Stall
The broker wants your dearest memory for your name. The contract warns that without it even your achievements may be assigned to someone else.
Offer a memory as a deposit towards redeeming the name
Sell Memory
Thousands of names hang as lamp tags recalling forgotten people. You can release them or take the register and gain control over the market's contracts.
Identify how the stolen names can be released
Claim Name Ledger

The visitor claims to be you from one possible future and offers that route's victory for a present relationship. Pressed, it admits knowing only the path it lived. “If you choose differently, I don't know what follows either.” The contract remains unsigned.
Reject Future
Trade With Future
The owner explains the first stolen name binds the market. “Tear the contracts to free them or take the seal. A new owner inherits the debts too.”
Identify the master contract needed to release the souls
Take Market Seal
Unsettled names fade as dawn approaches. Redemption, sale, release and reconciling the conflicting lives remain decisions that cannot wait much longer.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.heav: A city missing from your map appears beside the road. Its residents call your name as though welcoming you home and say your family has been waiting. Inside is the life you once wished you had lived. The road behind you remains open while someone at the gate urges you to come in for dinner.
Enter City
Mark Exit
Speak Unborn

The faces and food resemble your memories, but nobody can answer questions about events outside. They have known only the person who lived here. Your original life has not been transported into the city. These residents have their own histories and wait to hear whether you will stay.
Accept Ideal Life
Reject Ideal Life
The walls feed on abandoned possibilities. Your marked exit preserves a way home while severing it could trap the inhabitants permanently.
Trace City Array
Examine what severing the exit would do
The unborn residents know what they are. “We'd like a chance to live.” Giving them reality would narrow somebody else's possible future.
Promise Real World
Deny Unborn
Before the seventh bell the city must open permanently or fold back into a dream. Residents return to ask about your promises.
Prepare to connect the city gate to reality
Prepare to fold the city back into a dream
The city disputes which version of you is real while the gate destabilizes. Your preserved route and earlier commitments determine who can leave.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.nort: The northern pass shelters refugees while snow beasts surround the roads. The garrison says its scout is still missing, but townspeople say he returned with an old treaty and was hidden away. Archers prepare on the walls, and nobody will explain what the treaty says.
Enter Pass
Scout Beasts
Find Scouts
There are too few hands to repair the wall and prepare evacuation together. The soldiers ask which matters first if the city cannot hold.
Repair Walls
Prepare Evacuation
The beast king demands the stolen heart core beneath the city. Negotiation exposes the defenses while an ambush could end any chance of agreement.
Parley Beast King
Prepare an ambush against the beast king
The scout proves the commander fabricated an attack to steal the core. Disclosure could split the garrison on the eve of battle.
Reveal Officer Lie
Hide Officer Lie
The final wave gathers and the defenders wait for your signal to hold or raise a truce flag before neither side can stop.
Lead Defense
Open Negotiation
Snow covers the battlefield without removing the soldiers, civilians or beasts. Your preparations determine whether defense, evacuation, treaty or shared rule can bring survival.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.esco: Your sect assigns you to escort Danxia and nine medicine chests to an allied sect. Villagers along the route seek help for leaked spiritual poison, but the captain urges the escort onward. A chest knocks and calls a disciple by name. All nine are listed as medicinal cargo.
Guard Carriage
Aid Poisoned Village
Inspect Elder Cargo
The masked attackers strike the chains. “My sister's still awake in that chest,” one calls. “Listen to her before you fight us.”
Hold Formation
Capture Attacker

Villagers collapse from leaked spiritual poison. The accompanying healer prepares temporary treatment from the emergency medicine bag, but Danxia still orders departure. A disciple suggests checking the sealed chests to establish what has been leaking.
Share Antidote
Question Villagers
The people inside have meridians altered into medicine and can still hear you. The formula is evidence and might support a method without living victims.
Copy Pill Formula
Confront Elder
Danxia admits the experiments and offers personal discipleship for silence. The receiving sect waits at the pass knowing what is inside the chests.
Check the delivery papers without handing over the chests yet
Publicize Formula
Both parties demand delivery at the final checkpoint. The people, antidote and evidence you preserved determine who can testify and what happens to the formula.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: The sect sends you to investigate disappearances at Blackstone Mine, but Steward Shi first asks when production can resume. Families refuse to leave the entrance and report singing below level seven each night. When you request the movement ledger, you find fresh scrape marks on its pages.
Audit Ledgers
Descend Seventh Layer
Organize Miners
The books expose forbidden extraction and elders' shares. Before you finish copying someone offers stones. “Some pages might be better left where they are.”
Copy Ledger
Accept Silence Money

The earth spirit has confined living miners in rock chambers with air holes. It answers your calls: “The vein is my blood. How long must I hold after the heart crystal was stolen?” It demands the crystal's return before discussing release and mining limits.
Hear Earth Spirit
Mine Earth Heart
Some miners demand armed resistance while others fear unemployment. “Could we have open accounts and know who takes the money?” one asks.
Arm Miners
Mediate Strike
As the guards arrive the earth heart wakes and passages close. Sealing level seven contains danger while returning below risks time to recover witnesses and accounts.
Seal dangerous side passages while keeping access to observe the core
Bring Truth Up
Guards, miners, elders and spirit face each other above the collapse. Your alliances determine whether quotas, accountability or violence remain possible.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reco: You are ordered to recover Gu Changfeng and the Chiyang manual, with authority to kill if he resists. On the trail you find that his supposed victims are alive with their cultivation sealed. They can still describe what happened. Another pursuit party approaches, using signals different from those in your orders.
Chase Directly
Visit Hometown
Shadow Other Hunters
Gu avoids lethal strikes and offers the jade slip. “Read it before deciding to arrest me.” It lists disciples rather than the claimed technique.
Wound Defector
Hear Defector
His sister's letters describe experiments burning lifespan. Protecting the family preserves witnesses while confiscating the letters could leave them unable to prove it.
Protect Family
Seize Letters
The second pursuit party destroys evidence under orders to execute surviving subjects. You can expose it or help silence them before Gu reaches the cave.
Expose Kill Order
Join Kill Order
Gu's sister survives in the cave with ruined meridians. He protects her while urging you to read the register as pursuers approach the entrance.
Take Testimony
Hold the siblings under the pursuit order pending a final decision
The besiegers demand surrender while those inside wait for your answer. Evidence, treatment and loyalties determine who can return alive to testify.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.sect: Before the sect tournament ends, a forbidden drug ruins the favorite's meridians. He insists he never chose to take it, while the stewards hurry the next match forward. From the waiting area you hear gamblers changing their bets and someone asking who delivered the injured disciple's last meal.
Enter Tournament
Inspect Wound
Follow Gambler
A steward offers payment for a deliberate loss to advance a chosen disciple. Your schedule has already been worked into somebody else's betting.
Fight Fair
Accept Fixed Match
The drug targets disciples about to expose corruption. Protecting the next target preserves a witness while following the assassin may reveal the buyer.
Save Target
Trace Assassin
The betting book connects merchants, stewards and elders. Keeping it offers blackmail while publication could stop the entire tournament.
Take Blackmail
Expose Betting Ring

A healer identifies a self-destruct seal in one finalist's weapon and a potentially fatal pill in the other, and immediately stops further circulation. The bribed referee still calls for the match while an assassin watches the witness. You must control the ring or halt the event.
Fight Final
Stop Final
The competitors step aside and the ring is cleared while the witness remains guarded. You must present the final evidence and terms for fair matches, concealment, or suspension and reform.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.lin_: You accompany a sect force sent to the Lin clan over concealed mining and withheld tribute. Refugees along the road speak instead of impossible taxes and missing children. An older report dates the envoy's death before his last recorded visit. The commander keeps urging the column onward.
The enforcement elder demands an attack before civilians leave. One last negotiation risks charges of betrayal while offering a way to trace the stolen mining revenue.
The heir accepts open tribute terms while radical elders seek independence through demonic help. Each side wants your support and control of the ancestral hall.

An accompanying steward acting for a demonic cultivator killed the envoy after he found false accounts, then used his seal for an impersonated visit—the source of the posthumous record. The weapon's mark matches secret correspondence showing a deliberate effort to provoke war and conceal the proceeds.
The sect prepares its assault while Lin radicals sacrifice civilians. Exposing the manipulator may be the only way to halt both sides in time.
The ancestral hall burns between armies awaiting orders. Evidence and alliances determine whether suppression, new terms or pursuit of the instigator ends the conflict.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.guar: You are assigned to guard the Nine-Turn Ginseng until it matures in seven days. On the first night an injured fox comes seeking medicine, and someone tampers with the garden defenses. While you inspect the marks, the ginseng quietly asks you not to wake the other guards.
Dress the cub's wounds and stabilize it
Inspect Sabotage
Guard Ginseng
The fox mother waits outside. “Give me my child. I don't want your ginseng.” Returning it offers an ally while keeping it as bait invites an ambush.
Reunite Foxes
Use Fox As Bait

A garden disciple says an elder plans to take the ginseng and blame the guards. He proposes weakening the outer wards at the fifth-day shift change, then stealing it amid the beasts when it matures on the seventh. “Better than keeping it safe for him and taking the blame.”
Arrest Traitor
Join Theft

The Nine-Turn Ginseng asks for one more year before harvest, enough to complete its transformation. You show it your orders. After studying them, it asks whether you will appeal on its behalf. Footsteps approach outside the garden; the people sent to collect it will need an answer too.
Promise One Year
Insist on guarding it until the ordered mature harvest
On the seventh day every faction moves as the beasts turn towards the village and injured guards, forcing a choice over the remaining help.
Divert some guards to protect villagers and the injured
Protect Ginseng

At dawn the fox mother waits with her cub, which still needs medicine. The ginseng offers three side roots for refining if its main root may remain for another year. The sect's agreement and the shares of medicine must be settled using what you have prepared.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.seal: The sect sends you to inspect the seals on a forbidden cave said to hold an ancient demon. As you note the first crack, a voice inside uses an old name for the founder and asks to be heard before you repair it. “Do your records say what happened after he left?”
Repair Seal
Answer Whisper
Read Founder Records
Four seals replay rise, slaughter, fear and division. One was forged later to contain the memory the sect most wants forgotten.
Replace Four Nails
Remove False Nail
Xuanzu says, “I came out of him rather than from outside.” The confined collection of the founder's crimes and desires offers forbidden knowledge for freedom.
Accept Demon Offer
Test Demon Memory

The records locate the founder's benevolent remnant in the main seal and the corrupted half below. Both came from one soul; neither is a living founder in a physical body. Losing either would damage its memories and the defenses sustained through it.
Reveal Founder Split
Hide Founder Split
The elder offers core teachings for silence and orders resealing while the founder's divided halves begin reaching towards each other.
Open a connection between the two remnants
Locate and restrain the corrupted core for destruction
The cave opens before the sect and your preserved memories can be heard. Resealing, destruction, release and reunion await the final decision.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.miss: A seven-person mountain patrol is overdue. Its last message says it has found its own bodies for the third time. Sent to search, you enter hills held in perpetual dusk. Distress signals come from different directions, and the approaching figures all wear the same patrol uniforms.
Follow Signal
Search Survivors
Inspect Repeated Body
The clearing resets with every approach. Rushing reaches a timeline quickly while circling reveals the formation learning your route.
Rush To Signal
Circle Signal
The injured disciple accuses the captain of murder and the captain calls him a spy. Questioning may expose implanted memory while delaying treatment.
Carry Survivor
Question Survivor

The formation has retained bodies from failed branches of the seven disciples' patrol. Their living counterparts are still calling for help. An eighth body wears equipment like yours and carries matching handwriting. Its identity remains uncertain. Burning these remains would weaken the loop, but destroy evidence with it.
Count Eighth Body
Burn the seven branch bodies while preserving the unidentified eighth

The trial lacks a normal exit, but a discarded calibration record gives a shutdown order in handwriting unlike the patrol's. As the branches collapse, you must gather the living or create a breach that can be held temporarily.
Gather the patrol near the exit in the recorded order
Breach the array's center and hold a temporary route
Versions of the patrol gather in the dusk calling identical names. The living people and letters you preserved determine the remaining routes out.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.oute: The sect asks you to investigate seventeen outer disciples who are losing their memories. They show no obvious wounds, but sleepwalk uphill together and increasingly fail to recognize familiar people. Their carers hand you the night records and ask you to find their destination before tonight.
Wake Disciple
Enter Shared Dream
Inspect Guard Array
Their bodies appear sound while the formation drains their souls. Protecting all bodies preserves return; using one disciple as a dream anchor would hurt that person.
Preserve Bodies
Use One As Anchor
The sect repeatedly falls in the shared dream as disciples sacrifice themselves to repair it. Returning the souls weakens defenses while guarding the dream steadies the route.
Guide the seventeen souls towards the return channel
Remain Dream Guard
The elder admits the array drains weaker disciples when stones run short. “That's how we've kept it running.” Exposure unsettles the sect and replacement fuel may mean new victims.
Publish Array Truth
Redirect Array

The seventeen souls fade as an enemy tests the defenses. The elder proposes captive spirit beasts as fuel, leaving another set of victims. You must secure the return channel or preserve full defenses before settling who bears the energy cost.
Secure the return channel for the seventeen souls first
Keep Array Power
Dream and barrier demand their final energy. Your preparation determines whether voluntary sharing across the sect can replace return, a dream keeper or other fuel.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.thre: You attend the three-sect talks as an envoy seeking resistance to demonic expansion. Public discussion concerns command and supplies; private bargaining concerns sword mines, medicinal valleys and marriage terms. The chair asks you to hear each party before deciding which agreement to take home.
Every concession shifts command. Delegates ask for balance while your own sect hints at the rewards of securing the leadership for itself.
The secret terms reveal all sides exploiting the pact. Publication forces honesty while retaining them lets you play competing offers against one another.
The disciple offered as a marriage guarantee asks whether refusal is allowed. Freeing them weakens the old arrangement while coercion buys stability with one life.
Forged sect techniques mask a demonic fourth party's attack. Before the delegates are all safe someone suggests letting a rival representative die.

Armed disciples guard separate parts of the hall while surviving delegates and the deputies taking over await the final evidence and terms. Any loss must be recorded in the agreement, not concealed by replacing a seat.
Reading the royal genealogy in Tianheng's capital, you find the eighth prince followed directly by the tenth. The keeper of the records warns you away from the missing name. A sealed palace court and the severed ninth vein beneath the city both have gaps in their records for the same year.
Search Missing Palace
Read Erased Genealogy
Enter Dragon Vein

An old attendant keeps the ninth place set according to an old ceremonial list and brings Ji Wuming from the lower city. The young man bears the royal dragon mark. “Do you want to help me find out, or hand me to the princes?”
Protect Prince
Use Prince

The records show that a prophecy led the emperor to erase the ninth prince's name rather than kill him. Sent to the lower city, he became Ji Wuming. These papers can establish his identity; destroying them would make it harder to prove.
Publish Ninth Name
Erase Last Name

The vein's keeper brings a young man with the dragon mark who calls himself Ji Wuming. The vein answers only to the ninth bloodline, and a repair rite lists him as its sacrifice. He asks, “Must I die to keep their throne stable?”
Free Dragon Vein
Examine the rite that would sacrifice Ji to repair the vein
Under the eclipse princes and rebels gather around the dragon's image with Ji among them. You can continue the succession or break the rule choosing its owner.
Reveal the ninth prince's identity and prepare his accession
Break Coronation
The dragon circles awaiting a name while Ji looks towards you. The evidence and your treatment of him determine which futures remain available.
Restore the Ninth Prince
Ji becomes emperor and reforms the capital using what he learned below. The city prospers while displaced nobles regard you as an enemy.
Sacrifice the Nameless Heir
Ji dies beneath the palace to stabilize the vein and the crown prince's rule, erased again with no chance to survive this time.
Rule Behind the Throne
Ji takes the throne under your control and your wealth grows while princes and noble families organize to remove you.
Send the Nameless Prince Away
With the last evidence burned Ji leaves freely while unsure whether to thank you for the throne he will never claim.
Return the Dragon Vein to All
The vein passes into the provinces and ends royal monopoly as more mortals awaken roots and a council replaces the old capital system.

While you walk through the floating Yunhai Market, the street begins to sink. Its main core is missing and the reserves can last only twelve double-hours. Thousands live in the market's lower decks, with a separate mortal city directly beneath. Merchants above rush to move goods while people in both places seek safety.
Repair Formation District
Evacuate Lower City
Enter Black Market

Pointing to the dwindling reserve stones, the master admits that the missing main core is a living heart. “The old circuit is quicker, once the heart is recovered. Temporary cores would need a different distribution of load.” The reserves keep draining as he speaks.
Restore Lift Array
Redirect Lift Array
Treasures fill the merchant airships while thousands below lack passage. “What about our children?” residents ask. Cutting the lower districts loose would shed weight at their expense.
Save All Districts
Cut Lower District
The missing core is the ancient cloud-kun's severed heart. After centuries of confinement rebinding it would let one faction control the floating city.
Recover the heart and negotiate its return to the cloud-kun
Bind True Core
The market's shadow reaches the roofs below during evacuation. You can spend the remaining core to rise or redirect the descent towards uninhabited land.
Hold the market temporarily while preparing to restore lift
Guide Market Down
In the last double-hour workers wait for the formation and the cloud-kun for freedom. Earlier rescue and engineering determine who can still be saved.
Raise the Cloud City
The rebound heart raises the market and earns you a rich reward while the cloud-kun's hatred continues to grow.
Guide the Market to Earth
The cloud-kun is freed and residents survive the controlled landing as workers gradually gain authority in the new ground city.
Build Upon Yun Kun
With the cloud-kun's consent residents rebuild on its back and travel the world while admitting only trusted merchants.
Seize the Entire Market
You take the core and the market's substantial income while rival merchants unite to overthrow their new owner.
Save All Within Twelve Hours
Temporary cores support the market while the vulnerable evacuate and the cloud-kun goes free. Merchants, workers and beast form a new alliance without captivity.

Jingyue's residents are checking every household for missing reflections. Earlier victims vanished seven days after losing theirs. You arrive under a full moon as a city running backwards in time appears beneath the lake. The council wants the lake sealed, but families block the doors and demand the missing be found first.
Follow Missing Reflection
Defend Surface City
Compare Two Histories

Your mirror counterpart remembers another history and finds you equally unfamiliar. He sets out the local household register and asks you to compare it with what you know. The residents have families and lives here and will not surrender their homes on the upper city's demand.
Recognize Reflections
Claim Mirror City
The surface council wants the lake gate sealed before more reflections arrive. Evacuating civilians preserves lives while allowing the histories to overlap longer.
Seal Lake Gate
Evacuate Surface
The moon mirror split the city during a disaster and both histories grew afterward. Choosing only one would erase the people who lived in the other.
Restore Both Histories
Choose One History
The failing mirror brings corresponding residents together. You can merge them into coexistence or shatter it and accept survival among both cities' remnants.
Connect the cities' boundaries in preparation for coexistence
Prepare the positions needed to shatter the moon mirror
Two moons shine over residents holding evidence of their identities. The people and histories you preserved determine which lives can continue.
Leave One Moon Above
Destroying the mirror city restores the missing and stabilizes the surface city while its alternative lives disappear.
Make the Reflection Real
The mirror city replaces the surface with familiar people whose memories, relationships and histories differ from those you knew.
Let Both Cities Coexist
Both populations survive the merger and confront their alternative lives in a stronger but unsettled city.
Shatter the Moon Mirror
The shattered mirror sinks districts from both cities and leaves survivors rebuilding amid water and unstable moonlit reality.
Stabilize Two Reflected Moons
The histories stabilize as paired cities with safe passage between them and your counterpart becomes an ally.

An invitation names you as a candidate for the Gu Mother's bridal rite, held once every twenty years. You go to Wangu Swamp for an explanation. Tribal elders say the rite suppresses an ancient plague. Behind a curtain, earlier brides ask you to stay and hear them before accepting the mark.
Accept Wedding Invitation
Investigate Gu Mother
Contact Tribes

The earlier brides show you their living bodies and linked minds, explaining how the Mother uses them to contain the plague. Disconnection threatens their shared memories; accepting the bridal mark would join you to them. They disagree about what to do, and voices behind the curtain continue arguing.
Free Former Brides
Become Bride
The Gu Mother admits taking a vessel every twenty years to suppress the ancient plague. “Who holds it back if you kill me?” Inheriting her brings another cost.
Identify a way to kill the Gu Mother
Seek the right to inherit the Gu Mother's role
The original pact shared the burden until powerful tribes imposed it on outsiders. Renegotiation requires real contributions while breaking it risks releasing the plague.
Renew Shared Pact
Break Old Pact

On the wedding night, the sealed chambers holding the vessels open together as the tribes prepare to burn the nest. The selected bride is brought before the array. You must protect people or contain the fire threatening to release the plague before deciding the final outcome.
Protect Bride
Protect Tribes
The unveiled gu body speaks with all its stored voices. Continuing the pact and allocating protection can no longer be left only to those offering other people.
Become the Twenty-Year Bride
You become the new vessel maintaining the pact as your identity gradually blends into the earlier brides' voices.
Slay the Gu Mother
The Gu Mother's fall opens every vessel and frees the tribes to face the ancient plague without her protection.
Escape With the Bride
You escape with the bride as a companion while pursuers and the deteriorating pact continue to follow.
Inherit the Mother's Body
You command the gu network and swamp while thousands of instincts awaken to contest control of your body.
Forge a Shared Gu Covenant
The tribes share small Qi contributions under a new pact and suppress the plague without sacrificing brides, forming a tribal alliance.

Workshops in Tianlu are closing as the heavenly fire weakens, and craftspeople ask you to help trace the cause. The master keeps everyone away from the main furnace, where a fire child is chained. The child says it knows why the fire is dying. Hearing that, the master shortens the chain.
Repair Furnaces
Free Fire Child
Follow Master Plan
The main furnace takes all the heat. A craftsperson asks, “We could work again with a share. Will they give up their mass production?”
Share Heaven Fire
Feed Main Furnace
The volcanic fire child was chained before learning to speak. Returning it restores the veins while permanent confinement secures the furnaces' supply.
Plan the fire child's return to the volcanic vein
Prepare the restraints for binding the child to the furnace
The master lays out a defensive artifact. “This is how we must use the last heavenly heart.” Taking it for yourself would leave no second heart for the city.
Forge City Artifact
Seize Heavenly Heart
The main furnace has one firing left. Concentrating the fire completes the great artifact while distributing it preserves other hearths before the old system consumes everything.
Stabilize the main furnace for the final forging
Divide the fire channels to preserve the other hearths

The crystal casing around the heavenly heart cracks above the city and fire begins escaping, though the heart itself remains intact. The child and craftspeople await its final destination: the main furnace, the volcano, the great artifact, or the separate hearths.
Keep the Furnace Fire Eternal
The rebound child restores unmatched production and perpetual fire through continued loss of its freedom.
Return the Fire Spirit
The child returns to the volcano as mass production ends and the fire domain's veins slowly heal.
Forge One Artifact for the City
The final fire becomes a powerful defensive artifact while the darkened workshops must adapt to dependence on it.
Claim the Heavenly Heart
You leave with the heavenly heart while the city splits over remaining resources and its factions share lasting pursuit of you.
Awaken Ten Thousand Hearths
Safely distributed fire restarts ordinary workshops and a workshop council replaces dependence on the single main furnace.

A break in the Guixu black tide reveals a thirteenth island with ships lost in different eras along its shore. A cartographer searching for his daughter shows you his amended chart. High in the island's center, a coral clock remains visible and moving even from the bank.
Trust Thirteen Island Map
Rescue Black Tide Ships
Study Tide Clock
The fragile camp argues over the year. Anchoring it preserves a place in the present while looting temporal relics risks losing everyone again.
Set a temporary anchor to slow the island's drift
Loot Island
Every ship claims a different era and priority. Guiding them all may exhaust the tide window while saving only one abandons the rest.
Guide All Ships
Save One Ship

The clock's current mechanism restores one era by displacing others. Separate calibration grooves suggest that matching the ships to their departure times might permit successive returns. Borrowing the tide for cultivation would instead consume future travelers' time.
Reverse Tide Clock
Borrow Black Tide
As the tide ebbs the island sinks. Some ask you to raise it while others wait at the clock for a route to their own era.
Hold the island temporarily and prepare its present-day anchor
Open Return Current

The clock sounds across moments a thousand years apart. Bodies on the island remain at the age of disappearance while memories accumulate, explaining how the daughter endured so long. Holding records of their departure dates, the travelers wait for the final route to be calibrated.
Return Today's Lost
Recent travelers return with the cartographer's daughter while ancient travelers vanish as the island commits to the present.
Anchor the Thirteenth Island
Anchored in the present the island becomes a permanent settlement shared by survivors from different eras.
Borrow the Black Tide
You gain decades of practice within an outside year while every further use makes another unknown traveler disappear.
Sink the Island Into Guixu
The destroyed clock sinks the island permanently and scatters its people into moments of history nobody can verify.
Guide All Ships Home
The repaired clock returns everyone to the instant after disappearance without erasing an era, including the daughter carrying centuries of memories home.

At Futian Academy you find seven classroom desks but only six names on the register. Students insist the empty place has always been there. Tiny writing in a margin seems to ask for help. You turn a page and find it waiting where you look next.
Sit Empty Seat
Read Margin Student
Inspect Fate Register

Pei Zhao's name remains carved beneath the empty desk. An old note says he was erased because of a predicted threat to the academy. Restoring his place would disturb forgotten relationships; leaving it unchanged preserves a class whose history excludes him.
Reconstruct the seventh student's identity records
Leave Seat Empty

The student in the margins finally writes his name: Pei Zhao. The seventh desk was his before an altered fate register confined him to the blank spaces. He asks you to bring him back, but admits the others have lived for years in a history without him. Restoring the register means facing those changes too.
Bring Peizhao Out
Use Peizhao Fate
The register manufactures distinction by transferring fortune and disaster between students. Burning it ends predictions while writing in it makes you the next allocator.
Identify the fate-altering pages that must be disabled
Write New Page
As the head opens Pei's page current achievements fade. Pei wants to return while the others fear losing the lives they have already lived.
Prepare to restore Pei Zhao's original life
Preserve Academy Order
Ink spreads across every record. Your work with Pei and the register determines whose history changes or whether he can have a separate one.
Restore the Seventh Seat
Pei returns and exposes the academy as the original timeline restores itself and changes some existing achievements and relationships.
Leave the Seat Empty
You preserve the current students and gain register access while Pei remains confined to blank space and his seat stays empty.
Burn the Fate Register
The designed futures burn and the academy loses its reliable production of geniuses without success requiring another person's destruction.
Write a New Fate
You steal limited power to alter future events while every edit transfers disaster to an unknown person.
Create a Person Outside the Books

You establish an independent history for Pei without overwriting the current students. He retains his memories of the altered years but is no longer governed by the academy's old records, and can finally leave the pages as a companion.

Wuxiang Temple promises relief from suffering. At its gate you hear pilgrims describe remembering their families without feeling any attachment to them. As an attendant invites you in, one catches your sleeve, asking first to explain that strange change.
Guide Faceless Pilgrims
Inspect Desire Vault
Awaken Seventh Statue
Some surrendered love and the will to live along with pain. Returning desire restores difficult lives while erasure leaves undisturbed calm.
Return Desires
Erase Last Desires

The vault holds centuries of emotions, some without a surviving owner. Those that can be identified may be returned; the rest need another provision. The voices plead for release. You could shelter some within yourself, but would have to bear thoughts unlike your own.
Trace the emotions' origins and open their return channels
Take in some emotions to investigate the vault

The seventh statue speaks with emotions collected in the desire vault. The voices remember where they came from and plead against being erased together. Asked how they could be returned, some urge you to trace the pilgrims; others ask to shelter within you long enough to leave the vault.
Question Statue
Become Statue Vessel
The abbot begins merging with the statue to create a desireless Buddha before conflict tears the temple apart. Stopping or completing it will change people.
Stop Enlightenment
Help stabilize the merger array and examine its cost

Many faces appear in succession on the statue while pilgrims await the emotions identified as theirs. You must decide on return, destruction, containment or reform of the taking mechanism, including what happens to the unclaimed parts.
Create the Desireless Buddha
The abbot becomes powerful and nearly emotionless as perfect peace gradually dissolves the residents' individuality.
Return Desire to All Beings

Identified pain and love return to their owners, leaving pilgrims laughing and crying at once. Emotions without living owners receive separate provision rather than being forced into strangers. People can speak honestly about their feelings, and the temple is no longer uniformly silent.
Take All Desires Into Your Heart
Absorbing the statue brings vast perception and countless personalities that may influence your later major decisions.
Leave the Temple Formless
Destroying the statue ends the immediate crisis while permanently depriving thousands of the feelings stored inside it.
Let All Beings Have Form
The statue becomes a mirror that reveals rather than removes emotion and the temple begins treating inner demons with it.

A record dates your death a year too early, and you trace it to Jiuyou Ferry. The boatman calls names, including the living Shen Nian, while a nameless soul waits without an answer. You bring him the disputed date. He first asks who sold those years.
Read Death Ledger
Follow Living Passenger
Investigate Stolen Lifespan
Someone paid to enter the death date. Confirming it wins underworld recognition while removing it by force challenges the ledger's authority.
Write Own Name
Erase Own Name

Shen Nian is alive, but already bears a boarding mark. Her remaining years were sold and the ferry ledger now lists her as due. The boatman demands equivalent lifespan to return her. “What if we find the years that were stolen?” she asks. “Why should somebody else have to pay again?”
Return Passenger
Hand Passenger Over
The treasury holds years taken from poor mortals. Returning them changes death dates while keeping them brings wealth and lifespan burdened by the victims' consequences.
Identify the stolen years' owners and prepare their return
Keep Stolen Lifespan
The bell compels listed souls aboard. Turning back defies the law while taking the oar transfers both passage authority and future duties to you.
Turn Boat Back
Take control of the oar to stop the crossing

The ferry stops at the final passage across the boundary. Shen looks towards the shore you came from. The boatman waits for your decision on the names and stolen years: return the living, obey the ledger, or challenge the trade in false death dates.
Return the Living to Shore
Shen returns at the cost of your years, remembering the underworld and remaining connected to your future.
Obey the Name in the Ledger
Shen boards and you gain underworld permissions while her family investigates the death that should never have happened.
Seize Stolen Years and Return Life
Defeating the lifespan merchant restores stolen years and removes your false death date as unexpected survivors alter the future.
Become the New Ferryman
Taking the oar gives you command over the dead and responsibility for every future crossing.
Rewrite the Fraudulent Deaths
Correcting every false date without harming natural lifespans opens a permanent safe route between the living city and the ferry.

Every expedition leaving Duanjie to the west returns through the eastern gate. Following one partway, you find repeating milestones and records, while the walls rise and fall like breathing. The gatekeeper refuses to send more people out and asks you to find what is holding the city shut.
Walk Returning Road
Inspect Duplicate Expeditions
Enter Living Wall
The looping road is a chain of the spatial prison. Closing it strengthens confinement while opening it connects the duplicate city and weakens the boundary.
Seal Returning Road
Open Returning Road

Residents recognize their counterparts across the seam and discover that an injury on one side bleeds in the same place on the other. Both groups have families waiting. Some favor merging the expeditions and preserving their memories; others argue that one city must be sacrificed. Asked what that would do through the injury link, nobody yet has an answer.
Merge Expeditions
Isolate the duplicate expeditions and examine a removal plan

Through its prison the Devourer offers passage for remote lands to consume. Repairing the lock would keep it confined and the road closed. An older diagram also proposes transferring the prison to an empty realm, but its boundary calculations remain incomplete.
Repair World Lock
Speak World Devourer

As the cities overlap the seams reveal the circuit carrying injuries between counterparts. It must be isolated before one city can bear the seal while the other survives. Re-anchoring the prison or separating the whole city from its duty are still alternatives.
Anchor City
Release City
An unfamiliar sky appears beyond the boundary as both populations gather. Your handling of the seal and counterparts determines what can cross it.
Guard the Boundary Forever
The reinforced seal puts the Devourer to sleep and protects the city while leaving it confined at the world's edge.
Open the Boundary Gate
Opening the boundary and defeating the escaping Devourer reveals the second world map and a path towards higher cultivation.
Trade One City for the World

You isolate the circuit carrying injuries before surrendering one city to the gate. The other breaks free, but its survivors remember the counterparts they lost. When the names are counted, nobody will call the sacrificed city empty.
Make a Pact With the World Devourer
Instant spatial travel comes with the Devourer's recurring demands for energy, buildings or even a remote region.
Let the City Walk Between Realms
The cities merge into a traveling fortress while the Devourer is separately sealed in an empty realm, creating a hub between worlds.

A plague spreads and raises regional danger.

life.immortal_cultivation_mod.map.travel: The injured cultivator blames a beast for the collapse while the caravan leader suspects a scout. Both want you to believe them and a route is still needed.
Help the wounded cultivator
Treating the stranger gains a grateful guide at the cost of time and stamina.
Search the surrounding slopes
Following the tracks reveals hidden supplies and a route around the collapse.
Continue without stopping
The caravan leaves the dispute behind and continues safely.
Seize the cultivator's storage bag
You take the bag and abandon the injured cultivator, gaining wealth and a greater local wanted status.
The bandits push captives into the road. “Pay first if you want your people to pass.”
Break through by force
You break the ambush and recover part of the stolen property before leaving the road.
Pay the demanded toll
Paying the ransom gets the group through safely.
Abandon the road and flee
You escape through rough country with shaken composure and your life intact.
Negotiate for the captives
Negotiation divides the bandits and opens the route without a full battle.
The spiritual storm scrambles weather, Qi and direction as the group stops and someone calls for shelter.
Shelter until it passes
Sheltering safely delays the journey until the next annual phase.
Force a path through
You cross with injuries and hard-earned combat experience.
Study the storm's circulation
The storm strains your mind while revealing an unusual pattern of Qi circulation.
Harvest concentrated Qi
You collect the condensed Qi at risk and continue with increased cultivation.
A broken seal exposes the illegal cargo. The manager tries to close the box. “Could we keep this quiet until the journey's over?”
Report the cargo
The authorities seize the cargo after your report and pay the reward.
Ignore it
You keep quiet as the cargo is concealed again and the journey continues.
Join the transaction
You receive a share of the illicit trade and become complicit in it.
Confiscate it yourself
Seizing the cargo by force gains property and local enemies.
The huge flying beast follows until it folds its wings into a dive and the group scatters between confrontation and cloud cover.
Repel the beast
You repel the beast after a dangerous aerial fight.
Evade through cloud cover
The group escapes through clouds and remains tense long after losing sight of the beast.
Attempt to tame it
Enduring its attacks lets you establish a bond and gain a new spiritual mount.
Follow it off route
Following it off route reveals a lead concerning the hidden Guixu islands.
A failed spatial anchor opens the exit at the wrong coordinates and the passage distorts as you choose stabilization, endurance or an abort.
Stabilize the formation
Repairing the anchor brings a safe arrival and new spatial understanding.
Endure the distortion
You endure the distorted passage and reach the destination with injuries.
Abort the teleport
The formation shuts down safely before worsening and the journey is delayed.
Observe the broken coordinates
Observing the faulty coordinates before arrival yields insight for your cultivation.

tooltip.immortal_cultivation_mod.yuanyin: Captured from an escaped Nascent Soul before its body could regenerate
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.blood_ape_: Blood Ape Demon General Spawn Egg
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.xuanyan_h: Forms three rotating stone plates with a shared 100-point shield. The plates block melee, projectiles, and spells, reduce knockback by 30%, and slow movement by 5% until broken or 25 seconds pass.
Earth qi rises into three circling stones; each plate meets the blow before the body.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.liufeng_x: Maintains a 120-point spiraling wind shield. It deflects 80% of weak physical projectiles and 40% of weak spiritual projectiles, reduces knockback by 20%, and consumes 15 qi per second.
Layered winds turn arrow and blade aside; incoming force is scattered into empty air.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.xuesha_hu: Sacrifices 5% of current health to form a 500–750 point blood shield that grows stronger at low health. When broken, it erupts in a damaging, interrupting four-block shockwave.
Blood essence becomes a violent crimson wall; when the wall dies, its fury bursts outward.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jingling_: Creates a 1,000-point mirror shield for up to 20 seconds. Compatible spell projectiles consume another 200 qi and return toward their caster at 80% damage; attacks that cannot be reflected damage the shield.
A clear spiritual mirror receives the hostile art, then returns its radiance to the hand that cast it.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yuangang_: Maintains a moving spherical domain that protects allied entities through one shared shield pool. Its cost, radius, and durability scale through the three Nascent Soul stages, and hostile projectiles are slowed within it.
Vast primordial qi opens into a heavenly sphere; all companions beneath it share one unbroken defense.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinmang_c: Compresses metal qi into an extremely narrow, high-speed projectile. It penetrates up to three enemies, loses 20% damage after each target, ignores 30% of armor defense, and deals 50% extra damage to shields.
One thread of golden radiance gathers to a point; armor splits only after the light has passed.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jinfeng_z: Fires an extremely narrow golden projectile for 28 damage on impact. It ignores 10% of defense and deals 25% extra shield damage, but its thin hitbox makes misses costly.
Two fingers gather a golden edge; one fine ray parts armor before the eye can follow.
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.wanren_chu: Myriad Blades Pierce the Heart Scroll
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wanren_ch: Forms six spiritual metal blades around the caster and launches them from different angles. Each deals 110 damage and ignores 15% of defense; after the first hit marks a target, the remaining blades gain homing.
Six blades circle like stars; the first draws blood, and all the rest remember the heart.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jingji_tu: Fires an invisible trigger that erupts spiritual thorns in a 2.5-block radius on impact, dealing 40 damage, launching targets slightly upward, and slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds. It cannot reach enemies high above the ground.
A thought enters the soil; green spears answer beneath the enemy's feet.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wanteng_j: Fires an invisible trigger that summons a five-block snare for 5 seconds on impact. Vines pull enemies inward, slow them by 60%, and deal 90 damage each second. Fire techniques rapidly destroy the formation.
Ten thousand vines knot into one prison; roots tighten until breath itself is bound.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yanbao_da: Throws an unstable fire orb. A direct hit deals 65 damage, its three-block explosion deals up to 35 more, and affected enemies burn for 3 seconds.
Fire is folded into one restless pearl; release the hand, and scarlet ruin blossoms.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.chiyan_lo: Fires an invisible trigger that creates a slowly advancing pillar of spiritual flame for 5 seconds on impact. The eight-block-tall tornado draws enemies and loose objects within six blocks inward, deals 180 damage each second inside its four-block core, tears a wide path through terrain as it moves, and throws survivors outward when it ends.
Scarlet wind coils from earth to heaven; flame draws all things inward, then casts ash away.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.diyan_qia: Fires an invisible trigger that drives a stone spear from below its impact, dealing 55 damage and launching targets upward. Landing back on solid ground deals another 20 damage.
The mountain hides a spear; at one command, stone rises and the foe falls twice.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shanbeng_: Fires an invisible trigger. Its impact warns for 1.5 seconds before a huge mountain seal falls across six blocks. It deals up to 900 damage with edge falloff, gains 50% damage against grounded targets, crushes them downward, and blasts out a massive deep crater. Full charge makes the destruction wider, deeper, and able to break harder blocks.
A seal borrows the weight of peaks; shadow arrives first, then mountain and earth become one.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shuiren_l: Launches three slightly spread water-crescent projectiles. Each deals 12 damage, for 36 total if all connect, and extinguishes burning targets.
Three crescents leave one stream; flame dies wherever the blue edges pass.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.canglang_: Sends a seven-block-wide wave forward for 14 blocks. It deals 180 damage once, carries enemies with it, knocks them away at the end, and extinguishes fire and burning terrain.
The vast tide crosses the field in one breath; foes and flame alike are swept from its path.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.leishan.d: Becomes a lightning streak and instantly dashes up to eight blocks without passing through walls. Enemies crossed take 55 damage, while the caster receives 50% less damage during the brief transformation.
Thunder leaves no footstep; a white line passes, and only then does the wound speak.
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.wulei_hong: Five Thunderbolts Crown the Target Scroll
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.wulei_hon: Fires an invisible trigger that marks the enemy it strikes and calls five lightning strikes over roughly 3 seconds. Each strike deals 240 damage in a two-block radius; consecutive hits against the marked target gain 10% damage each.
The first thunder writes the name; four heavenly judgments follow the same mark.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.bingzhui_: Fires an invisible trigger that creates eight OBJ-rendered ice spikes above a four-block area on impact. Each falling spike deals 30 damage and adds 5% slow, stacking to 30%.
Cold stars gather above; eight crystal points descend and winter follows each wound.
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.hanyu_feng: Cold Prison Seals the Earth Scroll
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.hanyu_fen: Freezes a seven-block radius for 6 seconds, dealing 100 damage each second and slowing enemies by 35%. Remaining inside for 4 seconds freezes a target for 1 second. Fire techniques rapidly break the frozen domain.
One breath seals seven paces; linger beneath the frost, and even thought becomes still.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yaoguang_: Releases a six-block flash that deals 20 damage and blinds enemies for 2.5 seconds, interrupting mobs focused on the caster. Undead and Yin-aligned enemies take 50 damage instead.
Radiance opens like a second sun; hostile eyes lose the path, and shadows burn deepest.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.tianguang: Fires an invisible trigger that marks its impact for 1 second, then sends a two-block-wide pillar through every enemy in its vertical path for 950 damage. The heavenly beam bores a long vertical shaft through terrain; full charge widens and greatly extends the channel. Yin-aligned targets take 25% more.
A pale mark invites heaven's gaze; one pillar descends, and every shadow in its path is pierced.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.yingxi.de: Fires an invisible trigger. When it strikes a visible enemy, the caster melts into shadow for 0.3 seconds and appears behind them. The strike deals 70 damage, or 100 from behind, and cannot cross thick walls or forcefields.
The shadow leaves before the body; when the foe turns, the blade is already behind the heart.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.tianfeng_: Fires an invisible trigger that crushes a five-block area on impact for 600 damage and drives a broad crater into the impact zone. Flying targets are forced violently downward and suffer up to 300 impact damage; grounded targets are briefly knocked down. Full charge produces a much larger and deeper crater.
Heavenly wind becomes an unseen hammer; wings fold, knees break, and the sky returns its prey to earth.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.muling_sh: Sneak-cast to fill yourself with life energy, or cast normally to fire an invisible healing projectile at an ally. Restores 140 HP over 8 seconds while moving and fighting. Burning halves each healing pulse. Cannot stack with itself.
A breath of green enters the meridians; wounds close even while steel still rings.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.xue_guiyu: Sneak-cast on yourself or cast normally to fire an invisible healing projectile at an ally. Removes heavy bleeding, restores 120 HP instantly, then 100 HP over 5 seconds. Targets below 5% HP are stabilized by the same cast before healing begins.
Scattered blood answers the origin; severed currents join, and the fading pulse becomes whole.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.shengxi_b: Instantly restores 35% of the caster's missing HP. The self-only heal is at least 100 HP and at most 250 HP.
Stored spring erupts in one breath; the emptier the vessel, the stronger life returns.
message.immortal_cultivation_mod.xue_gui: The target is stabilized and Blood Returns to Origin begins healing.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.tianyun_f: 1,600 center / 700 outer; 3,200 center / 1,400 outer at 200% charge

Fires an invisible trigger that condenses a vast burning meteor over its impact point. After a two-second red warning, it strikes a 20-block-radius area for 1,600 center or 700 outer damage, drives airborne enemies down, knocks central enemies down, blasts out a vast crater, and leaves fire and glowing fissures. At 200% charge the warning lasts three seconds, the radius becomes 26 blocks, and both damage values double.
Fire and earth forge a falling star; red heaven warns the city before stone, flame, and dust erase its walls.
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.luohua_cha: Falling Blossoms Entwine the Body Scroll
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.luohua_ch: Fires an invisible trigger that surrounds the enemy it strikes with wood-and-wind petals. Four cutting waves deal 25 damage each, slow the target by 20% for 2 seconds, follow limited movement, and finish with a slight backward push.
A tender blossom follows the wandering wind; four turns bind the body, then every soft petal reveals its edge.
item.immortal_cultivation_mod.baihua_zan: Burial of a Hundred Flowers Scroll
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.baihua_za: Fires an invisible trigger that plants a six-block-radius spiritual garden on impact. Each deals 100 damage and ignores 10% defense. The first hit applies a Sword-Fate Mark that strengthens the remaining swords' tracking.
One sword asks the path, two swords seal escape; when three silver traces meet, fate has nowhere left to turn.
A Heaven-tier fire and Yang body-cultivation method capped at late Spirit Transformation. Sunlight fills the body with 0-100% Solar Power. Power follows daytime, weather, open sky, and proficiency: Beginner caps at 60%, Minor at 80%, Great at 100% and unlocks Great Sun Descends, while Perfected reduces weather/loss penalties and unlocks Extreme Yang Moment. Solar Power raises physical damage, defense, speed, knockback, health, regeneration, and fire resistance. It fades at night, underground, and in sunless dimensions.

The sun's essence enters blood and bone.
Yang fire follows the meridians and forges a mighty body.
At dawn, a little more divine strength awakens.
At noon, towering power subdues every foe.
At night, golden light returns to silence.
For one supreme Yang moment, heaven and earth shine.

spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.rilun.des: Requires 70% Solar Power. Sneak-cast to hold a miniature sun that illuminates the caster, burns nearby enemies, and melts snow and ice. A small sun rests above the palm; held, it rules the dark—released, it becomes the dawn of ruin.
spell.immortal_cultivation_mod.jiyang_yi: Requires 99% Solar Power, Perfected proficiency, and Great Sun Descends at noon. For 10 seconds the body becomes a white-gold solar vessel with +300% physical damage, huge heavy-hit shockwaves, close aura damage, spell resistance, knockback immunity, a larger body, and a sun halo. A Heaven-tier wind and thunder method capped at late Nascent Soul. Continuous sprinting, dashing, fast flight, successful dodges, moving wind/thunder casts, and uninterrupted attacks build 0-100 Wind-Thunder Momentum. Standing still, heavy stagger, leaving combat, and major techniques drain it. At 25/50/75/100 Momentum, movement speed rises by 10/20/30/40%; wind force, dash distance, lightning chaining, thunder power, and wind radius unlock in stages. After moving continuously for 3 seconds, Chasing Wind Draws Thunder improves aerial steering and acceleration, reduces moving knockback by 20%, and may make fast projectiles narrowly miss.
method_poem.immortal_cultivation_mod.gan:

The faster the wind, the greater the thunder.
The greater the thunder, the wilder the wind.

guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: Chapter 0 · Mortal Awakening
Before sensing Qi, a mortal must first awaken the body's potential with an Enlightenment Pill.
Find an Enlightenment Pill
Follow the cave bearing %s for %s blocks to X: %s, Z: %s. Search its chest for the pill.
The guidance is searching the world for the nearest ancient cave.
Return to the Overworld; the cave guidance cannot cross dimensions.
Chapter 1 · First Steps
Heaven and earth hold spirit. First know yourself, then awaken the sense of Qi.
Examine your cultivation state
Press [%s] to open cultivation stats. The highlighted fields show realm, spirit root, vitality, and lifespan.
Enter Qi Refining
Consume an Enlightenment Pill and complete awakening to sense the world's Qi.
Chapter 2 · Drawing Qi Within
Draw worldly Qi through the meridians and settle it within the dantian.
Absorb Qi while meditating
Press [%s] and genuinely absorb 100 Qi. Denser-Qi locations recover it faster.
Activate a cultivation method

Learn and activate the provided Basic Breathing Method. Methods affect cultivation speed, Qi recovery, affinity, and breakthroughs. Spell and method puzzle tiers depend on the major realm gap. Same realm: Foundation; +1 realm: Golden Core; +2: Nascent Soul. Lower-realm content uses Qi Refining difficulty. Basic Breathing and Clear Heart are starter methods. Their puzzles always use a simple 5×5 Qi Refining board with extra spare moves; realm gaps and low talent do not add advanced mechanisms.
Chapter 3 · First Techniques
Spell and method puzzles scale with major realm difference. After learning a spell, equip it, select it, and cast it.
Learn your first spell

Study the provided Wind Blade scroll through its Lingqi Trajectory puzzle. Spell and method puzzle tiers depend on the major realm gap. Same realm: Foundation; +1 realm: Golden Core; +2: Nascent Soul. Lower-realm content uses Qi Refining difficulty.
Equip the spell to the wheel
Press [%s], then add a learned spell to the spell wheel.
Cast the equipped spell

Use [%s] for the spell wheel and [%s] to cast the selected spell. A successful innate ability activation briefly writes its Chinese name across the view in enormous brush calligraphy, with glowing edges and flying ink. The caster and all players within 32 blocks in the same dimension see the burst. The strokes disappear within about a second while combat continues. Toggling an ability off or inspecting it produces no title. The unfinished curse announces its actual rescue, not its status check.
Release a spell at 150%% charge
Hold [%s], then release after charge reaches at least 150%%.
Build spell proficiency
Practice advances real proficiency: Beginner → Minor Success → Major Success → Perfection → Peak.
Chapter 4 · Spiritual Sense
Eyes perceive form; spiritual sense perceives life, Qi, formations, and intent.
Release spiritual sense
Press [%s] to toggle spiritual sense and let its perception sphere expand.
Sense an animal or monster through a wall

1. Find a living sheep, cow, or ordinary monster.
2. Put one layer of ordinary solid blocks between you and it, blocking direct sight. Merely turning your back does not count.
3. Press [%s] to enable Spiritual Sense. Stand close to the wall and let its sensing range expand to the creature.
Completion: sense that living creature through the wall. The objective completes automatically; no attack is needed.
No detection? Move closer, try an ordinary animal, or reduce the obstruction. Plants, dropped items, and Qi traces do not count.
Chapter 5 · Cultivator Combat
Cultivator combat alternates weapons, movement, spells, defense, and Qi control.
Land a weapon attack
Press [%s] for combat mode, then land a real weapon hit. A cultivator's Interact → Spar option provides safe practice.
Use a weapon technique
Charge and land a heavy attack with any weapon, including vanilla weapons, or use a weapon-specific technique.
Cast during combat
Create an opening and press [%s] to cast a learned technique successfully.
Use a charged combat spell
Hold [%s] and release a technique at 150%% charge while fighting.
Keep a safe Qi reserve
Cast successfully without allowing Qi to fall below 20%%.
Recognize an enemy attack
Block or survive a projectile/telegraphed technique instead of ignoring it.
Chapter 6 · Storage and Equipment
Equipment belongs in its proper slot; storage pouches and protective accessories each have their own controls.
Equip a cultivation item
Place suitable armor or clothing into its real equipment slot.
Open a Qi pouch
Use a Qi pouch to enter its top-down internal-space interface.
Place a block inside
Drag a valid block into the real buildable internal space.
Remove a placed block
Double-click a placed block to return it to your inventory.
Chapter 7 · Spiritual Veins
Worldly Qi gathers into underground currents whose centers empower cultivation.
Detect a spiritual vein
Use spiritual sense until an actual vein signature enters perception.
Reach the vein center
Follow the sensed Qi flow and stand within four blocks of its center.
Chapter 8 · Artifact Forging
Complete a real forging process: recipe, materials, flame, temperature, melting, and the finished item. Higher-grade materials require stronger flames.
Open a forge ding
Interact with a placed ding to open its forging interface.
Add the required materials
Fill the highlighted material slots with the recipe's real ingredients.
Insert the recipe jade slip
Place the matching recipe slip into the highlighted recipe slot.
Raise and control temperature
Begin forging and pulse the fire toward the displayed target range.
Maintain the melt
Keep the forge active while its real melting progress advances.
Complete the forged item
Finish a successful forging cycle and produce its actual output.
Chapter 9 · Recipe Jade Slips
Complex recipes are carried by jade slips and used by their proper system.
Use a recipe jade slip
Learn a spell scroll, or use a forging jade slip in a real recipe. Spell puzzles scale with realm gap; forging recipes do not use this rule.
Chapter 10 · Formations
Craft the Magic Ritual Guide from a Book and Low-Grade Spirit Stone. Formation cultivators carry the Ritual Dagger needed to build formations.
Place a blank Magic Center
Shift-right-click with a Ritual Dagger, choose a radius, and place the center beneath you. It records you as its owner.
Complete a valid circle pattern
Right-click with the Ritual Dagger to draw the circles required by a diagram in the Magic Ritual Guide.
Transform the center
Strike the completed center with the Ritual Dagger to transform it into the matched formation.
Chapter 11 · Formation Flags
Flags modify an existing formation; their tooltips retain exact effects.
Open the octagon flag tab
Open a center, then select its highlighted octagon tab.
Install a formation flag
Insert a real formation flag into one highlighted octagon slot.
Chapter 12 · The Cultivation World
Cultivators possess identity, realm, relationships, inventory, and goals.
Speak with a cultivator
Interact with a real cultivator NPC and choose a dialogue option.
Complete an NPC trade
Inspect the NPC's inventory and complete one valid exchange.
Accept an NPC task
Accept one actual quest from a cultivator.
Chapter 13 · Breakthrough
A breakthrough opens only after meeting the current stage requirements. Some major realms have separate trials, with lasting consequences for failure.
Reach the current realm limit
Fill cultivation progress and Qi; required pills and method limits still apply.
Begin a breakthrough
Open cultivation stats and use the highlighted breakthrough control.
Succeed in the breakthrough
Complete the actual breakthrough or Golden Core trial successfully.
Chapter 14 · Foundation Establishment
Foundation Establishment brings sustained techniques, mobility, defense, and outward Qi.
Reach Foundation Establishment
Advance to Foundation Establishment through the real breakthrough path.
Release external Qi through a weapon
Use [%s] to enable and release real outward weapon Qi.
Sustain controlled combat for 60 seconds
Remain in combat for 60 seconds without letting Qi fall below 20%%.
Chapter 15 · Flight
Golden Core unlocks creative-style flight. Double-tap Jump to take off; Jump rises and Sneak descends.
Take flight
Enable Golden Core flight in settings, then double-tap Jump. For sword flight, release and control a sword, then use Toggle Sword Flight (default N). Same movement controls; no vehicle mount.
Remain airborne for 10 seconds

Stay airborne for 10 seconds. Normal speed caps: Golden Core x5, Nascent Soul x10, Soul Transformation and above x20. Sword flight multiplies selected speed by 1.5 after the cap (max x7.5/x15/x30). Enable flight mouse-wheel control in settings to adjust speed.
Recall a flying weapon
Recall a flying sword with the recall control. Automatic recall is on by default and can be disabled in cultivation settings. Free inventory space if needed.
Chapter 16 · Golden Core
Qi condenses into a core, improving spiritual sense and unlocking Golden Core systems. Failed tribulation can leave a cultivator at Half-step Golden Core.
Form a Golden Core
Complete the Golden Core challenge and survive its tribulation.
Use strengthened spiritual sense
Release spiritual sense after reaching Golden Core and observe its clearer reach.
Enter Golden Core inner space
Use the Golden Core control in cultivation stats to enter the real pocket dimension.
Side Path · Corpse Arts
A concealed path involving resentment, corpses, refinement, coffins, and control.
Discover an entry to corpse cultivation
Obtain or use a genuine corpse-path item; its deeper branches unlock contextually.
