guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: Forging Branch · Special Flames
Each spiritual flame has its own nature. Different flames suit different weapons.
Discover a special flame
Find any special flame in the world and approach closely enough to identify it.
Identify the flame
Observe its name, color, strength, and properties. The eight special flames have different appearances and forging capabilities.
Check flame sources

Crimson Flame: dropped by Crimson Scale Flame Lizards, or refined from crimson scales and flame-lizard blood.
Earthlung Flame: underground lava and mountain fire vents.
Verdant Spirit Flame: lightning striking mature spirit wood.
Golden Yang True Flame: Golden Core or stronger Metal/Fire cultivators, ruins, and Daoist temples.
Nether Yin Flame: may appear when powerful undead die.
Thunder Flame: weapon-tribulation lightning striking lava or fire.
Dragon Flame: may appear after defeating or capturing a Crimson Sky Flame Dragon's escaped spirit, or refined from dragon horns and Nascent Soul beast cores.
Purple Heaven Flame: extremely rare after surviving a powerful weapon tribulation.
Check forging requirements
Inspect a forging recipe that requires a special flame. Forging cannot proceed properly if the required temperature exceeds your flame's capacity.
Use a stronger flame
Find a flame that can reach the required temperature and use it for forging.
Forging Branch · Flame Vessel
A Flame Vessel can contain a spiritual flame and unleash its power directly.
Craft a Flame Vessel
Craft an empty Flame Vessel using its recipe.
Capture a flame
Hold an empty Flame Vessel and right-click a floating flame that can be captured.
Inspect the captured flame
Read the vessel tooltip to check the flame type, power, stability, and highest forging tier. Shooting does not deplete the captured flame.
Release the flame
Sneak and right-click with a filled Flame Vessel to release the flame at the selected location.
Shoot flame
Right-click the Flame Vessel to spend Qi on a flame attack.
Charge the flame
Hold right-click to concentrate the flame. Firing consumes Qi; insufficient Qi prevents further charging.
Release a giant fireball
Release right-click after charging to launch a giant fireball. Holding until fully charged fires automatically. Charged attacks cost more Qi.
Forging Branch · Spiritual Flame Forging
Flames determine both furnace temperature and whether certain materials can truly melt.
Place fire beneath the cauldron

Shoot a filled Flame Vessel at supported empty ground, then place a forging cauldron directly above the resulting fire. Sneak-right-click releases a floating, capturable seed instead of the fire used beneath a cauldron.
Observe the temperature
Open the forging cauldron and check the temperature supplied by the current flame.
Choose a suitable flame
If the temperature cannot meet the recipe requirement, switch to a stronger or more suitable flame.
Maintain the spiritual fire
Ground fire fades over time and burns longer directly beneath a forging cauldron. Floating, capturable flame seeds do not expire on this timer.
Complete spiritual flame forging
Successfully complete a full forging process using a special flame.
Combat Branch · Giant Fireball
Highly concentrated spiritual fire has destructive power far beyond ordinary techniques.
Charge the Flame Vessel
Hold right-click with a filled Flame Vessel until a large fireball forms. Release to fire, or keep holding to fire automatically at full charge. Firing requires enough Qi.
Hit the target area
Release a giant fireball and let its explosion affect the target area.
Observe the explosion radius
A giant fireball can damage multiple creatures within its radius.
Observe terrain destruction
The explosion can destroy terrain and affect liquids within its radius.
Check block-breaking settings
Disable Flame Vessel terrain destruction under Block Breaking in Cultivation Settings. Attacks still damage creatures, but do not destroy terrain.
Weapons Branch · Restrictions and Advancement
A true spiritual weapon is not finished in a single forging. Restrictions are engraved layer by layer until they form a complete cycle.
Inspect weapon restrictions
Check the current restriction layers and advancement progress of a spiritual weapon that can grow.
Add a restriction layer
Successfully engrave one restriction on a weapon through the appropriate forging system.
Complete a restriction cycle
Keep strengthening the weapon until its current restriction cycle is complete.
Attempt weapon advancement
After completing a cycle, start advancement in the weapon enhancement screen. This immediately begins a weapon tribulation.
Summon a weapon tribulation
Advancing a spiritual weapon calls down heavenly lightning. Prepare to bear the trial while holding the weapon, or risk the weapon taking the strikes itself.
Weapons Branch · Weapon Tribulations
A spiritual weapon must endure heavenly lightning to advance. Its wielder can bear the trial, or the weapon can face it alone.
Begin a weapon tribulation
Meet the weapon advancement requirements and actively begin the lightning trial.
Hold the weapon through the trial
Keep the target weapon in your hand when lightning falls. The wielder takes the strikes first.
Survive the lightning trial
Withstand consecutive lightning strikes until the weapon completes its tribulation.
Understand letting go
If no one holds the weapon, lightning strikes it directly and reduces its durability.
Prevent the weapon from shattering
A weapon shatters when its durability reaches zero. Make sure it is in good enough condition before attempting the trial.
Understand death during the trial
If the wielder dies during a weapon tribulation, the trial weapon always drops into the world, even with keepInventory enabled.
Weapons Branch · Weapon Shards
A spiritual weapon may break, but it does not vanish completely. Its remaining shards still remember the weapon they belonged to.
Obtain a weapon shard
Shatter a spiritual weapon or obtain a weapon shard from another source.
Identify the shard
Inspect its information. Weapon shards retain details that identify their original weapon.
Collect all matching shards
Collect every matching shard required to reforge that weapon.
Prepare reforging materials
Prepare two stacks of spirit stones in addition to all matching shards.
Reforge the spiritual weapon
Use all matching shards and two stacks of spirit stones in the appropriate forging system to restore the shattered weapon.
Use shards in forging
If you do not plan to restore the original weapon, some weapon shards can serve as materials for other forging recipes.
Breakthrough Branch · Golden Core Failure and Recovery
Failing to form a Golden Core does not always mean returning to Foundation Establishment. Some cultivators have already taken half a step beyond it.
Fail a Golden Core trial

After dying during a Golden Core lightning trial, inspect the consequences of a cracked core and the Half-Step Golden Core realm. This branch unlocks when a cracked core appears; you do not need to fail deliberately.
Inspect the cracked Golden Core
Open your cultivation status. Death during a Golden Core trial leaves a cracked core and puts you in the Half-Step Golden Core realm.
Check recovery requirements
Check the recovery requirements for attempting Golden Core again with a cracked core.
Restore breakthrough readiness
Half-Step Golden Core requires twice the cultivation progress of Late Foundation Establishment, plus any other breakthrough conditions shown in the screen.
Attempt Golden Core again
Once ready, start the Golden Core trial again. The previous failure does not count as a successful breakthrough.
Alchemy Branch · Using Pills
Pills do more than restore health. They can affect breakthroughs, Qi, physical condition, or special systems.
Obtain a pill
Obtain any pill with a cultivation effect.
Read the pill description
Check its purpose, duration, and activation conditions.
Take a pill
Consume a pill when its use requirements are met.
Activate a pill effect
Let the pill's actual effect activate at least once.
Learn conditional pill effects
Some pills do not take full effect immediately. They activate during a breakthrough, injury, low Qi, or another specified condition.
Check remaining effects
Open the status screen to check active pill effects and their remaining duration.
Soul Branch · Thoughts and Control Resistance
Cultivators can spend Thoughts to retain control under spiritual suppression, illusions, and other control effects.
Suffer a control effect
Be affected by a control ability that consumes Thoughts.
Resist with Thoughts
Spend Thoughts while the effect lasts to reduce or escape its control.
Observe Thought consumption
Watch your Thoughts decrease while resisting.
Understand depleted Thoughts
Once Thoughts run out, you can no longer resist control, making further control effects more dangerous. Reading this tip is enough; do not deliberately exhaust your Thoughts.
Restore Thoughts
Let your Thoughts recover after escaping control and ongoing consumption.
Keep Thoughts in reserve
When facing several enemies with control abilities, avoid spending all your Thoughts on the first effect.
World Branch · Life Simulation
A cultivator's life holds more than meditation and battle. A single choice can change the opportunities that follow.
Begin a life simulation
Enter the Life Simulation system and create a new simulation.
Make a choice
Read an event and choose one of its actions.
Complete several events
Continue the simulation and let earlier decisions influence the life that follows.
Inspect simulation rewards
Once settlement is available, inspect the rewards from this simulation.
Settle manually
Choose Manual Settlement when available to end the current simulation early.
Claim the simulation result
Confirm settlement and receive the actual rewards produced by this simulated life.
World Branch · Hair Styling Table
The cultivation journey is long, and a cultivator's appearance need not stay the same forever.
Open the Hair Styling Table
Interact with a placed Hair Styling Table.
Change hairstyle
Choose a new available hairstyle and preview your character's appearance.
Adjust hair color
Change the current hair color and observe the live preview.
Use a skin reference
Load an available skin reference so the hairstyle matches your character's skin properly.
Save your appearance
Confirm the changes to apply the new hairstyle and color to your character.
Equipment Branch · Protective Accessories
Protective accessories have their own slots and provide special effects when their conditions are met.
Open accessory slots
Open your character equipment screen and find the protective accessory slots.
Equip a Fortune Guarding Coin
Place a Fortune Guarding Coin in a valid accessory slot. It consumes itself to protect you from misfortune it can block.
Equip a Shieldbreaker Ring
Place a Shieldbreaker Ring in a ring slot and hit a blocking enemy with a melee attack to break their guard.
Equip a Blood Fang Pendant
Place a Blood Fang Pendant in a necklace slot. Blood-demon cultivators or living corpses carrying blood or blood crystals can let it replenish low Blood Qi or Resentment automatically.
Equip an Enlightenment Leaf
Place an Enlightenment Leaf in a charm slot. Meditate to practice a method or practice spells to activate its proficiency bonus.
Change protective accessories
Choose accessories for your current enemies, cultivation method, or goal instead of always using the same equipment.
Equip a protective accessory
Open the equipment screen and place any protective accessory in its matching slot.
Check the required flame
Check the target temperature and flame requirements. Ordinary fire cannot refine every material.
Supply fire to the cauldron
Place a usable fire beneath the cauldron. Open it, start forging, and stoke the flame to raise the temperature.
Check breakthrough consequences
Some failed breakthroughs do not simply return you to your previous state. Open cultivation status to check your realm, injuries, and the conditions for another attempt.

guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: Pill Toxicity
Know when medicine becomes poison.
Sources and repeat use

Every successfully consumed pill adds toxicity once, including doses that restore over time. Potency and quality use current server rules, even for old saved pills. Default base gain is 4 × pill potency; common / fine / superior quality multiply it by 1 / 0.75 / 0.5. Pills have a configured medicinal realm (most ordinary pills: Qi Refining; breakthrough pill: Foundation). Each realm above you multiplies toxicity by 1.75; each below multiplies it by 0.85. Saved pill realm metadata, when present, is respected. Each earlier repeat of the SAME pill in a chain that resets after 120 online seconds without that pill adds 35%% gain, up to five repeats. Different pill types track separately. The tooltip previews your next gain.
Stages and warnings

Default stages: 0–19 Pure; 20–39 Mild; 40–59 Accumulated; 60–79 Meridian Poisoning; 80–100 Marrow Poisoning. Screen corners begin with green mist, progressing to green-purple edges, slow purple veins and deep violet miasma. The aiming center stays clear. A brief edge label announces a worse stage; recovery allows a later warning. Open Pill Toxicity from statistics for the ACTUAL server multipliers. Open Toxicity Visual Settings from the main configuration menu or toxicity details page to disable screen effects or adjust opacity (default 60%%). Mist and veins blend continuously with your actual toxicity; the center stays clear. These client settings change no mechanics.
Total penalties

Each stage uses its total multiplier once. Mild: pill healing/Qi 90%%. Accumulated: healing/Qi 75%%, other numeric pill benefits 90%%, natural Qi 85%%. Meridian: 60%% / 80%% / 70%%, cultivation 85%%, spell costs 115%%. Marrow: 40%% / 65%% / 50%%, cultivation 65%%, spell costs 130%%; lose 1%% maximum HP every 10 seconds, never below 1 HP. Trigger chances, permanent legacy unlocks and fixed vanilla effects retain their behavior. Restoration penalties apply to instant and ongoing doses without compounding per tick. Natural Qi and pill restoration are separate.
Recovering safely

Online play removes 0.01 points/second. Meditation adds 0.04 points/second. Leaving meditation stops the bonus; damage interrupts meditation and blocks its bonus for 5 seconds. No offline detox. Death clears toxicity and repeat records; logout and changing dimensions do not. Qingdu Pill removes 25 points, adds no toxicity, requires Qi Refining or higher, and has a server-enforced 300-second ONLINE cooldown. During cooldown, below its realm requirement, or while already clean, it cannot be consumed. Its tooltip shows the limit and remaining time.
Qingdu formula

Refine 3 Harmonizing Herbs, 2 Spirit Spring Leaves and 1 Profound Ice Lotus using the Qingdu Pill Formula at 1200°C in a ding. Base yield: 5. Obtain the formula through the usual formula shop or merchant routes. All numbers here describe defaults; server config may change them. Statistics and tooltips show your current server rules.

life.story.rain_sword.title: The Sword at the Rain Crossing
life.story.rain_sword.opening: You stop at Rain Ferry to ask about a crossing, but the ferryman Old He leads you to a rusted sword on the bank. Its owner, Duan Qing, died defending the landing forty-three years ago. His oath still holds an echo in the blade. “I promised I'd come back for him,” He says, offering an old passenger token. A voice from the sword asks, “Has the last boat returned?”
life.story.rain_sword.choice.evidence: Inspect the family names on the tally (Insight check: target 11)
life.story.rain_sword.evidence: “These people were all on the bank,” He says as he traces the names beneath the military seal. “Duan was supposed to guard the granary but he stayed to get them across.” His finger stops beside the final name.
life.story.rain_sword.choice.a: Reconstruct the last crossing (Formation check: target 14; three successes before two failures)
life.story.rain_sword.choice.b: Release the oath without taking the sword (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.rain_sword.choice.c: Challenge the remnant and take the sword (nonlethal battle)
life.story.rain_sword.decision: The remembered passengers gather at midnight with an empty bundle and a severed halter. From the sword Duan's remnant says, “I promised to wait for the last boat. I need to know what became of it.”
life.story.rain_sword.a: You carry the sword and its remnant across the river. On the far bank Duan's voice finally stops asking when the boat will return. At dawn Old He gives you the rust-cleared blade and adds the date to the token. The crossing left unfinished forty-three years ago has at last been answered.
life.story.rain_sword.a.later: The date of that crossing was added beside the token's old lettering, answering the last boat after forty-three years.
life.story.rain_sword.b: You read each name on the token for Old He, then return it to the river. With the last name the oath loosens and the sword breaks into pale light. He begins writing down the people he still remembers. You stay to help him finish, until no voice on the water asks after a boat.
life.story.rain_sword.b.later: The names read aloud remained in the ferry account, while the river took the token. That farewell left no sword to carry away.
life.story.rain_sword.c: With the oath unresolved, you pull the sword from the bank. The river quiets, but its remnant remains. The boat on the wrong bank continues to appear in your dreams.
life.story.rain_sword.c.later: The account of taking the blade was brief. Why the boat had never returned remained an unanswered question.
life.story.rain_sword.withdrawn: You return the token and explain that you cannot continue. As you leave the voice asks again whether the boat has returned and He remains on the bank listening through the rain.
life.story.missing_disciple.title: The Disciple Who Did Not Return
life.story.missing_disciple.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.missing_disciple.opening: A sect notice accuses Lin Que of desertion and theft and calls for information. Passing his room, you notice his cloak beside the bed and an untouched bowl of medicine. An injured worker carrying a medicine tray stops you. “Look under the bed before you believe that notice.” A note hidden there reads, “They aren't repairing the formation. They're feeding it.”
life.story.missing_disciple.choice.evide: Inspect the medicine accounts (Insight check: target 17)
life.story.missing_disciple.evidence: The worker points into the accounts. “None of this went to the infirmary. I carried the trays beneath the garden and the disciples brought out each morning could barely stand.” Xie has ordered the duplicates destroyed.
life.story.missing_disciple.choice.a: Free Lin Que and preserve the evidence (Formation check: target 14)
life.story.missing_disciple.choice.b: Replace the living anchor quietly (Formation check: target 14)
life.story.missing_disciple.choice.c: Accuse the steward before gathering proof
life.story.missing_disciple.decision: Lin tries to rise and sinks back in pain, his meridians still bound to the array. “Don't pull. The supply hasn't stopped.” Xie points to reserve spirit stones nearby and admits they could temporarily replace the living source, provided the connections are isolated in order.
life.story.missing_disciple.a: After Lin is freed, the elders receive the scene record and surviving accounts for review and halt night duty. Physicians take the injured. From his bed Lin asks whether anyone else will be sent below, and you read him the order prohibiting further human feeding.
life.story.missing_disciple.a.later: The published accounts exposed the night labor, preserving the circumstances of Lin's rescue alongside the reforms.
life.story.missing_disciple.b: With the human source replaced Lin can finally leave the formation. Xie puts away the undisclosed records. At the door Lin tells him, “You know what we saw. Don't mistake our silence for forgetting.”
life.story.missing_disciple.b.later: The arrangement that saved Lin still concealed some responsibility. The compromise never amounted to a full accounting.
life.story.missing_disciple.c: Without complete accounts your accusation brings disciplinary action against you. The worker catches up as you leave. “Can we still appeal? We can't leave Lin's case like this.” There is evidence still to gather.
life.story.missing_disciple.c.later: Censure arrived before the facts were established, leaving the appeal to work from an incomplete case.
life.story.missing_disciple.withdrawn: You hand the worker what you know and explain that you cannot continue. He keeps the note. “I'll find someone else but first tell me exactly how far you got.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.title: The Market of Borrowed Faces
life.story.borrowed_faces.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.borrowed_faces.opening: While you browse a memory shop in the ghost market, a spirit called Yuexi asks you to stay as a witness. The merchant holds a true-name ledger and refuses to let her leave. “I lent him a memory. I didn't sell him my name.” She points to the contract on the counter. “Will you look at what he put in there?”
life.story.borrowed_faces.choice.evidenc: Read the true-name contract (Insight check: target 17)
life.story.borrowed_faces.evidence: Yuexi recognizes her fingerprint but not the clause surrendering her name. “You were there when it was signed,” the clerk says. She holds the paper down. “Then let's check what you changed afterward.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.choice.a: Restore the stolen names (Formation check: target 17)
life.story.borrowed_faces.choice.b: Pay for a limited memory trade (100 simulation wealth)
life.story.borrowed_faces.choice.c: Steal the ledger and fight the mirror attendants
life.story.borrowed_faces.decision: Two mirror servants guard the ledger while the merchant offers his terms. “If you want to borrow a memory we'll agree the price first. Her name needs proof of alteration.” Stealing the book would invite pursuit.
life.story.borrowed_faces.a: You identify the name-transfer clause added after signing and require the merchant to honor the original agreement. Once her name is restored, Yuexi leaves her own contact token. “Use this to find me. You won't need to go through them.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.a.later: The amended contract returned Yuexi's name to her. Your signature belonged in the witness's space.
life.story.borrowed_faces.b: You and the merchant rewrite the memory loan's scope, duration and payment terms, keeping a copy each. Yuexi's name remains a separate dispute under her own contract. When the merchant hands over the agreed memory, he asks you to read its marginal conditions before accepting it.
life.story.borrowed_faces.b.later: The borrowed memory had boundaries and a payment due. The merchant left your questions in the contract's margins.
life.story.borrowed_faces.c: The dispute breaks down and the mirror servants try to remove the contested ledger. You hold on to it and retreat towards the gate as the merchant calls for its recovery. You leave with the ledger and its memories, and with the market's hostility behind you.
life.story.borrowed_faces.c.later: After the ledger was taken, both sides of its trades sought it out. Several notices about you appeared in the market.
life.story.borrowed_faces.withdrawn: You leave the ledger alone and tell Yuexi which clauses you saw. She turns back towards the mirrors to continue trying to recover her name.
life.story.flooded_mine.title: The Mine Beneath the Water
life.story.flooded_mine.opening: Miners stop you on the mountain road and ask for help with a flooding shaft. Their foreman Zhou still wants the carts brought out, though water is nearly across the escape route. A water spirit named Lian appears in a crack. “You've cut into my watercourse. Move those lower supports and nobody gets out.” Zhou looks back towards the workers still underground and stops shouting for more ore.
life.story.flooded_mine.choice.evidence: Read the pressure formation (Formation check: target 14)
life.story.flooded_mine.evidence: All three supports strain under the pressure as water reaches the escape route first. A miner braces himself against a pillar. “You still want us going deeper? We won't carry anything out if the exit floods.”
life.story.flooded_mine.choice.a: Stabilize the shared reservoir (Formation check: target 14; three successes before two failures)
life.story.flooded_mine.choice.b: Evacuate the miners and close the mine
life.story.flooded_mine.choice.c: Force the extraction through the flood
life.story.flooded_mine.decision: Lian points to three supports under pressure. “Three successful stabilizations will relieve it. Two failures in total and we withdraw.” Zhou stops the carts and waits for your plan for the miners. Water covers the next step; repair, closure or further extraction must start now.
life.story.flooded_mine.a: Once the reservoir is stable Zhou and Lian agree on its upkeep. The miners return without racing for one last load and accept smaller earnings from work they can continue.
life.story.flooded_mine.a.later: The reservoir agreement set extraction limits beside maintenance duties, with Zhou's signature covering both.
life.story.flooded_mine.b: The entrance is sealed after the final miner emerges. Zhou stares at the abandoned carts while a worker grips your hand. “That's everyone. We've actually got everyone out.”
life.story.flooded_mine.b.later: The evacuation list filled with names brought above ground. Closure and lost production came at its end.
life.story.flooded_mine.c: As the ore is hauled away the water spirit departs. Zhou counts the proceeds while you watch the damage spreading through the vein with nobody left to answer the water below.
life.story.flooded_mine.c.later: The ore accounts showed a profit. Beside it stood the damage left in the watercourse.
life.story.flooded_mine.withdrawn: You leave before the water closes the route and describe the cracks and rising level to those outside. People inside are still waiting for Zhou to call a halt.
life.story.future_letter.title: A Letter from a Possible Future
life.story.future_letter.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.future_letter.opening: A letter arrives without a return address, in what looks like your handwriting and signed with your name. It tells you to abandon a scarred courier at a bridge and seek treasure in a nearby deserted observatory, and gives his time of death. You have never met him. Wet ink marks your finger as you unfold the page.
life.story.future_letter.choice.evidence: Compare the letter with the present (Insight check: target 17)
life.story.future_letter.evidence: You find the scarred courier at the bridge carrying medicine. The pier is cracked. Showing him the letter, you ask him to wait while you check the nearby observatory for its source. He sets down his parcel. “Find out, but don't take long. Someone needs this medicine.”
life.story.future_letter.choice.a: Rescue the courier despite the prediction (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.future_letter.choice.b: Study the branching letters without obeying them (Insight check: target 17)
life.story.future_letter.choice.c: Sell the letter to a collector
life.story.future_letter.decision: Following the letter's clues, you reach the deserted observatory and find dozens of conflicting predictions. An echo resembling you copies your movements but offers different answers to the same question. The courier is still waiting at the bridge. You must decide what to make of these predictions before returning to his predicament.
life.story.future_letter.a: After you rescue him the messenger checks the medicine. “I can manage the rest of the road.” You put the letter away and choose your own direction.
life.story.future_letter.a.later: The predicted hour passed, but that day's account ended with the courier rescued rather than the letter fulfilled.
life.story.future_letter.b: You organize the conflicting letters as preparation for later deductions. The more you study them the less reason you have to treat any one as a certain future.
life.story.future_letter.b.later: The letters you preserved still gave several endings for the same day. Nobody could arrange them into one timeline.
life.story.future_letter.c: The collector pays and records your account along with the letters. As you leave he asks another visitor about you; your movements have become part of his research.
life.story.future_letter.c.later: The collector bought the letters together with what they revealed about your movements, an additional part of the sale.
life.story.future_letter.withdrawn: You fold the letter and stop investigating its origin without following the course written on the page.
life.story.heretic_orphan.title: The Heretic's Orphan
life.story.heretic_orphan.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.heretic_orphan.opening: At the sect gate you find Officer Wen stopping a nineteen-year-old medicine carrier, Shen He. She has come to make an agreed delivery. Wen brings up her father's old heretic case and warns that pursuers could follow her here. Shen opens her bag. “Are you inspecting the medicine, or do you want me to confess to what my father did?”
life.story.heretic_orphan.choice.evidenc: Separate the evidence from her parentage (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.heretic_orphan.evidence: The old case concerns Shen's father, without evidence of her involvement. Officer Wen worries about pursuers. “You can arrange supervision,” she says. “Being afraid of trouble doesn't establish that I've committed a crime.”
life.story.heretic_orphan.choice.a: Escort Shen He to a supervised refuge (nonlethal battle)
life.story.heretic_orphan.choice.b: Demand a monitored hearing (Charm check: target 14)
life.story.heretic_orphan.decision: When the officers arrive, Shen shoulders the inspected medicine bag and asks where they mean to take her and for how long. Wen waits for your proposal: shelter, a supervised hearing or service in return for permission to remain. Shen watches you, insisting that every condition be stated in front of her.
life.story.heretic_orphan.a: Shen registers at the supervised refuge after confirming that she can continue medical study. She keeps the access and appeal conditions. Her entry records her own history instead of treating her father's case as her offense.
life.story.heretic_orphan.a.later: The shelter arrangement left room for Shen's medical study, recording her own name and history.
life.story.heretic_orphan.b: The detention now has a written limit with oversight and appeal. Shen keeps her copy. “I still can't leave but somebody will have to answer when I can.”
life.story.heretic_orphan.b.later: The hearing agreement specified its deadline and avenue of appeal, with the overseer's signature beneath the detention terms.
life.story.heretic_orphan.c: Shen performs the service you demand and speaks less with each day. What she remembers is that you knew she had nowhere to go and used it to obtain her agreement.
life.story.heretic_orphan.c.later: The coercion behind her service remained in the file after payment had been settled.
life.story.heretic_orphan.withdrawn: You explain that you will not intervene further and tell Shen what the old case contains. The officers are still waiting and she must continue arguing over her own future.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.title: The Shop That Pawned Tomorrow
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.opening: Seeking treatment at Wen Su's pharmacy, you notice a contract offering care today in exchange for future time. A stopped clock behind her replays a girl's arrival home. “My daughter,” Wen says as she weighs your medicine. “She's gone. Each day I borrow lets me see that moment again. Your treatment is a separate bargain.”
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.eviden: Inspect the repeated day (Insight check: target 17)
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.evidence: Wen shows you the jammed hourglass holding that moment. Each borrowed interval pays for another replay. “I know fixing it means letting it go,” she says, still watching the clock. Your treatment contract remains unsigned.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.a: Repair the clock and release the memory (Formation check: target 17)
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.b: Borrow one future action for healing
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.c: Break the clock wraith and close the shop
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.decision: Three hourglasses sustain the replay. Repair would let time continue, while destroying the spirit would ruin the pharmacy. Wen offers treatment for one action next year. A separate soul-bearing pill lies on the counter; she cannot establish its origin and warns that it carries a remnant's risk.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.a: Once the hourglasses are repaired Wen says goodbye to the memory. When she reopens she offers her alchemy notes. “I neglected these while I waited for the clock. We could go through them together.”
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.a.later: The clock's account stopped at its final replay, giving Wen's preserved memory an ending at last.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.b: After treatment you confirm that only one action next year is committed. Wen gives you a copy without claiming the rest of your future.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.b.later: The contract reserved one action next year, its unpaid balance recorded beside the treatment received today.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.c: With the clock spirit broken Wen leaves the shop and pauses before closing its door. The goods inside still belong to their owner rather than passing to you.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.c.later: The closure account recorded Wen's release alongside the loss of the pharmacy, making the cost visible on both sides.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.withdrawn: You decline the contract and explain that you are leaving. Wen puts it away and glances towards the back room beneath the stopped clock.
life.story.heart_steps.title: The Steps That Asked No Question
life.story.heart_steps.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.heart_steps.opening: A flight of stone steps at the end of the mountain path offers a trial of judgment. Its keeper, a preserved remnant, asks you to sit before deciding whether to enter. The steps can replay lived memories or present imagined dilemmas. “I'll tell you which is which,” it says. “If you wish to climb, we can talk about the choices you've made.”
life.story.heart_steps.choice.evidence: Face the remembered choice honestly (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.heart_steps.evidence: The keeper asks you to check the scene against your life. “Where there's a record we'll use it. Otherwise this is a fictional trial and I won't call it your memory.”
life.story.heart_steps.choice.a: Adapt instead of repeating yourself (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.heart_steps.choice.b: Force your way to the summit (nonlethal battle)
life.story.heart_steps.choice.c: Turn back and leave the trial
life.story.heart_steps.decision: A cry rises from below within the trial, while the top of the steps shows you continuing upward. The keeper reminds you that this is the dilemma it presented. “Now you can hear it and see what lies ahead. Will you turn back, seek help or continue? Tell me why.”
life.story.heart_steps.a: You explain the choice without reshaping it into a more flattering account. As the steps dissolve the question that kept circling feels easier to carry.
life.story.heart_steps.a.later: The steps retained your answer, with each acknowledged experience named for what it was.
life.story.heart_steps.b: You reach the upper steps and gain experience from the trial, but the earlier question remains unanswered. Climbing higher has not settled it.
life.story.heart_steps.b.later: The ascent reached its conclusion, while the unanswered question remained on the same page.
life.story.heart_steps.c: The keeper lets you walk away. Back on the mountain road you keep thinking about why you left but this attempt at the trial is over.
life.story.heart_steps.c.later: What you learned in leaving came from the decision to turn back. The unfinished steps remained unfinished.
life.story.heart_steps.withdrawn: You leave before committing further without answering the keeper. The image fades behind you and the road leads back the way you came.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.title: The Caravan's Unfinished Contract
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.objec: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.openi: Merchant Luo offers you an escort job for a spiritual artifact addressed to the Black Crane Buyer. Before he finishes naming his price, a voice comes from the crate. “I'm Qiuyue. Ask him what they're going to do with me.” Luo admits the artifact holds a spirit, but keeps his hand on the seal while he waits for your answer.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.choic: Read the escort contract (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.evide: The paperwork gives the buyer forty years of Qiuyue's service. “I never agreed to that,” she says. The escort agreement is an ordinary commercial contract rather than a blood oath binding you.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.choic: Expose the scheme and face the retrieval guards
Negotiate Qiuyue's freedom (100 simulation wealth; Charm check: target 14)
Deliver her knowingly for the agreed payment
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.decis: The Black Crane Buyer's guards arrive at the caravan demanding delivery. Still bound in the crate, Qiuyue asks for release. Luo waits with the contract: pay to end the trade, expose it and face the recipient, or deliver. You have not yet handed over the crate for him.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.a: You pay to end the restraints. Qiuyue stands beside the crate. “We could travel together sometime if you ask me first.” She is free to deal with you independently.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.a.lat: Qiuyue's release named her free, with the spaces for recipient and new owner struck through.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.b: After the confrontation, the sale documents reach witnesses on the trade road and Luo releases the crate's restraints. Qiuyue escapes, but the buyer records your name and intends to pursue the interrupted transaction.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.b.lat: Once the sale was exposed, the trade-road confrontation had a public cause. The waybill could no longer conceal Qiuyue's name.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.c: While the buyer counts your payment Qiuyue asks why you delivered her knowing what would happen. You receive the money and she remembers you as an accomplice.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.c.lat: The delivery receipt recorded arrival, and that you had continued after hearing Qiuyue speak.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.withd: You withdraw from the escort and explain what you know. The caravan must decide what comes next while Qiuyue continues trying to get out of the crate.
life.story.silent_elder.title: The Elder Who Stopped Speaking
life.story.silent_elder.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.silent_elder.opening: The sect asks you to examine a widening rift. Yunxia meets you at the cordon with an anchor diagram drawn by Elder Han Xu, who is still inside maintaining the seal. He has communicated only in writing for thirty years. “I think someone altered the orders,” she says, unfolding the sheet. “He can spare time for a few words. We'd better ask the right questions.”
life.story.silent_elder.choice.evidence: Read the elder's written diagram (Formation check: target 17)
life.story.silent_elder.evidence: Han Xu answers in writing. Yunxia shows you the connections. “A spoken promise would give the rift another anchor. Let him write whatever you need to ask.”
life.story.silent_elder.choice.a: Share the anchor duty with willing protectors (Formation check: target 17) (shared anchor upkeep: 20 simulation wealth each year; unpaid upkeep raises local danger)
life.story.silent_elder.choice.b: Evacuate and relocate the sect (Charm check: target 17)
life.story.silent_elder.choice.c: Seize rift power against the sentinel
life.story.silent_elder.decision: The rift corrupts the array's sentinel constructs, turning them against its three anchors. Han puts down his brush to hold the seal while Yunxia reads his plans: volunteers to share it, evacuation, or the risk of taking power. The foundations keep cracking and someone must act.
life.story.silent_elder.a: Volunteers share the maintenance and the sect remains. Han Xu provides a limited continuation of his method with the annual twenty-wealth upkeep clearly recorded rather than pretending the anchors sustain themselves.
life.story.silent_elder.a.later: The volunteer roster carried an annual upkeep of twenty wealth on its next page. Those accepting the anchors had read both.
life.story.silent_elder.b: Once the others leave with the recoverable texts, Han follows the planned shutdown order to disengage from the old anchors and withdraw. Looking back, Yunxia says, “When we rebuild, let's choose somewhere he won't have to hold together day and night.”
life.story.silent_elder.b.later: The relocation list struck out the old site and itemized the teachings carried away, leaving its losses visible.
life.story.silent_elder.c: You take a small amount of the rift's power and leave injuries and a regional crisis behind. Yunxia deals with the damage rather than treating your gain as mastery of every realm.
life.story.silent_elder.c.later: The power taken was limited. Injuries and the rift's damage filled most of the account.
life.story.silent_elder.withdrawn: You return the diagram and explain that you cannot take this further. Han Xu remains beside the anchors without speaking to stop you.
life.story.tribulation.title: When the Heavens Answer
life.story.tribulation.objective: Body / meridians / will: stabilize three knots
life.story.tribulation.opening: As your cultivation reaches the threshold of a major realm, tribulation clouds begin to gather. At the trial platform the attendants move spectators beyond danger and leave you time to inspect the preparations. The thunder is still distant enough to seek help or postpone. Once you enter, your own body and cultivation must bear what follows.
life.story.tribulation.choice.evidence: Prepare the platform and protect bystanders (Formation check: target 14)
life.story.tribulation.evidence: You inspect the platform and clear the bystanders before deciding whether to invite living guardians. Preparation makes the risks clearer without guaranteeing success.
life.story.tribulation.choice.a: Commit to the three-phase tribulation (LETHAL simulation battle)
life.story.tribulation.choice.b: Delay the breakthrough and preserve cultivation
life.story.tribulation.decision: The clouds settle over the platform as the trials of body, meridians and will take shape. You can complete the three knots or attempt to disperse the clouds. Withdrawal means leaving with the resources already spent and injuries already sustained, to seek another chance. The attendant steps beyond the line and waits for your decision.
life.story.tribulation.a: The last knot settles and the clouds clear after your breakthrough. Further cultivation still depends on the limits of the method you actually practice.
life.story.tribulation.a.later: That trial became a threshold in the cultivation record. Practice beyond it still began with the next unearned step.
life.story.tribulation.b: You withdraw from the platform, account for supplies already spent and arrange recovery for any injuries sustained. Your realm remains unchanged, with another attempt still possible.
life.story.tribulation.b.later: The account of leaving the platform retained the injuries and the breakthrough left incomplete.
life.story.tribulation.c: The knots break after you have spent the strength needed to retreat. This simulated life ends on the platform without injuring the real character.
life.story.tribulation.c.later: The trial was the last event of that simulated life. Others recorded what remained in its history.
life.story.tribulation.withdrawn: You stop before committing further and put away the preparations. The breakthrough waits while your existing cultivation remains for a later decision.
life.story.inner_demon.title: The Voice That Knows Your Name
life.story.inner_demon.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.inner_demon.opening: After days of demanding practice, the same voice follows you even into rest. Sometimes it worries at an old regret; sometimes it calls exhaustion a failure of character. The harder you suppress it, the clearer it becomes. Tonight, after you finish training, it asks again, “How long do you mean to pretend you can't hear me?”
life.story.inner_demon.choice.evidence: Identify the remembered anchor (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.inner_demon.evidence: You listen closely enough to separate things you actually did from the voice's habit of turning exhaustion into fault. An unsettled oath calls for examining its terms; accumulated strain calls for rest. The shadow keeps pressing, but this time you take time to consider its accusations.
life.story.inner_demon.choice.a: Integrate the memory rather than deny it (Insight check: target 17)
life.story.inner_demon.choice.c: Accept help and pay for recovery (100 simulation wealth)
life.story.inner_demon.decision: The demon copies your repeated movements and waits for the same response. Acknowledgment, a different approach or help from someone living and trusted may break the loop; failure means strain rather than automatic death.
life.story.inner_demon.a: You work through the sources of strain instead of treating exhaustion itself as a fault. You face what needs responsibility and allow rest where it is needed. The demon loses its repeated accusations' hold, and your breathing settles.
life.story.inner_demon.a.later: The strain acknowledged then found its source, and the past no longer needed the shadow to give it words.
life.story.inner_demon.b: You silence the voice by force and end this confrontation. Returning to practice you still know the cause that formed it has not been addressed.
life.story.inner_demon.b.later: The suppression halted that episode. The underlying trouble remained in the recovery notes, awaiting attention.
life.story.inner_demon.c: You pay for care and the person assisting you helps keep you grounded while treatment and rest take effect. Trust grows through the time you spend getting through it together.
life.story.inner_demon.c.later: The care account included medicine, rest and time spent helping through the ordeal. Trust grew out of those ordinary acts.
life.story.inner_demon.withdrawn: You withdraw from the confrontation without pretending the pressure is resolved. Rest and assistance remain decisions for afterward.
life.story.sect_invasion.title: The Night the Sect Burned
life.story.sect_invasion.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.sect_invasion.opening: The dispute between the two sects has reached the mountain gate. You arrive in the outer court as fire spreads through the galleries and disciples carry out the wounded and the texts. The attackers, led by the Red Willow Captain, press towards the evacuation route. A defender catches your arm. “Can you help hold this stretch? There are still people inside.”
life.story.sect_invasion.choice.evidence: Inspect the old command token (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.sect_invasion.evidence: An injured disciple picks up a token dropped by the threshold and recognizes the Red Willow Army's mark. You have evidence of the attackers' identity, but the evacuation road remains threatened and people outside still need help.
life.story.sect_invasion.choice.a: Hold the evacuation route against the invaders
life.story.sect_invasion.choice.c: Rescue people and abandon the old gate
life.story.sect_invasion.decision: The Red Willow Captain sends another squad forward. Wounded people and texts still wait beside the evacuation route. The defender estimates six rounds before it is overrun and asks you to assign capable companions. Holding the line, abandoning the site with its teachings or negotiating a ceasefire each leaves different people waiting for instructions.
life.story.sect_invasion.a: The defense holds until the evacuation finishes and survivors and texts are counted. The disciples can finally rest although the damage to the sect will take longer to repair.
life.story.sect_invasion.a.later: The list made after holding the road named the people and texts saved, alongside the gate that could not be preserved.
life.story.sect_invasion.b: You abandon the old gate and lead the disciples away with their teachings. Some keep looking back until the fire disappears; the sect survives without keeping its former home intact.
life.story.sect_invasion.b.later: The first relocation account began with the abandoned gate and ended by checking the teachings brought away.
life.story.sect_invasion.c: The agreed ceasefire lets both sides withdraw. Its concessions change local politics while sparing civilians from another round of fighting.
life.story.sect_invasion.c.later: The ceasefire set out each side's concessions. Evacuation resumed under those signatures.
life.story.sect_invasion.withdrawn: You withdraw and pass your observations to those still coordinating the defense. The alarm continues and the unfinished evacuation is not counted as your achievement.
life.story.oath_collection.title: The Debt Written in Blood
life.story.oath_collection.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.oath_collection.opening: An oath collector arrives with the agreement you accepted and an account of its breach. He lays out the original terms, the due date and the exceptions for you to inspect. “This is the agreement I'm here about,” he says. “If the claim is wrong, show me what happened.”
life.story.oath_collection.choice.eviden: Examine the original oath (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.oath_collection.evidence: The original terms, breach evidence and exceptions are laid out together. The collector waits until you have read them. “Will you compensate or tell me which clause you dispute?”
life.story.oath_collection.choice.b: Request the creditor's release (Charm check: target 17)
life.story.oath_collection.decision: The collector has the strength specified in the oath and cannot surrender the creditor's claim. Defeating him would interrupt this visit without replacing repayment or voluntary release.
life.story.oath_collection.a: You pay the stated compensation and receive the settlement record. The breach is repaired and this oath no longer pursues you.
life.story.oath_collection.a.later: Once compensation was paid, the collector dated the settlement beside the original oath and left an agreed receipt.
life.story.oath_collection.b: The collector carries the release request to the creditor and returns with a voluntarily signed waiver. After you check it against the original oath, he closes the document and confirms the claim ended.
life.story.oath_collection.b.later: The release bore the creditor's signature, bringing the oath to an ending both parties accepted.
life.story.oath_collection.c: This attempt at collection ends and the messenger leaves, but the oath is unsettled. Without repayment or the creditor's release, a quiet interval cannot erase the debt.
life.story.oath_collection.c.later: That collection was recorded as interrupted, with the unsettled oath retained separately.
life.story.oath_collection.withdrawn: You withdraw without making a further promise or calling the claim settled. The original oath and its breach remain to be addressed.
life.story.spirit_mist.title: The Mist That Eats the Road
life.story.spirit_mist.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.spirit_mist.opening: The road through the village is short, yet you reach the same milestone for the third time. A familiar voice calls from the fog while villagers cry for help near the well. As you approach the familiar face, it breaks into moths. The cries by the well continue, begging you to stop following the images.
life.story.spirit_mist.choice.evidence: Mark the repeating landmarks (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.spirit_mist.evidence: Your trail marks bring you to a cellar entrance beside the old well. Villagers sheltered below from the moths, but the looping roads trapped them. They ask where the exit is while apparitions beckon elsewhere.
life.story.spirit_mist.choice.a: Purify the well anchor (Formation check: target 17)
life.story.spirit_mist.choice.b: Evacuate the villagers and seal the ruins
life.story.spirit_mist.decision: Following the markers to the well, you see how its old core feeds the moths and the village fog. The trapped villagers still need a guide. Cleansing the core and keeping the settlement, evacuating before destroying the contamination, or following the route out alone lead to different resolutions.
life.story.spirit_mist.a: Cleansing the core restores the roads and lets the villagers come up from the cellar. You record the toxin and illusion signs for those continuing their care.
life.story.spirit_mist.a.later: The cleansing and reopened road received a date. The faces mistaken in the fog had no place on the rescue list.
life.story.spirit_mist.b: You evacuate the villagers before burning the contaminated settlement. From safety someone watches their roof burn; survival has not made losing home easy.
life.story.spirit_mist.b.later: Evacuated villagers and destroyed homes filled adjoining pages. Resettlement followed from there.
life.story.spirit_mist.c: You escape alone with injuries and exposure still affecting you. The people in the well have not been rescued and you see nobody following you out.
life.story.spirit_mist.c.later: That escape found a route for one person. The calls for help were left unanswered when you reached clear air.
life.story.spirit_mist.withdrawn: You retreat along the stretch of road you can still recognize and leave the warnings you have actually established. You do not follow the apparitions farther. The village rescue remains unfinished.
life.story.rival_return.title: The Rival at the Gate
life.story.rival_return.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.rival_return.opening: A rival from an old dispute arrives at your door with its keepsake and asks whether you remember what happened. “If you won't talk, we can settle it in a duel.” He rests a hand on his sword and waits.
life.story.rival_return.choice.evidence: Review the recorded grievance (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.rival_return.evidence: He offers a duel but leaves the evidence on the table. “If you want to discuss compensation do it now.” The old grievance still needs to be examined rather than shouted away.
life.story.rival_return.choice.a: Duel and spare the rival (nonlethal battle)
life.story.rival_return.choice.b: Settle the grievance through restitution (100 wealth; Charm check: target 14)
life.story.rival_return.choice.c: Accept a lethal duel (simulation death risk)
life.story.rival_return.decision: Your rival watches your sword hand and waits for your answer. You can agree to restraint or continue discussing settlement. A lethal duel would change the stakes beyond an ending by submission.
life.story.rival_return.a: You establish the facts and compensation and finish talking without weapons in hand. Hostility eases towards neutrality rather than becoming instant friendship.
life.story.rival_return.a.later: The settlement preserved the grievance and compensation, with each party signing beneath the account they accepted.
life.story.rival_return.b: You win and stop when you could strike harder. Your rival acknowledges the result; the grievance remains but there is room to speak again.
life.story.rival_return.b.later: The duel ended with restraint after victory. The old grievance remained, but no death was added to it.
life.story.rival_return.c: The lethal duel ends with your rival dead. He will not return to your door but living people connected to him may judge what happened.
life.story.rival_return.c.later: The rival's name moved from the relationship account to the dead. That encounter left no chance to arrange another.
life.story.rival_return.withdrawn: You end the meeting without claiming reconciliation and leave the token as a reminder of where the dispute began.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.title: The Mountain Loses Its Breath
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.opening: The mountain's failing vein has opened cracks from the mine passages to the village. When you arrive, the keeper is counting evacuees while three spiritual pillars barely support the heart below. “Some workers are still down there. We haven't recovered all the records either.” He points to the entrance. “First find out which routes will hold. Then we can talk about blame.”
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.choice.e: Survey the fracture and its recorded cause (Formation check: target 14)
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.evidence: Three spiritual pillars barely hold the vein. The keeper offers the damage records. “This is what we can check. We need the supports secured before we start naming culprits.”
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.choice.b: Close the mine and evacuate everyone
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.choice.c: Escape and abandon the damaged vein
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.decision: A fracture construct gathers beside the three pillars and advances with the vein's tremors. The keeper recognizes a form produced by damage to the heart and urges you not to linger. The crack grows each round. You must stay to stabilize the pillars or close the shaft and get people out.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.a: The pillars stabilize and the miners can rest. Contributors and future maintenance duties are recorded before the area begins recovering.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.a.later: After the three pillars were secured, the maintainers signed beside their duties, turning the rescue into continuing responsibility.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.b: You evacuate the workers first, then use the surveyed fracture lines to close and destroy the shaft, relieving the mountain's pressure. The neighboring villages survive, but the mine's livelihood ends.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.b.later: The closure ended the mine's income and left the neighboring villages on ground spared from collapse.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.c: You reach safety before the greater collapse. The mine is permanently damaged and the survivors must move elsewhere rather than resume their old lives.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.c.later: After the passage describing your escape, the disaster account continued through mine damage and displaced survivors.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.withdraw: You stop advancing and pass on what you saw at the supports. Leaving the encounter does not finish the work of securing the mine.
life.story.friend_betrayal.title: The Friend with a Drawn Sword
life.story.friend_betrayal.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.friend_betrayal.opening: A longtime friend waits on the mountain road and draws his sword across your path. His demand for your belongings sounds rehearsed. You notice fresh restraint marks on his wrists. As you step closer he raises the blade, but his eyes move past your shoulder towards the trees.
life.story.friend_betrayal.choice.eviden: Read the signs of coercion (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.friend_betrayal.evidence: Following your friend's glance, you see his fellow traveler Song Shi bound among the trees. He whispers that masked captors threatened Song's life to make him delay you. “They're watching. Don't let them know I've told you.” The ropes remain in place; you still need a way to approach.
life.story.friend_betrayal.decision: Your friend shifts the blade to show the route behind him. You could stage a restrained duel and confront the kidnappers together or separate without killing. Lethal retaliation remains a deliberate choice.
life.story.friend_betrayal.a: The captive is freed but your friend does not immediately reach for your hand. He thanks you and still needs time to explain; only part of the trust returns.
life.story.friend_betrayal.a.later: The rescue file explained Song Shi's captivity and the coercion. Trust between friends had to be rebuilt after the explanation.
life.story.friend_betrayal.b: You put away your weapons and go separately. The old friendship becomes neutral rather than an obligation for him to keep fighting beside you.
life.story.friend_betrayal.b.later: No further promise to travel together was made that day. The old friendship remained in the past as your paths parted.
life.story.friend_betrayal.c: The confrontation ends with your friend's death. Your intended ending cannot change the result. The coercion behind it remains, as do the consequences of losing the relationship.
life.story.friend_betrayal.c.later: Your friend's death gave the coercion an irreversible ending. The relationship account stopped there.
life.story.friend_betrayal.withdrawn: You withdraw instead of prolonging the staged confrontation. The kidnappers and their captive remain to be dealt with; departure is not a rescue.
life.story.pill_soul.title: The Second Soul in the Pill
life.story.pill_soul.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.pill_soul.opening: The soul-bearing pill you took earlier begins to disturb your awareness. A voice within its medicinal force names itself Yan Qiu and asks to speak before you continue refining it. You pause your practice and try to locate the connection. The remnant falls quiet too, waiting for an answer.
life.story.pill_soul.choice.evidence: Quarantine the suspicious medicine (Insight check: target 14)
life.story.pill_soul.evidence: The seal preserves Yan Qiu while restricting part of your awareness. You try to isolate the medicine and identify the connections before hearing his account, rather than refining them into a tighter bond.
life.story.pill_soul.choice.a: Archive the remnant with consent (Insight check: target 17)
life.story.pill_soul.choice.b: Purge the soul and discard the pill benefit
life.story.pill_soul.decision: After telling his history, Yan Qiu urges you to resume refining. You can still feel the limits of his pill-bound strength; neither of you can be certain of overpowering the other. You could negotiate a memory-only agreement or purge the medicine. Forcing absorption risks losing control of the connection.
life.story.pill_soul.a: You agree on a limited memory arrangement and retain a little knowledge. Your identity and cultivation remain your own rather than becoming Yan Qiu's.
life.story.pill_soul.a.later: The agreement specified the memories Yan Qiu could share. His cultivation did not pass with the signature.
life.story.pill_soul.b: Purification removes the medicine and its voice along with the pill's benefits. Your meridians now need recovery rather than another dose.
life.story.pill_soul.b.later: Purification forfeited the pill's benefits. The recovery account then followed the healing of the meridians.
life.story.pill_soul.c: While the remnant is being dealt with, the seal fails and the conflict between medicine and awareness becomes uncontrollable. This simulated life ends without injuring the real character.
life.story.pill_soul.c.later: The uncontrolled pill calamity became the end of that simulated life. Its remaining account could only be entered in its history.
life.story.pill_soul.withdrawn: You stop further contact and retain what you learned. Withdrawing does not cure the pill's effects and treatment can still be sought afterward.
life.story.dynasty_end.title: The Last Winter of the Dynasty
life.story.dynasty_end.opening: Winter comes without an end to the regional crisis, and village wells fail. Qin Ruo, organizing relief, asks you to examine reports while Chu An returns from tracing the arrays. Water and Qi flow towards the capital. “Let's see how it works,” Qin says. “We need routes people can still use.”
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.evidence: Trace the distributed well anchors (Formation check: target 17)
life.story.dynasty_end.evidence: The well arrays match the established regional crisis. Qin says, “Even if we can't defeat the guards we can move grain and help people out. Somebody still needs to examine the outer anchors.”
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.a: Break the central ritual in battle (taking rule: 30 simulation wealth each year; unpaid governance increases local unrest)
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.b: Negotiate a council and dismantle the wells (Charm check: target 17)
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.c: Rescue civilians and refuse the throne
life.story.dynasty_end.decision: Qin and Chu mark the gate, outer anchors and central ritual on the same map. Well guards still hold the approaches while people outside wait for water. You can defeat the guards and take authority, seek a council to dismantle the arrays or concentrate on evacuating civilians. They begin allocating relief supplies and wait for your plan.
life.story.dynasty_end.a: The council begins managing resources once diverted to the capital. Qin leaves the accounts open. “Now we can discuss it. We still have to decide who manages what and do the work.”
life.story.dynasty_end.a.later: The council and dismantled arrays entered the record together. Relief and governance still needed people to carry them through.
life.story.dynasty_end.b: After the former authorities retreat, your side takes temporary charge of the wells and stores, and the remaining administration falls to you. Wealth and authority arrive with an annual governance cost of thirty wealth written into the handover.
life.story.dynasty_end.b.later: The governance accounts paired the gained wealth with an annual cost of thirty wealth. Taking authority was the beginning of the obligation.
life.story.dynasty_end.c: You refuse the throne and find homes for civilians and refugees. Chu rests only after the final group is placed; the dynasty's damage will require more than relocation to repair.
life.story.dynasty_end.c.later: That rescue ended with a list of civilians housed. Succession to the dynasty was no part of its achievement.
life.story.dynasty_end.withdrawn: You withdraw and leave Qin and Chu your findings about the wells and rescue routes. The crisis continues beyond what the report has established.

life.replacement.third_bell.title: The Third Bell
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.title: A Debt by the Stove
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.0: You are lodging at Reedbank's clinic when the healer Du Fen asks for help investigating the sluice. She cannot leave her patients, and her son Qiao has not returned from the gate. She has just pushed a bowl of rice towards you when the village bell rings. At the third stroke she pauses and turns towards the door.
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.1: Du: “We ring it once when we draw water in the morning and twice in the evening. There shouldn't be a third stroke.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.3: Du: “There shouldn't be anyone pulling it after my son took the rope down yesterday.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.5: Du: “His name's Qiao Sheng and he still hasn't come home.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.6: You: “And you want me to fetch him.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.7: Du: “I want him home more than anything. What I need you to do is find out what's happened and come back before the third sunrise whether he's with you or not.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.9: Du: “I've got six patients who throw up every time they drink and I can't leave them on their own.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.10: She hands you a folded message asking Qiao to return, then takes it back long enough to add a line.
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.11: Du: “Would you tell him I've left his boots by the stove? I'd rather he didn't hear about me crying.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.A: “I'll find him and make sure he gets a hearing before anyone takes him into custody.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.B: “I'll ask the sect what happened before I promise more than an honest report.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.title: Grains on Iron
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.0: Following the sound of water, you reach the village mill. Its owner Tao Wen is examining a leaking wheel shaft. He catches some water in a cup and shows you the black particles settling at the bottom.
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.1: Tao: “Everyone blames my millstones, but a magnet picks these particles up. They aren't stone dust.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.3: Tao: “He brought a magnet. Then he nailed the lower drain shut.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.4: You: “Wouldn't blocking the drain make things worse?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.5: Tao: “I didn’t say he was clever.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.6: He unfolds a rubbing of an order: an extra daily draw, ten days only. Du’s witness mark sits beside Ren Bo’s seal.
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.8: Tao: “You'll have to ask her why. I wasn't there when she signed.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.en_us.10: Tao: “If you help me brace the old walkway we can have it ready in half a day. Twelve stones would pay three workers to do it sooner. You could try the sect gate instead if you think they'll let us through.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.A: “I’ll stay and help you brace it.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.B: “I'll pay the twelve stones so the workers can start now.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S02.C: “Let's take the order with us and try to get through the sect gate.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.title: The Steward’s Hand
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.0: The sect has set up a temporary checkpoint at the ruined shrine. Steward Xu Lan sits beside a cracked brass regulator, holding its trembling rim shut. Tao explains that he is the village's appointed observer and asks Xu to let you inspect it with him.
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.1: Xu: “Watch where you put your feet so you don't catch my hand as you cross the channel.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.2: You: “You’re Foundation Establishment. Can’t you stop this?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.3: Xu: “I'm holding the crack shut because if this housing breaks the pressure will go straight downhill.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.6: You: “Then why is it still running?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.7: Xu: “Because closing the upper intake before the lower valve breaks it.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.11: Xu: “The man my clerk says sabotaged it.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.13: Xu: “I haven't had a chance to ask Qiao. Until I do, I'm not calling him a saboteur.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.14: He sets a stamped inspection pass within reach of your free hand.
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.en_us.15: Xu: “I can order an inspection or close the sluice in an emergency but I have no authority to take the village fields. Take Tao with you because he knows which floorboards are still safe.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S03.B: “We’ll use the old channel. Inspection isn’t permission to arrest him.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.title: The Falling Record Room
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.0: The old shrine’s walkway hangs above an overflow channel. Beyond it, a red register lies in a room with a buckling floor.
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.1: Tao: “That's where Qiao keeps his water records and the shelf won't stay dry much longer.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.2: You: “He could have brought it out.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.3: Qiao, from behind the lower wall: “I had both hands on a valve.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.5: Qiao: “I did, but you couldn't hear me over the water. I knocked on the pipe too. Up there all you could hear was the bell.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.6: Everyone falls quiet as a stone breaks loose overhead and drops into the water below.
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.7: Qiao: “You can get to me through the low channel. But you won't reach the shelf from there.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.9: Qiao: “I've recorded when they drew water and how often they did it. Those numbers don't match the totals Ren sends up the mountain.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.en_us.10: Tao: “We can reach him without it. Decide which risk you’re taking.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.A: “Use the safe crossing we already have.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S04.C: “We should get to Qiao before trying to save the register.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.title: The Infirmary Account
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.0: Ren Bo waits at the inspection desk. He keeps his account case away from the leaking wall.
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.1: Ren: “I'll need to see your pass before I let you through regardless of your cultivation.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.3: Ren: “Behind the lower valve. Refusing a lawful summons.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.4: Tao: “So the nails in our drain were part of your summons?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.7: Ren opens a ten-day emergency order bearing Du’s mark.
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.8: Ren: “Water sales keep twenty-three patients in our mountain infirmary.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.10: Ren: “Fourteen. The others never had a spirit root.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.11: Tao: “Ten days. When did it stop?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.en_us.13: Ren: “You'll have to decide whether to inspect the register or go after Qiao first. The record room's taking on water fast enough that the book may be ruined by the time you get back.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S05.B: “Qiao first, even if that costs us the register.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.title: Forty-Two Days
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.0: Once the red register is recovered, Tao dries his fingers before carefully opening its damp pages.
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.1: Tao: “Ren approved a third draw every day for forty-two days. Du's signature only covered ten of them.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.3: Tao: “They wouldn't need forty-two days of tests and there's a buyer listed beside each draw.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.4: You: “The payment column goes to the infirmary.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.9: Tao: “Paper and charcoal in the desk. I can make a witnessed copy. Keep yours out of Ren’s hands.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.10: Tao: “Du’s mark will travel with this.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.12: Tao: “No. I want her to answer before the square answers for her.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.13: You: “Once people see the copy, I can't control who they tell.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.en_us.14: Tao: “Then don't promise what you can't do. If we make copies, I'll witness their contents. If we seal it, we'll keep the original safe.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.A: “Make two copies. I won’t promise secrecy.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S06.B: “Seal the original. I promise not to publish it.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.title: The Barefoot Keeper
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.0: Qiao is barefoot beside the lower valve. A red line circles each wrist where he has leaned against its lever.
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.1: You: “Your boots are by the stove.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.2: Qiao: “She thinks that will bring me home?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.9: Qiao: “The lower drain carried the extra draw past our measuring weir.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.10: Tao: “You blocked it to make the theft visible.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.11: Qiao: “I thought the excess would spill outside.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.14: You: “Did you know your mother signed?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.15: Qiao: “For ten days. She told me to give them ten.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.17: Qiao: “I'd been keeping the counts and I sent in two complaints. Ren sent one back with my wages crossed out.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.18: Qiao: “That dry tin has my returned complaint and the ten-day order. Take them.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.19: Qiao: “Write down everything I did and put the complaints beside it so whoever reads it understands why I blocked the drain.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.20: Qiao: “Did you promise her a hearing before anyone takes me? Don’t trade that away quietly.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.en_us.21: Tao: “Du sent word. Another barrel of clean water is gone. Nobody has died, but we used time they needed.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.A: “Write your confession now. I’ll attach your complaints.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S07.B: “Don’t sign until they guarantee your safety.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.title: Both Things Happened
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.0: Only a low wall separates the lower valve from the regulator, so Xu can hear you. Still holding the valve lever, Qiao asks him to help test a small adjustment.
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.1: Qiao: “When I ease off, the water hits the wall. Can you hold the housing while I press the lower valve down and loosen the board over the drain?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.2: You: “The lower valve first, before the upper intake?”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.3: Xu: “Lower first. Slowly. I have the crack.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.4: As the channel reopens, black flakes wash out of the damaged sleeve. Tao follows the rising float arm and sees its connection to the bell tower's striker.
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.5: Tao: “Above the third mark the float makes the striker ring three times. It doesn't need the rope. Loosen that board a little more. There—the water can drain instead of backing into the well, and the striker has dropped again.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.6: You: “An unauthorized draw, then a bad attempt to stop it.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.7: Qiao: “Yes, I made it worse. That doesn't mean I made up the extra draw.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.8: Xu: “I witnessed it. No one touches another control without him.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.10: Xu: “A replacement sleeve. Our toll reserve will buy one, but then the infirmary loses its subsidy.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.12: Xu: “A four-summer lease on willing owners’ reed strips, for a medicinal nursery, could fund both.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.en_us.13: Qiao: “I'll put the locking pin back in the lever. That will stop the flow long enough for us to go and talk. Permanent closure means disconnecting both channels. We'd keep the rainwater pools, but lose irrigation.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.B: “Use the pass. Ask Xu to hear his statement now.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S08.C: “I'll take what we've learned back and explain what caused this.”
life.replacement.third_bell.S09.title: The Custody Order
