life.replacement.salt_baskets.S15.title: Without Ringing
Eleven stops at the last gate and you wait without pulling him through. Farther up the slope another deer glances over before returning to its grazing.
You: “Give him a moment. He might just be looking around.”
Eleven sniffs around the open gate before stepping through and pausing a little farther on while Rang watches from the path without following him among the deer.
Ruan: “The gate closes when he’s clear. Not on his heels.”
Rang: “I promised to replace the beam he broke in your shed.”
Rang: “After I watch him through the first day?”
Ruan: “Tell me if you need the day to watch him so I know when to expect you back.”
He asks. She grants it, and names the morning she expects him back.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.S15.A: “I’ll observe the first day, without a lead.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.S16.title: Not a Better Word
Ruan records what was recovered, what was paid, and who could actually speak. An injured or unconscious witness is not assigned a signature.
Ruan: “The freight money is accounted for. The salt claim comes from Rang’s bond.”
Xu: “He'll stay in supervised holding without a saddle until the review is complete.”
Ruan: “Then tell Rang when the review will happen, as soon as you know. He needs something to go on.”
Ye puts the damaged harness beside the record. If her signed account was never made, she supplies her own statement now; it does not become yours.
He accepts the answer without reaching for the bell.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.title: A Winter Without a Saddle
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.en_us.0: On its first morning in the orchard, Eleven pulls leaves through the fence. No saddle hangs in the shed.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.en_us.1: Rang: “I thought he would keep looking for the road.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.en_us.2: Ruan: “Maybe he will. Today he wants that branch.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.en_us.4: Ruan: “Ask the tree’s owner before dismantling the orchard.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.en_us.6: Ruan: “We've been paid twelve stones to keep him for the winter. The salt losses are covered too although we still have to get a cart to bring in the replacement.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.en_us.9: Ruan: “Then we'll talk again before spring fair. Don't leave it until the last day.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E1.en_us.1: Rang returns to the new latch. Eleven watches until a leaf catches his attention. For once, the work being done near him asks nothing of his back.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.title: Someone Else Can Feed Him
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.0: The station’s handler reads the retirement warrant beside Eleven.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.1: Handler: “We'll travel without a load and stop whenever he needs to rest because his flank will take time to heal.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.2: Ye: “Six months. I’ve packed my own bag.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.3: Handler: “Your answer about the job doesn’t change my duty. His care is assigned to me.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.5: Ye: “We know, Rang. You can show the keeper how he likes his feed.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.6: Rang: “I wanted it to mean he could stay.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.7: The handler accepts Eleven’s familiar feeding bowl.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.8: Rang: “He tips it if you put it too near the wall.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E2.en_us.1: Rang demonstrates the placement. This time he attaches no request to the instruction.
Handler: “What did you miss when the saddle first hurt?”
Rang: “He kept looking back at my hand. I called it impatience.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.title: Beyond the Gate
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.0: Ye's observation record for that day notes that Eleven remains visible among the pines at dusk, still apart from the other deer.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.2: Ye: “He hasn’t come back for the bell either.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.3: Ruan: “It's only been a little while. Let's watch before we decide what it means.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.4: Xu: “I'll register him as released so nobody treats him as a missing sect animal. It won't protect him from the other dangers on the mountain.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.5: Ruan: “And it doesn’t mean I promised him my crops.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.8: Rang looks at the bag where Ye keeps the bell, but does not ask for it back.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.9: You: “We’ll watch until morning, from the human path.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E3.en_us.1: You: “I’m taking the final account down. He doesn’t owe me one last look.”
Rang: “I won’t call him back for that.”
Above them, the branches move. Nobody mistakes the sound for a request.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.title: No Bandit Required
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.0: The retirement review opens with the damaged saddle laid on the clerk’s table.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.1: Xu: “The report will include the broken buckle and Ye's correction along with the count of the cargo we actually recovered.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.4: Xu: “Supervised care. No saddle while the review continues.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.5: Rang: “I gave him orders for eleven years. Waiting feels like doing nothing.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.6: Ruan: “Then come mend the beam while we wait.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.8: Ruan: “The beam didn’t break because of the result.”
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.9: She leaves a hammer on the counter. He takes it without reaching for the bell.
life.replacement.salt_baskets.E4.en_us.1: Xu: “Your witness’s complaint joins this only if they authorized it.”
Ruan: “The report's been paid for. If we need more help, we'll have to ask them again.”
The road is still difficult. There is simply no invented bandit left to blame for it.

life.replacement.salt_baskets.S14.A.requ: Xu’s confirmation of current unladen mobility and release authorization, Ruan’s consent to one passage, and settlement of cargo losses. → S15
life.replacement.salt_baskets.S14.B.requ: nothing additional. Release has not occurred. Reconsider station care. → S13
life.replacement.salt_baskets.S15.A.requ: compatible physical condition and no conflict with existing time commitments. Advance time and injuries through existing simulation rules. Observation guarantees neither herd acceptance nor permanent safety. → E3: Stayed to Observe
life.replacement.salt_baskets.S15.B.requ: ability to return independently or with assistance. Rang and Ye continue their own observation; the protagonist does not claim to witness later events. → E3: Returned to the Village
life.replacement.salt_baskets.S16.A.requ: consciousness and ability to understand and authorize the statement. Attest only what the protagonist actually knows. Add it to the continuing retirement review without guaranteeing its outcome. → E4: Named Complaint
life.replacement.salt_baskets.S16.B.requ: consciousness and ability to authorize the report. Preserve evidence and others’ independently supplied statements. → E4: Report Only
life.trial.title: Breakthrough Trial
life.trial.ready: Prepare for the breakthrough trial. Combat resources and injuries follow the existing rules.
life.trial.b: Breakthrough postponed. Actual resources and injuries are retained.
life.trial.c: Trial unsuccessful. The combat outcome is retained.
life.replacement.rain_sword.title: The Sword at Rain Ferry
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.title: The Returning Boat
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.1: You come to Rain Ferry seeking a crossing, but the ferryman Old He first asks you to hear an old story. The soldier Duan Qing died here forty-three years ago, leaving an echo in his sword still waiting for a boat. The ferryman had promised to return for him. Old He hands you a wooden ferry token. Through the rain, a rusted sword stands embedded in the bank. From within it, someone asks, “Has the last boat returned?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.7: He: “The last time I said the boat had come back it asked me who was aboard.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.11: He: “When I told it nobody was aboard the river rose right through my floorboards.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.13: He keeps his hand beneath yours until you have the token securely. Names have been cut around a military seal. One corner is rubbed almost smooth.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.15: You: “The sword holds his memories from before he died?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.17: He: “Yes. It can answer us now, but it keeps thinking it's still guarding the old landing.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.19: You: “Have you told it all this?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.21: He: “I keep telling him I'm the boy who rowed that boat but he still asks for the boatman.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.23: He flinches before the sword finishes repeating its question although the voice has grown no louder.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.en_us.25: He: “Hear me out first. There's something about that night I haven't told you.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.A: “I’ll find out what he is waiting for.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.A.requir: Requires nothing additional. Accept the investigation without promising to complete the crossing. → RS-S02
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Make no promise to resolve the oath yet. → RS-S03
life.replacement.rain_sword.S01.C.requir: Requires nothing additional. Choose to return the entrusted token and withdraw. → RS-S15
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.title: Beneath the Seal
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.1: Under the boathouse roof, He sets out water, a rag, and a narrow knife. He keeps the knife away from the token.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.3: He: “There are three passengers named here with a mark on the back for each of them.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.15: He: “I used to say everyone got across. It was easier if nobody asked who I meant.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.17: Dark wax fills a groove beneath the military stamp. Rain has exposed a pale edge.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.21: He: “Perhaps you can read it without damaging it. Or we let the wax soften.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.25: He: “By the time the wax softened we'd have missed this evening's slack water and have to wait until tomorrow.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.29: He: “Me. I close the ferry when the sword starts asking.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.en_us.31: He puts the rag beside you, not into your hand.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.A.requir: Requires nothing additional. He cleans and reads the inscription completely. Spend one waiting interval and record the missed slack water. → RS-S04
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.B.requir: Requires the existing event system to permit this Insight check. Use its saved Insight target 11 result without rerolling.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S02.C.requir: Requires nothing additional. Do not obtain the complete token reading. → RS-S05
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.title: The Granary Guard
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.1: He explains that Duan had been ordered to guard the granary but left it to defend the ferry. A figure gathers above the sword, its left arm fading into the rain, its eyes fixed on where the old landing stood.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.7: Duan’s remnant: “Then stand clear of the return rope.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.11: Duan’s remnant: “I can feel it pulling.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.13: He does not turn towards the ferryman.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.15: You: “Why did you leave the granary?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.17: Duan’s remnant: “They were shutting its gates. The people outside had nowhere left to go.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.19: You: “Your order was to guard the grain.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.23: You: “I’m asking why you disobeyed it.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.25: Duan’s remnant: “A girl kept trying to hand her mother over the wall. She wasn’t strong enough.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.29: Duan’s remnant: “Did they reach the boat?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.en_us.33: Duan’s remnant: “Please find out whether they reached the other bank so I can stop wondering.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.A.requir: Requires nothing additional. He retrieves the register. → RS-S04
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Record that you asked about ownership early. This grants no claim to the sword. → RS-S05
life.replacement.rain_sword.S03.C.requir: Requires the character’s ability to make a voluntary promise. Record the commitment to complete the last crossing; create no new magical-oath mechanic. → RS-S04
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.title: After They Landed
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.1: He opens an old household register. His boat lamp lights three entries copied beside the same passenger names.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.3: He: “I knew them after they landed: the woman ran a food stall and the farmer went back to his fields while the child grew up here.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.5: You: “Then the figures on the water aren’t their trapped souls.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.7: He: “The sword remembers them waiting on the bank but I knew them as living people long after the crossing.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.9: You: “Did they know you never returned?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.11: He: “They knew I took them across. Nobody asked what I promised before leaving.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.13: A loose receipt slips out. Its instruction is plain: bring the boat back for the guard.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.17: He: “I kept meaning to get rid of it. Then I'd put it back in the drawer.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.19: You: “What happened to the return rope?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.21: He looks at the receipt instead of the river.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.23: He: “Come see where it was tied.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.27: He: “There’s paper in the fare book.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.29: You: “You can write it for me?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.en_us.31: He: “And read it back. I won’t make you take my markings on trust.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.A.requir: Requires nothing additional. Obtain He’s confirmed copy of the names and arrivals. Originals remain ferry property. → RS-S05
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Make no copy here; question him about that night. → RS-S06
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.title: The Price of the Planks
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.1: The old landing lies behind a shallow bar. He sounds the depth from the bank, then shows you the newer ferry’s keel.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.3: He: “This can’t reach it. A shallow boat could.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.7: He: “I can build a raft from my deck planks. It would take the next daylight tide.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.15: He: “I hoped you owned a little boat.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.17: He smiles without expecting you to join him.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.19: Back in the boat shed, He takes the old rope from a dry cupboard. Its end was cut cleanly with a blade rather than torn apart.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.21: He: “The sword keeps the old landing from breaking apart and takes some of the strength out of the current. Once it's gone I'll only be able to ferry people in daylight.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.25: He: “Yes. We'll have to warn people. I can't keep taking night fares once that protection's gone.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.27: You: “Have you already promised this boat to someone else?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.en_us.29: He: “Nobody else owns a share of the boat although I owe the passengers fair warning before I take it apart.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.A: “Survey the raft route without cutting yet.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.A.requir: Requires nothing additional. He surveys the route and marks the timber. An injured protagonist need not do heavy labour. Record preparation; the ferry is not yet dismantled. → RS-S06
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.B: “No work on the boat. Explain the rope.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Do not complete crossing preparations yet. → RS-S06
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.title: He Saw the Knife
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.1: He brings the household register and lays the severed rope across his knees.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.3: He: “Duan untied the bow. He kept the long return line in his hand.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.5: You: “So he could haul you back.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.11: He: “The woman couldn’t breathe. The farmer had one usable arm. The girl was bailing with both shoes.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.15: He: “I cut the rope. Then I kept rowing.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.27: He: “I brought the empty boat back at dawn and found him dead beside the sword.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.29: He turns the severed end over and rubs his thumb along the cut before looking up again.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.39: You: “You saved them. But you'd promised to go back for him.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.en_us.41: He: “I've spent all these years avoiding the fact that he saw me cut the rope and I don't want to hide it anymore.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.A.requir: Requires He’s consent to disclose his own actions, which he gives. → RS-S07
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Change the order of disclosure without promising permanent secrecy. → RS-S08
life.replacement.rain_sword.S06.C.requir: Requires nothing additional. Preserve any existing promise; withdrawal does not erase it. → RS-S15
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.title: The Road for the Living
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.1: He asks the waiting villagers to remain under the roof. He tells them about the knife himself.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.3: A woman holding a covered lamp speaks first.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.9: Woman: “Then don’t say you saved her because you were certain. She said everyone was frightened.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.13: You: “Completing the old crossing may cost his ferry. Any released oath also ends the old river shelter.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.15: Woman: “We can take the ridge road. I won’t call it easy.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.19: Woman: “Some days. We’re talking about carrying grain around a mountain.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.21: She puts her lamp on the bench.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.23: Woman: “Keep the names somewhere dry so people can still read what happened even if you can't finish this tonight.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.en_us.27: Woman: “I'll stay and listen. But you'll have to speak to the others yourself.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.A.requir: Requires nothing additional. Preserve a copy with He’s supplies. Record public disclosure. → RS-S08
life.replacement.rain_sword.S07.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Villagers retain the disclosed account, not a claim that the oath has ended. → RS-S15
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.title: The Last Passenger
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.1: At midnight, the woman with the empty bundle appears beside the farmer’s severed halter and the child’s shadow. They look across the river. None answers a question.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.3: He reads the three arrival entries.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.7: He: “She grew up and had children of her own and her daughter still lives here.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.11: You: “The man the boat was meant to collect.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.15: He: “You were also someone I left on the bank.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.17: Duan’s remnant: “I couldn’t leave before the last passenger.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.19: You: “Those three reached the far bank. You're the one who was left.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.21: Duan's remnant: “I thought I had to wait for every passenger to board before it was my turn.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.23: He steps where the boy once stood.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.25: He: “I brought the boat back too late.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.33: The three waiting images thin. The sword remains embedded.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.35: Duan’s remnant: “You can carry this remnant across. Or let the promise end here. Neither brings back the man who made it.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.en_us.39: Duan’s remnant: “You could take it. I'd still be waiting for the boat.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.A.requir: Requires He’s and the remnant’s voluntary cooperation. Actual boat and safety requirements still apply. → RS-S12
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Negotiate release rather than forcibly erasing the remnant. → RS-S13
life.replacement.rain_sword.S08.C.requir: Requires nothing additional. This choice does not automatically begin combat. → RS-S09
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.title: What the Sword Could Do
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.1: The sword’s hilt is close enough to reach. He folds a reed mat beside it.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.3: He: “For wrapping it. Not my permission.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.5: You: “A weapon could protect someone still alive.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.7: Duan’s remnant: “It could. That does not make it yours.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.9: You: “And leaving it asking the same question?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.11: Duan’s remnant: “You have heard other ways.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.13: He withdraws towards the stone steps.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.15: You: “Can you leave that patch of bank?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.17: Duan's remnant: “I can't leave the sword or move it myself. I can only guard this bank through it. Someone has to carry it if I'm to cross.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.23: He: “He could be defeated then too.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.25: The remnant steadies around the blade.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.27: Duan’s remnant: “I'll defend the sword without attacking the boatman and you can yield by stepping back.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.29: He: “If you fight him for it, that's what I'll have to tell people.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.en_us.31: The reed mat is spread at your feet although you haven't touched the sword yet. He waits beside it to see whether you'll take it.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.A.requir: Requires at least early Qi Refining, current combat eligibility, and an existing attack that can affect this kind of sword spirit. Do not invent a suitable spell. → RS-S10
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.B: “I withdraw my claim to the sword.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Do not begin combat. → RS-S13
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.title: Holding the Landing
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.en_us.1: You step onto the cleared bank. He moves the lamp behind the steps and withdraws beyond the fighting area.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.en_us.3: Duan’s remnant: “Let go before the stroke if you choose to yield.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.en_us.7: Duan’s remnant: “I'm saying you can still step back. You haven't struck yet.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.en_us.9: He: “The steps are behind you. I won’t move the lamp.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.en_us.11: The sword rises against its bonds as water washes over the bank stones. You settle your footing and keep the retreat to the steps in view.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.en_us.15: He: “Think before you answer. You don't have to do this for me.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.en_us.23: Duan’s remnant: “You can withdraw whenever you need to and I won't follow you onto the steps.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.A.requir: Requires continued combat eligibility. Enter the existing Duan Qing encounter.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S10.B.requir: Requires that battle has not begun. Add no combat or knockout. → RS-S13
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.title: What Victory Put Within Reach
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.1: The remnant is now a thin shape at the edge of the blade. Its guard has ended; its waiting has not.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.11: He: “Don’t make that sound like a companion.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.13: Rain washes the exposed metal. It is still stained.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.15: You: “Can we finish the crossing after this?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.17: Duan's remnant: “My memories are too scattered to recognize either bank tonight. Carrying the sword across wouldn't complete that return for me.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.19: He: “We know the passengers' names now so we could still ask him to release the promise.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.21: The sword can now be lifted without another battle. It can also be left where it stands.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.23: He: “If you take it, I’ll record that you took it.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.en_us.27: He: “No. I've kept enough of that night to myself already.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.A: “Take the sword and its unfinished oath.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.A.requir: Requires an actual battle victory. Return He’s token and obtain only the one existing sword. → RS-E3
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. Preserve the battle’s consequences without resetting the remnant. → RS-S13
life.replacement.rain_sword.S11.C.requir: Requires nothing additional. Do not take the sword. → RS-S15
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.title: Two Living People
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.1: By the next safe slack water He has checked the channel and marked the planks he could use. Everyone waits for his final agreement before cutting into the deck.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.3: He: “A shallow boat, or these planks.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.7: He: “I know which planks I’m cutting.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.9: You: “It isn’t all yours to repair.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.11: He: “I can decide about my boat. But the people who use it will still have to walk round the ridge.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.13: Duan’s remnant: “The last boat need not be the same wood.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.15: He: “You might have said that forty years ago.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.17: Duan’s remnant: “You kept telling me nobody was aboard.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.19: After resting, He gets up and points to the token still in your keeping, checking that its names have been read clearly.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.25: He: “You and I will come back alive after taking the remnant over. He understands that we can't bring Duan himself back.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.31: Duan’s remnant: “Memories. They won’t weigh down his boat.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.33: He: “I’ll bind a cradle for the blade. Nobody holds an exposed edge while I row.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.en_us.35: He: “I'll call his name when we land although there won't be a body stepping out of the boat.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.A.requir: Requires He’s consent and the character’s ability to board safely or receive actual assistance. He performs the construction and rowing within his experience. Complete the crossing and receive the offered sword afterward. → RS-E1
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.B.requir: Requires an actually owned suitable boat available at the ferry, with draft and capacity confirmed by He. Do not generate a boat. Complete the crossing and receive the sword. → RS-E1
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.C: “I won’t authorize the crossing. Release him.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S12.C.requir: Requires nothing additional. Withdraw this plan before dismantling He’s ferry or using the protagonist’s boat. → RS-S13
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.title: No Longer Seventeen
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.1: You hand the entrusted token back to He, who lays it beside the sword above the reach of the current.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.5: He: “Without pretending I can give you the morning you lost.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.7: You: “Do you release him from returning?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.9: Duan’s remnant: “I've been looking for the boy I remember instead of seeing the man who's been here all along.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.13: Duan’s remnant: “I think I've waited long enough too.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.15: He cannot look at the sword for a while.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.19: He: “I'll close before dusk and charge enough to keep a daylight ferry running.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.en_us.27: The sword’s outline begins to soften, but the token stays whole. No one has been asked to give up the proof that the people arrived.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.A.requir: Requires He’s and the remnant’s agreement, with truthful records preserved as part of the release. → RS-S14
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.B: “Not yet. Leave it without a new promise.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S13.B.requir: Requires nothing additional. The release is not completed; the oath remains. → RS-S15
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.title: Where the Names Remain
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.en_us.1: The names lie between the lamp and the dark water. He supplies paper from his fare book if no copy has been made.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.en_us.3: He: “We can keep the token, or copy it and return the wood to the river.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.en_us.7: He: “We need to keep the names somewhere safe. A copy would do, if you want to let the token go.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.en_us.9: Duan’s remnant: “The seal was put there to count stores.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.en_us.15: He reads every surviving name and its arrival mark. The voice from the sword does not interrupt him.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.en_us.17: He: “We need to put Duan Qing's name down too and say that he was left at the landing.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.en_us.25: With the remnant's agreement secured He puts down his brush and waits for you to decide how to preserve the names.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.A.requir: Requires nothing additional. Return it to He for later visitors to inspect. Release the oath without receiving the sword. → RS-E2
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.B: “Keep a full copy. Return the wood.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.B.requir: Requires a complete copy checked by He; he prepares it first if necessary. The original leaves the inventory and cannot reappear as a duplicate reward. → RS-E2
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.title: An Account Left Ashore
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.1: He lowers the barrier across the landing. He speaks to the people waiting under the roof, whether or not you can answer.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.7: He: “No night passengers. I’ll use the ridge warning board.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.11: He: “Even if they stop paying me.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.15: He leaves paper beside the fare book so any conscious witness can write or dictate their account. Where someone cannot answer he confines himself to what he witnessed.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.17: He: “I cut the return rope to get the passengers across and Duan died waiting for me to come back.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.21: He: “I'll write down how they helped, and where we had to stop. If they can't speak for themselves, I'll leave it at that.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.23: Villager: “You could have told us those first three things years ago.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.27: The lamp goes above the closed landing. Its light reaches the bank, not the opposite shore.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.en_us.29: He, writing: “I've written down what we found. If someone comes back to help, show them this first.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.A.requir: Requires consciousness and ability to understand and authorize the statement. Attest only to actual experience. Label He’s historical testimony as his account, not the protagonist’s eyewitness knowledge. → RS-E4
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.B: “Return the token. Make no further promise.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S15.B.requir: Requires consciousness and ability to express withdrawal. Return entrusted property still held by the protagonist; do not withdraw statements independently made by others. → RS-E4
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.title: The Last Answer
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.1: At the far bank, He calls Duan Qing’s name. An answering ripple touches the landing.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.9: As the outline fades the sword remains on the bank with its metal clear of rust. He wraps it carefully before putting it into your keeping.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.11: He: “Don’t test the edge with your thumb.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.15: He: “My work is still here at the ferry. I'd have no use for the sword.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.19: A villager finds the dismantled hull the next morning.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.21: Villager: “How do we take grain across?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.23: He: “Around the ridge until I rebuild.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.27: He: “I tried to give you warning although I know you've still got to find a way to get the grain across.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.33: He: “You can take your boat home now that we're done here.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.37: He: “Stopped. The sword isn’t holding that current anymore.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.39: He takes back the entrusted token and uses his knife to add the final crossing mark, specifying that the passenger was the sword's remnant.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E1.en_us.41: He: “Forty-three years. I know what a mark means now.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.title: No Longer Waiting for This Boat
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.1: The blade breaks into pale fragments. They settle like silt and lose their light before anyone can gather a weapon from them.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.3: He: “I thought it would be louder.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.7: He: “I might have called it an answer.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.11: He: “Yes. I’ll have to let that be enough.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.13: The preserved names and arrival records go into the fare box. Before closing it, He checks once more that nobody has been omitted.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.15: He: “I got three people to the other bank and left the man who'd held the landing for us to die there.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.17: You: “What will you tell people when they ask about that night?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.19: He: “I'll tell them the whole thing whenever someone asks.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.21: A woman arrives with grain for the evening boat.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.25: Woman: “Then my brother waits another day.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.29: Woman: “They said you settled the haunting.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.33: Woman: “I still need to send this.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.35: He helps her cover the grain.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E2.en_us.37: You leave without the sword while the ferryman and his passengers begin working out how to manage the crossing without its old protection.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.title: The Wrong Shore
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.1: The sword comes free. The river falls silent before He finishes folding the reed mat.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.3: He: “Wrap something around the edge before you carry it or you'll cut yourself.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.7: He: “I’m keeping you from cutting your hand.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.9: You: “Will you tell people how I got it?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.13: You: “Even if I use it well?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.15: He: “Then I’ll tell them that too, when it happens.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.17: The voice continues after the blade is wrapped in the reed mat.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.25: He goes to lower the barrier across the night landing.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.27: You: “I thought winning would stop him.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.29: He: “He can't stop you taking the sword now. That was all the fight decided.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.31: The blade is yours to carry. The question accompanies it.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.33: Before you leave, He writes: “The sword was taken after a duel against its keeper's wishes. The final crossing remains unfinished.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E3.en_us.35: During a later sleep, should the simulation reach it, a small boat approaches the wrong shore. The dream offers no answer you have earned by possessing the sword.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.title: The Next Visitor
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.1: The next visitor finds the night landing closed and an account beside the fare board.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.3: Visitor: “Is the ferryman who cut the rope still here?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.13: He: “Read what they did before you call it a failure. They helped as much as they could and I won't blame them for having to leave.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.15: Visitor: “What would you ask me to do?”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.23: He holds the lamp over the page for the visitor and offers to read the account aloud for anyone who needs it.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.25: Visitor: “You wrote the knife was yours.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.29: Visitor: “You could have left that out.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.31: He: “I’ve seen what happens when I do.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.33: The oath remains unresolved. If the duel weakened the manifestation, that weakness remains in the record too. He does not pretend the next arrival is a fresh beginning.
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.en_us.35: No sword has changed hands. The landing is less useful, but nobody is sent into the dark carrying only half his story.
life.replacement.rain_sword.S04.check_su:
The fourth line emerges: “Return for the guard.” There is no arrival mark beside it.
He: “Yes. I knew which passenger it meant.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S05.check_fa:
The cramped strokes will not separate cleanly beneath the wax.
He: “Stop there. The knife would give us a clearer story than the wood actually holds.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S09.ownershi:
Duan’s remnant: “You asked about the blade before you asked who crossed.”
You: “I’m still here listening.”
Duan’s remnant: “Then keep doing that.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.S14.promise:
You: “I also promised to bring the boat back.”
Duan’s remnant: “Then replace that undertaking with release. I agree.”
He: “Both sides agree. I’ll record that.”
life.replacement.rain_sword.E4.legacy: A later visitor reads He’s surviving ferry account. He is no longer present to answer. The oath remains unfinished; evidence, promises and actual injuries are preserved. No sword was transferred.
life.expansion.inherit.picker.help: Click a choice, then take the selected reward. Only one legacy can be claimed.
life.expansion.inherit.progress_source: Completed simulated cultivation: %s × %s%%. Carries across stages and realms.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.title: The Missing Fellow Disciple
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S01.en: Your sect duty brings you to Lin Que's room to take over this round of medicine deliveries. He covered the last one for you, and you agreed to do this one in return. On arrival, the first thing you find is a notice accusing him. Lin Que has been erased from the duty register. A notice says he absconded with sect property, yet his cloak hangs beside the bed and the medicine bowl has dried. Beneath the bed, a note reads: They aren’t repairing the formation. They’re feeding it.
A worker comes to the door to collect the medicine tray. His forearm is bandaged. Seeing you reach for the note, he quickly speaks up.
Injured worker: “Don’t put your thumb on that paper.”
Worker: “The paper's still damp enough that you'll rub the writing off if you touch it.”
You: “That’s what it says on the notice.”
Worker: “The notice went up before anyone asked us.”
His bandaged forearm prevents him from lifting the bowl. He pushes it towards you with his elbow.
Worker: “Steward Xie ordered his bedding cleared by dusk.”
Worker: “I don't know why he ordered it and I can't afford to have you quoting guesses as something I told you.”
Requires nothing additional. Safeguard the note without promising a rescue yet. → MD-S02
Requires nothing additional. The worker takes you to the accounts office. → MD-S03
Requires nothing additional. Give the note to the worker without claiming Lin has been found. → MD-S16
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S02.en: The bowl retains a bitter medicinal smell resembling the wash on the worker's bandage. He stands beside the bed as you lift it to smell more closely.
Worker: “I told him it was for soreness when he asked what the medicine treated.”
Worker: “That was what they told me.”
Inside the cloak is a meal ticket for two. Lin has written your next shared shift on the back.
Worker: “He kept offering food to people who couldn’t finish night duty.”
Worker: “Because he expected someone to clear his room.”
You: “Did he tell you to find me?”
Worker: “No, I only came to collect the bowl. I don't think he knew who would find the note.”
You can carry the cloak without owning it. The worker waits for your decision, holding the empty tray against his hip.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S02.A: “Bring his cloak. Show me the way.”
Requires nothing additional. Carry Lin’s cloak and its meal ticket in trust. → MD-S05
Requires nothing additional. Leave the cloak by the bed and preserve the note. → MD-S03
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S03.en: The accounts office smells of scorched paste. A clerk bundles receipts beside a stove; the purchase register still lies open.
Clerk: “I wasn’t told there was one.”
You: “These herbs appear under infirmary deliveries and garden supplies.”
A counterfoil is stuck beneath the page. You could inspect it or take the whole bound register before the office closes.
Worker: “The medicine never reached our dispensary.”
Worker: “I can tell you what I carried.”
You: “You were about to burn its receipts.”
Clerk: “And when he asks where the book went, I'm the one standing here.”
He sets down the bundle without blocking the door.
Use this event’s single saved Insight check, target 17. Resolve below, then go to MD-S04.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S03.B: “Preserve the whole register. Record that I took it.”
Requires no additional ability. Obtain the complete register and record unauthorized removal, which may be addressed separately. → MD-S05
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S03.C: “Leave the register. Show me the delivery route.”
Requires nothing additional. Obtain no complete accounting evidence. → MD-S05
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S04.en: Xie receives you with a garden thermometer in his hand. When you mention Lin, he puts it down so carefully that it makes no sound.
Xie: “He could have left without it. The ring is what's missing from the garden.”
Xie: “From interfering with a treatment batch.”
Xie: “Eight prescriptions the infirmary cannot replace tonight.”
You: “You could have said that in the notice.”
Xie: “Would it have stopped people following him downstairs?”
You: “Is that what the notice is for?”
Xie: “It is for keeping this from becoming a crowd.”
His thumb settles on the edge of his seal. Beyond the window, workers are carrying braziers towards the accounts office.
Xie: “I'll issue an inspection pass so you can see the connections in the control room. Don't touch the active formation until I've explained it.”
Requires nothing additional. Xie issues an inspection pass and brings you to the observation corridor. → MD-S06
Requires nothing additional. Obtain no inspection pass. → MD-S05
Requires nothing additional. Make a formal report without automatically treating suspicion as proof. → MD-S14
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S05.en: The worker takes you to the kitchen passage. He owns a service key, not a master key. It opens the observation corridor but none of the formation controls.
Worker: “I don't have a spirit root so they put me to work carrying trays.”
Worker: “I tried to lift Lin off the seat.”
Worker: “One of the fittings was hot. I caught my arm against it trying to lift him.”
He shows you where a bandage has stuck to the skin, then covers it again.
Worker: “He got five disciples out before he was left there on his own.”
Worker: “Ask him. I already gave one answer about medicine I didn’t understand.”
Worker: “Privately. My name stays out of the courtyard unless I agree.”
He leaves the key on the tray, beside a clean cloth.
Worker: “And bring this back. The next kitchen shift still needs a door.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S05.A: “I won’t identify you publicly without permission.”
Requires nothing additional. Record the confidentiality promise and obtain his voluntary private statement and trust. → MD-S06
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S05.B: “No statement yet. Show me the way.”
Requires nothing additional. Obtain no signed statement; accompanying you does not constitute consent to publicity. → MD-S06
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S06.en: Through the observation grille, Lin sits inside three linked seals. The copper ring from the notice is locked into the housing beside his wrist. Five other seats stand empty.
Lin: “You’re late.”
You: “For the medicine errand?”
Lin: “I could've used someone telling me to stop earlier.”
You: “I haven’t decided what you did.”
Lin: “I took the others off.”
You: “And put yourself on?”
Lin: “The return locked when I tried to leave.”
You: “You didn’t know it would?”
Lin: “I thought I understood it.”
You: “Did Xie?”
Lin: “He installed it.”
Lin has to pause when his fingers begin trembling again and waits for it to pass before continuing.
Lin: “Two of them signed up because I told them the night duty would get them extra meals.”
You: “That doesn’t authorize this.”
Lin: “I know it doesn't excuse what they did but I still wish I'd never said it.”
You: “What should I bring you?”
Lin: “Not another bowl labelled soreness.”
You: “Can you walk if we disconnect it?”
Lin: “I don't know. You'll probably have to help me up first.”
When you ask whether the garden could be stopped to release him, he looks up at you properly for the first time.
Lin: “Then someone needs to say that where Xie can hear.”
Requires nothing additional. Inspect the maintenance area on the observation side without touching the live formation. → MD-S07
Requires nothing additional. Record direct observation of the binding. → MD-S14
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S06.D: “I won’t operate it. I’ll seek medical help.”
Requires nothing additional. Lin remains connected at this point. → MD-S16
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S07.en: The observation corridor passes an unpowered storage alcove. A diagram and dated night-duty entries hang beside a sealed box.
Worker: “The chart shows the Living-Root, Supply and Return Seals with Xie's approval beside them.”
Worker: “It says to reduce the supply before isolating the living-root link and draining the return.”
Worker: “I can read. I can’t perform it.”
Worker: “Twenty-four charged stones. The seal’s intact.”
Worker: “The chart says within four double-hours. The batch should finish before then.”
Worker: “Not enough for all the nights they used people. Enough for what remains.”
You: “Then they can use it now. They don't need to leave him there.”
Worker: “They could have used it earlier too. Xie signed off on keeping it in reserve.”
He points to the dated entries.
Worker: “Take those before somebody calls them duplicates too.”
The box stays sealed. The worker does not have its key.
Requires nothing additional. Preserve the sheet, with the worker confirming its origin. Take no stones. Record technical night-duty evidence. → MD-S08
Requires nothing additional. Learn the reserve quantity and sequence without preserving the original night-duty record. → MD-S08
Requires nothing additional. Identify the documents’ location without claiming a completed investigation. → MD-S14
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S08.en: The guard blocks your way into the control room while Lin remains visible beyond the partition. His attention stays on you rather than threatening Lin with a weapon.
You: “He needs to come off the seat.”
The guard sends for Xie, who has gone back upstairs. Footsteps soon return along the stairway.
Guard: “I can let an authorized inspection through. I cannot let strangers strike a live formation.”
You: “He's getting weaker while we're standing here. How soon can Xie come?”
Guard: “He's been sent for. Stay clear of the live seals and wait for him to bring the key.”
The worker retreats behind the partition to stay with Lin and leaves you facing the guard as you decide whether to force your way through.
Requires the pass issued in MD-S04 A. Enter without combat. → MD-S10
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S08.B: “Have Xie explain in front of us.”
Requires nothing additional. Xie opens the control room after the brief wait. This does not accept a confidential bargain. → MD-S10
Requires at least early Qi Refining, current combat eligibility, and an actually usable attack. → MD-S09
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S09.en: You enter the cleared antechamber. Behind its partition, the worker stays with Lin.
Guard: “The supply continues whichever of us falls.”
Guard: “Stand down and I’ll bring Xie.”
Worker: “They’re both true. Winning here still leaves the seals.”
The guard raises an open palm.
Worker: “It’s open. I’m not coming through the fight to fetch you a tool.”
From the inner room comes a scrape as Lin adjusts his feet.
Lin: “If you're doing this for me then remember I'm still waiting to get off this seat.”
Lin: “Then come and help me off the seat as soon as it's over.”
Guard: “You can still lower your hand.”
Guard: “Before either of us attacks, yes.”
His hand remains raised. The next movement is yours.
Requires continued combat eligibility. Enter the original formation-guard encounter.
Requires that combat has not begun. Add no knockout or completed assault. → MD-S14
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S10.en: Once the confrontation ends Xie unlocks the inspection door and goes straight to examine Lin's wrist before turning to the papers you're holding.
Xie: “Don’t pull the ring.”
Lin: “You could put that on your notices.”
You: “Can you disconnect him?”
Xie: “By shutting down the garden.”
You: “Do it.”
Xie: “Eight prescriptions.”
Lin: “Will eight people die tonight without it? Do you know that, or are you trying to scare us?”
Xie: “They will wait longer for replacement medicine. I don’t know how long.”
You: “Is there anything that could supply the formation instead of a person?”
Xie: “The twenty-four stones would cover the hours left in this batch although they wouldn't have lasted through the whole growing cycle.”
Lin: “So you saved stones by using us.”
Xie: “Yes.”
Lin: “Don’t follow that with your reasons.”
Xie shuts his mouth. One of Lin’s hands has begun shaking again.
You: “Two ways, then.”
Xie: “We can stop the formation now or use the reserve to finish this batch before dismantling every human-supply connection.”
Lin: “Neither way puts anyone else on this seat.”
Xie: “Agreed.”

He hands over the tool for the external isolation control. It permits a mechanical action, not the ability to redirect spiritual flow. He remains responsible for that work unless a genuinely qualified cultivator takes over.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S10.A: “Shut it down. Accept losing the batch.”
Requires no additional cultivation. Xie performs the standard isolation he knows. → MD-S11
Requires the twenty-four reserve stones to remain unused and Lin’s consent to consider this approach. → MD-S12
Requires nothing additional. This does not leave Lin connected until an entire trial concludes. → MD-S14
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S11.en: You go over the control sequence together before Xie begins isolating the spiritual connections while you check the external labels.
Xie: “Wait for the return to drain.”
Lin: “I'm only saying the feeling's come back; I'm not trying to move it yet.”
Lin leans on the railing rather than standing unsupported.
Lin: “Now you can bring the bowl.”
Worker: “From the infirmary. With someone telling us what’s in it.”
Xie: “I have to report the crop loss.”
Xie: “The physician comes first. You can come with me.”
Above, heat leaves the growing beds. This batch will not finish.
You: “We still have them. We can talk about what to do with them after you're seen to.”
Lin: “Give me a moment until my legs stop shaking enough for me to stand.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S11.A: “He’s free. Present what we can prove.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S11.B: “Hand over his care. I won’t pursue the case.”
Requires nothing additional. Record Lin as disconnected; withdrawal does not put him back into the formation. → MD-S16
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S12.en: Xie opens the reserve box under observation. The twenty-four stones belong to the project, not to you; their use goes into the incident record.
Xie: “I can withdraw the desertion notice and put him on medical leave.”
Lin: “And say why the notice was false?”
Lin: “That is the part you are buying.”
Xie: “The reserve will finish this batch and we won't connect another person to it.”
Xie: “We'll seal the records while allowing each affected worker to get a copy of their own.”
You: “Does accepting treatment waive a complaint?”
Lin: “I'll take the treatment. But I still want it recorded why I was on that seat.”
He asks that Xie no longer control his work assignments. Xie agrees to a sealed referral to the duty elder, not a public confession.
Lin: “I don’t want his hands on the connection.”
You: “We still need someone who knows how.”
Lin: “I know we need him. Just let me say when I'm ready.”
The worker brings a chair outside the seals. No one places another donor on the empty seat.
Requires no protagonist cultivation. Xie performs the verified procedure on the apparatus he knows; do not add a random check to a settled operation. Consume the twenty-four project stones and free Lin. → MD-E2
Requires nothing additional. Unused reserve stones do not become protagonist property. → MD-S11
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S13.en: Lin reaches the courtyard on a chair carried by willing attendants. He refuses to be stood up for the hearing.
Duty elder: “What identifies who ordered repeated human supply?”
Xie: “The register is not permission to publish every patient’s name.”
Lin: “He's right about the patients so leave their names out when you publish it. His approval mark needs to stay where people can see it.”
Lin: “Mine stays. It was public when I was supposedly a deserter.”
Duty elder: “A complete register establishes the authorization. A detached night-duty sheet also needs a witness to its use.”
Worker: “I’ll confirm what I carried. Privately.”
Duty elder: “You need not address the courtyard.”
Worker: “All right. But tell the clerk too. I don't want to hear my name being called in the courtyard.”
Lin asks for his chair to be turned a little so he can see the worker as well as the elder and steward.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S13.A: “Publish the authorization, protecting the other victims’ identities.”
Requires complete accounting evidence, or the MD-S07 A night-duty sheet corroborated by the worker in a sealed hearing. For the latter, he now explicitly consents to private confirmation. → MD-E1
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S13.B: “Seek a protective order without overstating the evidence.”
Requires nothing additional. Do not repeat the completed rescue. → MD-S14
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S13.C: “Deposit the evidence. I won’t lead the next stage.”
Requires nothing additional. Lin remains in medical care; accountability is unfinished. → MD-S16
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S14.en: You bring the allegation to the courtyard before obtaining a final ruling. Xie arrives behind the duty elder.
Duty elder: “Start by telling me what you saw for yourself before we go over what anyone told you.”
You: “His name was erased. I found a note saying they feed the formation rather than repair it.”
You: “That doesn’t answer whether he can leave.”
Xie: “You could inspect without a crowd.”
He sends a medical attendant to verify Lin’s condition, taking any direct account you can provide.
Duty elder: “If a person is connected, stop the human supply under medical observation.”
Duty elder: “Will be recorded. Stop the supply first.”
You: “Will you wait for all the records?”
Duty elder: “I'll need the records before deciding on punishment but I can stop an unsafe treatment now.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S14.A: “State what is known. Protect the witness’s identity.”
Requires nothing additional. Do not present unobserved events as eyewitness knowledge. → MD-S15
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S14.B: “Identify the worker publicly to support the charge.”
Requires the private statement from MD-S05 A. The worker has not consented; this breaks your promise. Record the disclosure and damaged trust. → MD-S15
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S15.en: Lin receives treatment while the hearing addresses a narrower question. The attendant confirms that Xie completed the standard shutdown under observation.
Duty elder: “Night feeding will stop while we examine the surviving accounts and decide what further action is warranted.”
Lin: “You can restore my name without deciding everyone else’s case.”
Duty elder: “I can restore your current status.”
Elder: “He cannot operate formations fed by living people during the review. His other duties remain for now.”
Lin: “He’ll be here when witnesses return.”
Duty elder: “Another official will receive their statements.”
Duty elder: “I've asked the infirmary to arrange replacement medicine although it won't be ready tonight.”
Lin presses two fingers against his blanket.
Lin: “Write down who I should go to. I don't want to be sent back here when I try to speak.”
Duty elder: “And any charge against your visitor is separate. Reporting what they saw is not an offence.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S15.A: “Accept the protective order and continue through the record.”
Requires nothing additional. This does not declare every suspicion proved. → MD-E3
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S15.B: “Enforce the protection and request review of the disputed findings.”
Requires nothing additional. Record the review request without automatically reversing censure or awarding a victory. → MD-E3
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S16.en: The worker brings the duty key and the papers actually preserved to the physician's desk, distinguishing his own observations from what others told him.
Worker: “Could I sit down while you find someone to take this? Please keep it where they'll see it.”
Worker: “A man still tied to a formation.”
Worker: “A man who needs someone to take over his treatment.”
Worker: “We won't know until someone goes down there to check.”
Clerk: “And the person who brought the first note?”
He rests his uninjured hand on the papers.
Worker: “Please give it to someone who'll go down there. We've already lost enough time.”
The clerk takes the key and calls for an attendant.
Requires consciousness and ability to authorize the statement. Do not turn the worker’s later observations into the protagonist’s eyewitness experience. → MD-E4
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S16.B: “Return entrusted property. Make no new promise.”
Requires consciousness and ability to express the decision. Return any remaining key or Lin’s property to medical staff or the worker; destroy no evidence. → MD-E4
life.replacement.missing_disciple.E1.en_: The revised duty list omits private medical details. Lin’s name returns with an explicit correction of the desertion allegation. Xie is removed from night-duty authority pending a wider inquiry.
Lin: “They’ve left room after my name.”
Lin: “For when the physician says I can work.”
Worker: “I’ll read mine before they hang it.”
Lin: “We can go through both copies together if you'd like me there.”
Worker: “Two patients asked when the replacement medicine arrives.”
Worker: “They've ordered it but nobody's been able to tell us when it'll arrive.”
Lin: “I don't much feel like celebrating while they're still waiting.”
He starts to rise, thinks better of it, and settles back.
You: “When you're feeling better, let's have a meal together.”
Lin: “When I can sit through one without counting my pulse.”
Lin: “You can choose the place. Not the duty kitchen.”
The inquiry begins; injuries and unpaid wages remain to be addressed. What Lin offers is a visit, not a spell or somebody else’s compensation.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.E2.en_: Xie connects the twenty-four reserve stones before isolating the living source. The worker and infirmary staff help Lin away from the seat. Hours later, as the final stones dim and the crop is harvested, Xie shuts down the growth array and dismantles its human connections.
Lin: “What does the notice say now?”
You: “Would you rather have waited for a public correction?”
Lin: “Of course I wanted to get off the seat. I still don't like what we had to agree to.”
Lin: “Then deliver it. Don’t ask me to congratulate you.”
Xie: “You can still make a complaint.”
Lin: “I know. That’s why I insisted you write it.”
Worker: “Where will he work after treatment?”
Xie: “His referral specifies that a different official will assign his work after treatment.”
Lin: “Keep your copy somewhere safe in case they ever try to change what we agreed.”
The batch exists; whether patients benefit belongs to later treatment. The worker receives only his own record.
Nobody feeds the formation that night and the eight prescriptions are saved. Outside the room the new notice mentions only medical leave while the account of who was responsible stays sealed.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.E3.en_: The provisional order replaces the desertion notice. It protects Lin from further night feeding and restores his current status without declaring the whole case proved.
Lin: “At least I'm out here now instead of waiting in there for them to decide.”
Worker: “They asked me to check the spelling of my entry.”
Lin: “You don’t have to make that sound like forgiveness.”
A requested review of any separate censure remains a request, not an automatic reversal. Without an established breach, there is no invented punishment for a careful report.
The plants are lost. The inquiry must still address that loss, the injuries, and the false notice.
Your copy is a limited order, not proof that every suspicion was correct.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.E4.en_: The account is dated to the moment you leave. It states whether Lin was freed, which papers survived, and what the worker was willing to disclose.
Clerk: “We can mark the report received.”
Worker: “Write down the situation when we left too. Don't just stamp it handled.”
Worker: “Someone still needs to check how he is and arrange the care he needs.”
If Lin remains connected, the request is urgent and its success unconfirmed. If he was already rescued, accountability and continuing care remain unfinished.
The attendant leaves with the key. The worker stays by the desk; he no longer has to hold the door open with his own arm.
For an unconscious or deceased protagonist, this is other people’s testimony. No new conversation or signature is attributed to them.
There is no reward for completing a rescue that did not happen. There is a record from which someone can continue.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S04.ve:
You preserve two approved counterfoils with the same batch number and different destinations.
Clerk: “I’m confirming where the paper came from. Don’t answer the rest for me.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S04.in:
The records remain incomplete: authorization, batch number and destination are not reliably linked.
Worker: “That doesn’t mean I lied. It doesn’t mean you proved it either.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S11.cl: The worker places the entrusted cloak around Lin’s shoulders and returns his meal ticket.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S11.bl: Medical attendants provide an ordinary blanket; care still follows the actual injuries.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S15.pr: Worker: “You asked. I answered. I was not unclear.”
life.replacement.missing_disciple.S15.ce: The elder records a reviewable censure and temporarily restricts unaccompanied archive access. Evidence preservation, combat and disclosure can be argued separately.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.E3.wor: The worker no longer entrusts you with his documents. Lin’s rescue does not erase the disclosure.
life.replacement.missing_disciple.E4.leg: The infirmary receives the surviving record, preserving Lin’s actual rescue status and evidence. The worker can no longer answer in person. No signature, promise or successful rescue is invented.

life.loot.start.title: A Courier Beside the Flooded Road
life.loot.start.0: At an old waystation beside the wet road you meet Xu Yan, a courier carrying books and medicine. His overturned cart has three empty case compartments and he has injured his ankle. You have just met; he explains that the missing cases are deliveries entrusted to him.
life.loot.start.1: Xu points towards the drainage ditch. “The water carried all three down there. I can't manage those slippery stones with this ankle. If you'll help let me explain the goods and the payment first.”
life.loot.start.2: The ledger identifies medicine, a technique rubbing and a cultivation manuscript in the three cases. The sender authorizes one recovery reward: two pills, permission to study the rubbing or permission to study the manuscript. Original writings and unchosen goods remain deliveries rather than becoming your property.
life.loot.start.3: “The authorization lets me pay once they're recovered,” Xu says, showing you the signature. “If you can't find them or don't want the job we'll stop there. I can't promise somebody else's goods without permission.”
life.loot.pick_pill: Take two pills from the medicine packet
life.loot.pick_spell: Study a new technique suited to your realm
life.loot.cache.title: One Share of the Delivery
life.loot.cache.0: Behind fallen branches in the ditch, you find three cases whose sealed delivery marks match the ledger. You carry them beneath the eaves. Xu checks each one before opening them under the sender's payment authorization and preparing fresh delivery seals.
life.loot.cache.1: Xu sets the three cases beside the ledger and opens the payment authorization you saw earlier. “The medicine, rubbing and manuscript are all here. Now choose the share we agreed on.” He checks their delivery marks once more.
life.loot.cache.2: “Two pills or permission to study one of the texts here,” he says. “I can show you the instructions but can't give you cultivation you haven't earned. Choose something else if you already know it or can't learn it yet.”
life.loot.cache.3: Only one reward is settled. Pills enter your belongings without being consumed. Technique and method choices require your actual roots, realm and existing knowledge; the original texts are not additional items taken away.
life.loot.pill.follow: This delivery record shows three recovered cases, two pills paid and the remaining goods returned to Xu for delivery.
life.loot.E_pill.title: The Medicine Packet
life.loot.E_pill.0: Xu hands you the authorized two pills. You store them without taking a dose or also claiming study of the rubbing or manuscript.
life.loot.E_pill.1: The three cases remain with Xu and the ledger marks this recovery payment settled. Your property is the two agreed pills rather than the entire consignment.
life.loot.spell.follow: This delivery record shows three recovered cases and completed study of the rubbing, with the original returned to Xu.
life.loot.E_spell.title: A Technique Remembered
life.loot.E_spell.0: You study the original rubbing using your own existing cultivation until you understand and can reproduce the eligible new technique. Xu does not cast on your behalf or transfer another person's realm.
life.loot.E_spell.1: You return the original rubbing to its case and the ledger records the study permission fulfilled. The learned technique stays with this life without also granting the other rewards.
life.loot.method.follow: This delivery record shows three recovered cases and completed study of the manuscript, with the original returned to Xu.
life.loot.E_method.title: The Manuscript Opens
life.loot.E_method.0: You study the authorized manuscript and learn its eligible circulation route and cultivation limit. It becomes a learned method without deleting your previous methods or bypassing the realms and knowledge you actually possess.
life.loot.E_method.1: The original manuscript goes back into Xu's case. The settled reward is the completed study rather than the book, pills and another technique together.
life.loot.withdraw.follow: Xu's delivery ledger retains an incomplete recovery request, with no settlement entered in its payment column.
life.loot.E4.title: The Road Continues
life.loot.E4.0: The three cases remain unrecovered when you leave. Xu watches the rushing ditch with his ledger beside him and the payment authorization still between its pages. No medicine or text has changed hands.
